paras.en: Besides some pretty chill movies, A24 excels at spinning off memes. Hereditary memes, Uncut Gems memes, memes contrasting its movies with Costco hot dogs. The company thought — we all thought — they had a good one with that close-up two-shot of Fielder and Holmes on the couch. It had already been repurposed so many times.
paras.zh: 除了一些非常酷的电影外，A24 还擅长衍生梗。遗传模因、未切割宝石模因、将其电影与 Costco 热狗进行对比的模因。公司认为——我们都认为——他们拍了一个很好的镜头，拍摄了菲尔德和福尔摩斯坐在沙发上的特写两张照片。它已经被改变了很多次用途。

paras.en: But when the final history of our era is written and the one true artifact remains, that artifact will, of course, be a meme of the egg scene. So banal; so revealing. There is no one way to whisk eggs. But Evans thinks there is, and he is about to joystick Holmes into doing it that way.
paras.zh: 但是，当我们这个时代的最终历史被书写并且一件真正的神器仍然存在时，该神器当然将成为鸡蛋场景的模因。如此平庸；如此暴露。没有一种方法可以搅拌鸡蛋。但埃文斯认为是有的，他准备操纵福尔摩斯这样做。

paras.en: The SNL sketches are coming; so are the Oscar bits. An omelet station will never be the same again.
paras.zh: SNL 草图即将推出；奥斯卡金像奖也是如此。煎蛋卷站将不再一样。

paras.en: Federal Prison Camp Bryan, where Holmes is being held, already comes off as a mysterious place in the film, doesn’t it? (We still have vending-machine questions.) But you don’t know the half of it. The place has incarcerated a true motley crew of inmates — Epstein associate Ghislaine Maxwell is currently there, former Real Housewife star Jen Shah just got out of there in August, and Jenna Ryan, the Texas realtor and convicted Jan. 6 rioter who’s had some seriously wild things to say as she tried to become a right-wing influencer, was released from there last winter. When’s the doc of that place?
paras.zh: 关押福尔摩斯的布莱恩联邦监狱营在电影中已经显得很神秘，不是吗？ （我们仍然有自动售货机的问题。）但你只知道其中的一半。这个地方关押着一群真正的杂种囚犯——爱泼斯坦的同事吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔(Ghislaine Maxwell)目前就在那里，前《真正的家庭主妇》明星珍·沙阿(Jen Shah)8月份刚刚从那里出来，德克萨斯州房地产经纪人、1月6日被定罪的骚乱者珍娜·瑞恩(Jenna Ryan)去年冬天从那里释放，她在试图成为右翼影响者时曾说过一些非常疯狂的话。那个地方的医生什么时候有？

paras.en: The women’s prison is a very low-security facility (one reason Maxwell’s transfer there as a sex offender provoked outrage) and generally holds people with sentences shorter than five years. The facility, about 100 miles outside Houston, has fewer staff than other federal facilities because the inmates are not generally considered violent risks. Family and anyone else approved by the inmate can visit every Saturday and/or Sunday. The prison sits in a residential neighborhood of craftsman-esque homes and singing mockingbirds, and the grounds have even been reported by neighbors as almost seeming like a park. (You may have gotten that vibe from the last scene.)
paras.zh: 女子监狱是一个安全性非常低的设施（麦克斯韦作为性犯罪者被转移到那里引起公愤的原因之一），通常关押刑期不超过五年的人。该设施距离休斯顿约 100 英里，与其他联邦设施相比，工作人员较少，因为囚犯通常不被视为暴力风险。家人和囚犯批准的任何其他人可以每周六和/或周日探视。监狱坐落在一个住宅区，周围有工匠式的房屋和会唱歌的反舌鸟，邻居甚至报告说，监狱的场地几乎看起来像一个公园。 （你可能已经从最后一个场景中感受到了这种氛围。）

paras.en: Holmes, per her sentence, shouldn’t be out until 2034. But a judge ruled earlier this year that because she didn’t cause “substantial financial hardship” to victims she can get out some four years early, in 2030. Meanwhile a Theranos investor who was defrauded by Holmes says he was alerted by the Justice Department that, likely because of good behavior, Holmes is actually headed for a halfway house in Austin this very summer — giving her and Fieldenheim just enough time to plan a sequel for 2028.
paras.zh: 按照霍尔姆斯的判决，霍尔姆斯要到 2034 年才能出狱。但今年早些时候，一名法官裁定，由于她没有给受害者造成“严重的经济困难”，她可以提前大约四年，即 2030 年出狱。与此同时，一位被霍尔姆斯欺骗的 Theranos 投资者表示，司法部向他发出警报，霍尔姆斯实际上可能是因为表现良好，今年夏天将前往奥斯汀的一所中途宿舍，这样她和菲尔登海姆就有足够的时间计划在 2028 年拍摄续集。

articles.title: ‘Other Desert Cities’ Theater Review: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Ed Harris and Allison Janney Fail to Make a Once-Timely Play Relevant Again
articles.author: Richard Lawson

paras.en: What if there was a second Ronald Reagan? It’s a troubling question, and one that playwright Jon Robin Baitz posed in his 2011 Pulitzer-finalist play Other Desert Cities. A classic coming-home family drama, Other Desert Cities was last on Broadway that same year, when its study of neocon order running headlong into its rotten, self-serving legacy was hot-button relevant. The play, largely set in 2004, opens with talk of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, before settling into its more allegorical story of the troubled liberal daughter of Palm Springs Republicans returning to the nest with the worst kind of Christmas gift under her arm: manuscripts of a damning, soon-to-be-published family memoir.
paras.zh: 如果有第二个罗纳德·里根怎么办？这是一个令人不安的问题，剧作家乔恩·罗宾·贝茨 (Jon Robin Baitz) 在其 2011 年入围普利策奖的戏剧《其他沙漠城市》中提出了这个问题。 《其他沙漠城市》是一部经典的回家家庭剧，同年最后一次在百老汇上演，当时它对新保守主义秩序的研究一头扎进了其腐烂、自私的遗产中，成为热门话题。该剧主要以 2004 年为背景，以伊拉克和阿富汗战争作为开头，然后开始讲述更具寓言性的故事：棕榈泉共和党人的自由派女儿陷入困境，腋下夹着最糟糕的圣诞礼物：一本即将出版的家庭回忆录的手稿。

paras.en: The Wyeths, Polly (Julia Louis-Dreyfus in her Broadway debut) and Lyman (Ed Harris), are grand poobahs of the conservative establishment, once close friends of the Reagans and other miserable people (Barry Goldwater is mentioned). Lyman, like dear old Dutch, was a low-tier movie star before Reagan gave him an ambassadorship. Polly, unlike Nancy, is Jewish and wrote a forgettable series of made-for-TV movies with her sister before higher purpose, and more money, came calling. Retired from showbiz and politics, the Wyeths enjoy their country club socializing and their well-appointed mid-century home but, it seems, not always the company of their children.
paras.zh: 惠氏夫妇、波莉（朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷福斯在百老汇首次亮相）和莱曼（艾德·哈里斯饰）是保守派的大佬，曾经是里根家族和其他悲惨人民（提到了巴里·戈德华特）的亲密朋友。莱曼，就像亲爱的老荷兰人一样，在里根授予他大使职位之前，他只是一名低级电影明星。与南希不同，波莉是犹太人，在更高的目标和更多的钱到来之前，她和姐姐一起创作了一系列令人难忘的电视电影。从演艺圈和政界退休后，怀斯夫妇享受乡村俱乐部的社交活动和设备齐全的中世纪住宅，但似乎并不总是有孩子的陪伴。

paras.en: Baby boy Trip (Joe Keery) is the caddish, porn-addicted creator of a People’s Court-esque reality show called Jury of Your Peers, the gag being that the jury is made up of faded icons and D-listers. Though no great pride of his parents’, Trip is close to them in the infantilized way of youngest children, and is far more apathetic to their increasingly creaky (and dangerous) politics than is his sister Brooke (Lily Rabe), a black sheep who long ago decamped to the East Coast, where a marriage crumbled and some months were spent in a psychiatric hospital.
paras.zh: 小男孩特里普（乔·基里饰演）是一个恶俗、沉迷于色情片的人，他制作了一个人民法院式的真人秀节目《同侪陪审团》，搞笑之处在于陪审团由褪色的偶像和 D 级明星组成。尽管特里普并没有为父母感到骄傲，但他以最小的孩子们幼稚的方式与他们亲近，并且对他们日益摇摇欲坠（且危险）的政治态度比他的妹妹布鲁克（莉莉·拉贝饰）更加冷漠，布鲁克是一只害群之马，很久以前逃到了东海岸，在那里婚姻破裂，并在精神病院度过了几个月。

paras.en: The American moment in which Brooke and her parents find themselves — just after George W. Bush’s second election victory — is a fraught one for such ideological divides within a family, the respective sides pushed further from one another as the nation dumbs itself with modern media and tilts into what could become another Vietnam. But more poignantly ailing the Wyeths, maybe, is the ghost of Polly and Lyman’s eldest son, Henry, who dropped out and burnt out before taking his own life following a Weather Underground-esque bombing that killed a security guard at an Army recruitment facility.
paras.zh: 就在乔治·W·布什第二次选举胜利之后，布鲁克和她的父母发现自己所处的美国时刻是一个令人担忧的时刻，因为一个家庭内部存在着这样的意识形态分歧，随着这个国家用现代媒体愚弄自己，并倾向于可能成为另一个越南，双方之间的分歧越来越大。但更让怀斯一家感到痛苦的或许是波莉和莱曼的长子亨利的鬼魂。亨利在一次类似地下气象报的爆炸事件中导致一名陆军征兵设施的保安身亡后，他辍学并在自杀前精疲力竭。

paras.en: That’s 30 years in the past, though, which is where the family has largely kept that pain, until Brooke announces that she’s written the book that will till the earth of their tragedy for all to see. Horrified parents thus turn on addled daughter, with aimless, amoral son caught in the middle.
paras.zh: 然而，那已经是 30 年前的事了，这家人在很大程度上一直保留着这种痛苦，直到布鲁克宣布她写了这本书，这本书将让所有人都看到他们的悲剧。惊恐万分的父母于是把矛头指向了精神错乱的女儿，而漫无目的、不道德的儿子则被夹在中间。

paras.en: Minus the specific details, this is a familiar set-up in the American theater; anyone weaned on the medium is well (and perhaps fondly) aware of the squabbling, big-gesture, family-secret genre. We just saw it in sterling form on Broadway recently, in two awards-bedecked plays from the same playwright: Brandon Jacobs-Jenkins’ companion-piece barn burners Appropriate and Purpose. It’s a hoary but still fecund form — I’m tempted to make the contention that almost every great playwright worth their salt must have their version of a juicy living-room brawl in their portfolio.
paras.zh: 除去具体细节，这是美国剧院中常见的设置；任何接触过这种媒体的人都清楚（或许还深情地）了解这种争吵、大动作、家庭秘密的类型。我们最近刚刚在百老汇看到了它的纯正形式，在同一位剧作家的两部获奖戏剧中：布兰登·雅各布斯-詹金斯的姊妹篇《谷仓燃烧器》《适当》和《目的》。这是一种古老但仍然丰富的形式——我很想提出这样的论点：几乎每一位称职的伟大剧作家的作品中都必须有他们版本的有趣的客厅争吵。

paras.en: When it first debuted, Other Desert Cities — the title referring to a sign on the highway approaching Palm Springs, but perhaps also alluding to places in faraway countries that were being bombed and invaded at the time of the story — was hailed as one of the greats of its kind. Theatergoers in the elated and relieved first blushes of the Obama age were hungry for plays that looked back at the terrible destruction and numbskullery of the Bush years, eager to sift through the rubble and find some piercing insight that might put all that horror in its proper context. And to have a laugh, too, now that dinosaurs like Polly and Lyman had been proven so terribly wrong.
paras.zh: 当它首次亮相时，《其他沙漠城市》——标题指的是接近棕榈泉的高速公路上的一个标志，但也许也暗指在故事发生时正在遭受轰炸和入侵的遥远国家的地方——被誉为同类中最伟大的作品之一。奥巴马时代的观众在兴高采烈、如释重负的第一眼红时，渴望看到能够回顾布什时代可怕的破坏和麻木的戏剧，渴望在废墟中筛选并找到一些敏锐的洞察力，可以将所有这些恐怖放在适当的背景下。现在，像波利和莱曼这样的恐龙已经被证明是大错特错了，也可以开怀大笑。

paras.en: I saw the play back then, and was rattled and moved and amused by it, just as so many others were. It was a pleasure to watch Stockard Channing as Polly, playing the dark inverse of her solid-liberal first lady character on The West Wing; to sit in the rumbling majesty of Stacy Keach as grizzly old teddy bear Lyman; to enjoy Judith Light wryly staggering around as Polly’s tenuously sober sister, Silda (played in this production by Allison Janney). And the cri de coeur of Baitz’s writing made its impact, too: His portrait of wealthy and once powerful right-wingers stranded on the wrong side of history felt like a smug and bitterly sad goodbye to an era, to an entire ethos over which we had just triumphed.
paras.zh: 我当时就看过这部剧，和很多人一样，被它惊吓、感动、好笑。很高兴看到斯托卡德·钱宁饰演波莉，在《白宫风云》中扮演坚定自由的第一夫人角色的黑暗反面。坐在史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 的隆隆威严中，扮演灰白的老泰迪熊莱曼 (Lyman)；朱迪思·莱特 (Judith Light) 饰演波莉 (Polly) 清醒的妹妹西尔达 (Silda)（在这部作品中由艾莉森·詹尼 (Allison Janney) 饰演），她苦笑着摇摇晃晃地走来走去。拜茨作品中的内心呐喊也产生了影响：他对富有且曾经强大的右翼分子的描绘，被困在历史的错误一边，感觉就像是对一个时代、对我们刚刚战胜的整个精神的自鸣得意和痛苦的悲伤告别。

paras.en: In hindsight, of course, that was an awfully presumptuous sentiment. Baitz could in no way have predicted what would come belching out of hell in the wake of Obama optimism, which makes much of Other Desert Cities seem like an ossified, naïve period piece. And yet there is still some pertinence to be mined; plenty of liberal kids are currently railing against the cold self-dealing of their rich, Trump-voting parents. At least, that’s the value that the producers of this new production at the Hudson Theatre might have seen in the text.
paras.zh: 当然，事后看来，这是一种非常自以为是的情绪。贝茨根本无法预测奥巴马的乐观主义会带来什么，这使得其他沙漠城市的大部分内容看起来像是一个僵化、天真的时代作品。然而，仍有一些相关性有待挖掘。许多自由派孩子目前正在抱怨他们富有的、投票特朗普的父母冷酷的自我交易。至少，这是哈德逊剧院这部新作品的制片人可能在文本中看到的价值。

paras.en: In order to really sell this political-meets-personal drama in the present day, they’d need a starry cast, and one has indeed been impressively assembled. The A-list ensemble has made Other Desert Cities one of the hottest tickets of the fall season; as proof of that, my audience was stacked with celebrities, there to either cheer on their peers or stew enviously in their success.
paras.zh: 为了在当今真正推销这部政治与个人相结合的戏剧，他们需要明星阵容，而其中的阵容确实令人印象深刻。一流的乐团使“其他沙漠城市”成为秋季最热门的门票之一；作为证明，我的听众中挤满了名人，他们要么为同龄人欢呼，要么羡慕他们的成功。

paras.en: The latter camp wasn’t given much reason to sulk, though. This Other Desert Cities, directed by John Benjamin Hickey, is wobbly from the start, off-rhythm and woefully imbalanced in its performances. The biggest draw here is no doubt Louis-Dreyfus, a TV comedy icon who has won 11 Emmys and a Mark Twain Prize. Sharp, nimble and unafraid of humor’s dark corners, Louis-Dreyfus is a legend for good reason. She has also proved an adept dramatic actress in two Nicole Holofcener films, Enough Said and You Hurt My Feelings, performances that should have garnered far more acclaim than they did. I don’t know anyone who loves the filmed arts who doesn’t also love Julia Louis-Dreyfus. Which is why it’s such a shame to report that she really doesn’t work here.
paras.zh: 不过，后一个阵营并没有太多理由生闷气。这部由约翰·本杰明·希基执导的《其他沙漠城市》从一开始就摇摇欲坠，节奏失调，表演严重不平衡。这里最吸引人的无疑是路易斯-德雷福斯，他是一位荣获 11 项艾美奖和一项马克·吐温奖的电视喜剧偶像。路易斯-德雷福斯敏锐、敏捷，不畏幽默的阴暗角落，成为传奇是有充分理由的。她还在妮可·哈洛芬瑟的两部电影《说得够多》和《你伤害了我的感情》中证明了自己是一位娴熟的戏剧演员，这些表演本应获得比他们更多的赞誉。我不知道有哪个热爱电影艺术的人不喜欢朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷福斯。这就是为什么报告她真的不在这里工作真是太遗憾了。

paras.en: Louis-Dreyfus leans too hard on the sitcom-y beats of Baitz’s early banter, which sets her up poorly for the towering drama to come. Polly is spoken about as the lion of the household, a force of nature who ruthlessly commands her family in a cute tennis skirt or boho, Saks-outing maxi dress. Louis-Dreyfus, though, communicates little of that power; she’s too airy and chipper, never giving us the sense that Polly is firmly planted in the bedrock of her world.
paras.zh: 路易斯-德雷福斯过于依赖贝茨早期戏谑的情景喜剧节奏，这让她为即将到来的精彩戏剧做好了准备。波莉被认为是家庭中的狮子，一种自然的力量，她穿着可爱的网球裙或波西米亚风格的萨克斯外出长裙，无情地命令她的家人。然而，路易-德雷福斯并没有传达出多少这种力量。她太轻快、活泼，从来没有让我们感觉到波莉牢牢植根于她的世界的基石中。

paras.en: While Louis-Dreyfus deftly lands a few killer lines, and does achingly register some of the sadder stretches, Channing’s moody gravitas is sorely missed, especially when Polly gets angry. Pinched and peppery worked really well for Louis-Dreyfus on Veep, but Polly’s rage is meant to be a deeper, more elemental threat, one amassed to conceal an ocean of pain and regret. We pick up little of that layered complexity in this performance.
paras.zh: 虽然路易斯-德雷福斯巧妙地说出了几句杀手锏，并且确实痛苦地记录了一些更悲伤的片段，但查宁喜怒无常的庄严却令人非常怀念，尤其是当波莉生气的时候。路易斯-德雷福斯在《副总统》中的紧张和辛辣效果非常好，但波莉的愤怒意味着一种更深层次、更基本的威胁，一种聚集起来掩盖痛苦和遗憾的海洋。我们在这次表演中几乎没有看到分层的复杂性。

paras.en: Harris, on the night I saw him at least, seems lost, failing to find the music in Lyman’s shift from supportive dad to titan indignantly defending his master-of-the-universe life choices. I found myself wondering if Harris was maybe going up on his lines a little; there were sudden breaks in tempo that suggested an actor grasping for the next measure. Perhaps to make up for Louis-Dreyfus’ flimsiness and Harris’ willowy presence, Rabe turns the melodrama knob up too high, churning the play’s second act into a sometimes illegible howl of despair. Janney, such a smooth pro on stage, tries to keep things grounded and in motion, but can’t really find her place in this out-of-sync ensemble.
paras.zh: 至少在我见到他的那天晚上，哈里斯似乎迷失了方向，在莱曼从支持他的父亲转变为愤怒地捍卫他宇宙大师的人生选择的巨人的过程中，他找不到音乐。我发现自己想知道哈里斯是否可能在他的台词上稍微提高了一点；节奏突然中断，表明演员正在抓紧下一步。也许是为了弥补路易斯-德雷福斯的脆弱和哈里斯的柔弱存在，拉贝把情节剧的旋钮调得太高，把该剧的第二幕搅成了有时难以辨认的绝望嚎叫。珍妮在舞台上是一位如此流畅的专业人士，她试图让一切扎根并保持运转，但无法真正在这个不同步的合奏中找到自己的位置。

paras.en: The best acting is done by Stranger Things star Keery, who credibly embodies a young man whose privilege and access have certainly made him cynical, but not yet entirely indecent. He is simply the spoiled, listless baby of a family whom he is too young to have known at their mightiest, before the postlapsarian retreat to the desert, buried child in tow. Keery nails the way that guys of a certain stripe tend to pivot between snark and sensitivity, punctuating real feelings with a joke or a nihilistic provocation. He understands the intended tone of Baitz’s rickety dynasty, the clan’s haughty but not entirely confident put-on that through even this, they — like a noble idea of old America itself — shall endure.
paras.zh: 最好的表演是由《怪奇物语》的主演基里完成的，他可信地体现了一个年轻人的特权和接触，这无疑让他变得愤世嫉俗，但还没有完全不雅。他只是一个被宠坏了、无精打采的孩子，他还太小，无法了解这个家庭在堕落后撤退到沙漠之前，把孩子埋葬在最强大的时期。基里指出了某些类型的人倾向于在尖刻和敏感之间摇摆的方式，用笑话或虚无主义的挑衅来强调真实的感受。他理解拜茨摇摇欲坠的王朝的意图，这个家族傲慢但并不完全自信，即使如此，他们——就像旧美国本身的崇高理念一样——将持续下去。

paras.en: Keery’s best moment comes at the start of act two, when he fizzily delivers a biting monologue about the banalities and anxieties of his existence. One hopes that this welcome clarity and energy will sustain through the rest of the play, but Hickey all too soon lets the tension sag.
paras.zh: 基里的最佳时刻出现在第二幕的开头，当时他气喘吁吁地发表了一段辛辣的独白，讲述了他存在的平庸和焦虑。人们希望这种令人欢迎的清晰度和活力能够贯穿整部剧的其余部分，但希基很快就让紧张气氛缓和下来。

paras.en: The entire back half of Other Desert Cities is meant to build to a grand reveal that bares a stark truth about the Wyeths’ hypocrisy, about the parents’ failure to live public principle in private, or the other way around. That shock is severely dampened by Hickey’s enervating pacing; there is nothing steady about the build here, the line graph of the production instead one of sudden lurches.
paras.zh: 《其他沙漠城市》的整个后半部分旨在打造一个盛大的揭秘，揭露惠氏夫妇的虚伪、父母私下未能遵守公共原则的赤裸裸真相，反之亦然。希基令人疲倦的步伐严重削弱了这种震惊。这里的构建没有什么稳定的，生产的线图而不是突然的倾斜。

paras.en: Only the lovely writing at the very end of the play — when one character in a pool of light reflects, years later, on what all of this led to — delivers a swell of heady emotion. Just about everything else in this expensively populated place is arid, overheated and woefully devoid of life.
paras.zh: 只有剧末可爱的文字——当一个角色在光池中反思多年后这一切所导致的结果——传递出一种令人陶醉的情感。在这个人口稠密的地方，几乎所有其他东西都干旱、过热，而且严重缺乏生命。

paras.en: Producers: Bad Robot Live, ATG Productions, Gavin Kalin Productions
paras.zh: 制作人：Bad Robot Live、ATG Productions、Gavin Kalin Productions

paras.en: Cast: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Ed Harris, Allison Janney, Lily Rabe, Joe Keery
paras.zh: 主演：朱莉娅·路易斯-德瑞弗斯 艾德·哈里斯 艾莉森·珍妮 莉莉·拉贝 乔·基瑞

paras.en: 2 hours and 30 minutes (with intermission)
paras.zh: 2小时30分钟（含中场休息）

articles.title: Nasdaq futures gain as investors buy the dip in the AI trade: Live updates

paras.en: Stock futures rebounded early Monday as traders cautiously dipped a toe back in following last week's rout in shares linked to the artificial intelligence trend.
paras.zh: 继上周与人工智能趋势相关的股票暴跌后，交易员谨慎地回撤，周一早盘股指期货反弹。

paras.en: Nasdaq 100 futures added 1.32%. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures ticked 0.53% higher, or 278 points. S&P 500 futures gained 0.2%.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克100指数期货上涨1.32%。道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 0.53%，即 278 点。标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.2%。

paras.en: Stable oil prices early Sunday also lent the equity market some support.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候稳定的油价也给股市带来了一些支撑。

paras.en: In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 lost 1.65%, while the Topix was down 1.12%. South Korea's Kospi was 1.29% lower, while the small-cap Kosdaq Index fell 0.93%. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was up 0.37%. Mainland China's CSI 300 slid 0.28%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，日本日经225指数下跌1.65%，东证指数下跌1.12%。韩国综合指数下跌 1.29%，小型股科斯达克指数下跌 0.93%。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数上涨 0.37%。中国内地沪深300指数下跌0.28%。

paras.en: The S&P 500 lost nearly 2% last week, its biggest weekly decline since late June. The Nasdaq tumbled 4.5%, snapping a four-week winning streak.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数上周下跌近 2%，为 6 月底以来最大单周跌幅。纳斯达克指数暴跌 4.5%，结束了连续 4 周上涨的势头。

paras.en: Concerns around the health of the AI trade took center stage after CNBC reported, citing sources, that Anthropic's third-quarter revenue totaled $16.8 billion. And while that's up from $11.6 billion in the second quarter, it raised flags among investors about the pace of growth with the AI build-out.
paras.zh: CNBC 援引消息人士的话说，Anthropic 第三季度收入总计 168 亿美元，之后，对人工智能行业健康状况的担忧成为焦点。虽然这一数字高于第二季度的 116 亿美元，但它引起了投资者对人工智能建设增长速度的警惕。

paras.en: Neocloud stock CoreWeave, which uses large amounts of debt to build data centers that it rents out to tech companies, was at the center of those fears. The AI-linked name plummeted 25% last week — its largest one-week drop since November 2025. Investors in the corporate bond market have started to shun CoreWeave, with the company's credit default swaps reaching distress levels.
paras.zh: Neocloud 股票 CoreWeave 是这些担忧的焦点，该公司利用大量债务来建设数据中心并出租给科技公司。这个与人工智能相关的公司上周暴跌 25%，这是自 2025 年 11 月以来最大单周跌幅。公司债券市场的投资者已开始避开 CoreWeave，该公司的信用违约互换达到了困境水平。

paras.en: It's not just CoreWeave whose moves in the credit market are concerning. Goldman Sachs traders noted Friday: "AI Credit Spreads and hyperscalers specifically are at the widest levels of the year. The last time spreads were nearly this high, the underlying equities were 15% lower."
paras.zh: 不仅仅是CoreWeave在信贷市场上的举动令人担忧。高盛交易员周五指出：“人工智能信用利差和超大规模信贷利差尤其处于今年最高水平。上次利差接近如此高时，基础股票下跌了 15%。”

paras.en: "The widening across the complex has forced investors to confront what happens as AI spending growth slows. AI Capex has likely peaked and financing, sustainability, and returns on capital have become the debate rather than the next near term earnings revision," they said. "Pessimism is increasing, market breadth is low, and [Friday] we saw the second highest amount of puts traded (right behind June of this year)."
paras.zh: 他们表示：“随着人工智能支出增长放缓，整个综合体的扩大迫使投资者面对会发生什么。人工智能资本支出可能已经达到顶峰，融资、可持续性和资本回报率已经成为争论的焦点，而不是下一个近期盈利修正。” “悲观情绪正在增加，市场广度较低，[周五]我们看到看跌期权交易量达到第二高（仅次于今年六月）。”

paras.en: Traders were also keeping a wary eye on oil with ship attacks in the Persian Gulf picking up and Ukraine and Russia trading attacks on energy infrastructure. Ukraine hit an oil terminal in St. Petersburg, Russia on Sunday. Longer-dated oil futures have begun to ratchet higher on expectations energy infrastructure disruptions may last well into 2027.
paras.zh: 随着波斯湾船只袭击事件的增多以及乌克兰和俄罗斯对能源基础设施的攻击，交易商也对石油保持警惕。乌克兰周日袭击了俄罗斯圣彼得堡的一个石油码头。由于预期能源基础设施中断可能会持续到 2027 年，较长期的石油期货已开始走高。

paras.en: On Sunday however, Brent and WTI crude futures were both trading a tad lower.
paras.zh: 然而周日，布伦特原油和 WTI 原油期货均小幅走低。

paras.en: A slew of earnings from major companies such as Meta Platforms and Tesla hit the Street this week with optimism those results will stabilize the market.
paras.zh: Meta Platforms 和特斯拉等大公司本周发布了大量财报，乐观地认为这些结果将稳定市场。

articles.title: China's third-quarter economic growth quickens to 4.5% as exports surge, beating estimates

paras.en: China's economic growth accelerated to 4.5% in the third quarter from a year earlier, as robust foreign demand for the country's technological goods largely offset drags from a deepening property slump and sluggish consumer demand.
paras.zh: 第三季度中国经济增速同比加速至4.5%，外国对中国科技产品的强劲需求在很大程度上抵消了房地产市场下滑加剧和消费需求低迷的拖累。

paras.en: Third-quarter growth beat Reuters-polled economists' expectation of a 4.4% expansion, and was also higher than the three-year low of 4.3% in the second quarter.
paras.zh: 第三季度经济增长超出了路透调查经济学家预期的 4.4% 扩张，也高于第二季度 4.3% 的三年低点。

paras.en: "The rebound in September salvaged the lukewarm performance in July and August," said Tianchen Xu, senior economist at Economist Intelligence Unit, attributing the recovery to improved government investment that helped arrest the consistent worsening in fixed asset investment, an "ever-strong" external sector and a weak base. China's monthly trade surplus reached a record high of $133.5 billion.
paras.zh: 经济学人智库高级经济学家徐天辰表示：“9月份的反弹挽救了7月和8月的冷淡表现。”他将复苏归因于政府投资的改善，这有助于遏制固定资产投资的持续恶化、“持续强劲”的对外部门和薄弱的基础。中国月度贸易顺差创历史新高，达到1335亿美元。

paras.en: Momentum from the three forces will likely extend into the fourth quarter, Xu said, forecasting a full-year growth rate of 4.7%.
paras.zh: 徐说，这三种力量的动力可能会延续到第四季度，预计全年增长率为4.7%。

paras.en: The data shows an economy still leaning on factories and overseas buyers while households and private investors hold back, with growth through the first nine months averaging 4.6%, broadly in line with Beijing's official target range of 4.5% to 5%.
paras.zh: 数据显示，经济仍然依赖工厂和海外买家，而家庭和私人投资者则有所抑制，前九个月平均增长率为4.6%，与北京官方设定的4.5%至5%的目标范围大致一致。

paras.en: In September, retail sales eked out a 1.1% growth, exceeding analysts' forecast for 0.6% increase, while industrial output grew 5.5% from a year earlier, in line with the forecast of 5.5% growth. The urban unemployment rate stood at 5.2% in September.
paras.zh: 9月份，零售销售勉强增长1.1%，超出分析师预测的0.6%的增长，而工业产出同比增长5.5%，符合增长5.5%的预测。 9月份城镇失业率为5.2%。

paras.en: For the first nine months this year, fixed asset investment in urban areas declined 7.2% from the same period a year earlier, compared with a 7.3% drop estimated in a Reuters poll. Investment channeled into real estate development deepened declines, falling 20.6% in the January to September period, compared with 19.9% in the first eight months.
paras.zh: 今年前9个月，城镇固定资产投资同比下降7.2%，而路透调查预计下降7.3%。房地产开发投资降幅进一步加深，1-9月下降20.6%，而1-8月份为19.9%。

paras.en: "The prolonged housing slump will continue to limit the spillover from stronger industrial activity to the wider economy," Sheana Yue, senior economist at Oxford Economics, as Chinese households see their wealth stored in property shrink over the years.
paras.zh: 牛津经济研究院高级经济学家谢娜·岳表示：“长期的房地产市场低迷将继续限制工业活动走强对更广泛经济的溢出效应，”因为中国家庭多年来储存在房地产中的财富不断缩水。

paras.en: Yue also dismissed the idea that green shoots have emerged in the property market, as home sales, construction starts, and prices offer little indication that the sector downturn is "bottoming out."
paras.zh: 岳还驳斥了房地产市场已经出现复苏的观点，因为房屋销售、建筑开工和价格几乎没有迹象表明该行业的低迷已经“触底”。

paras.en: Beijing has leaned heavily on exports for growth this year, but that engine faces growing pressure as energy costs surge and its manufacturing and export surge has provoked growing anxiety among trading partners. Meanwhile, other pockets of the economy remain weak, weighed down by feeble consumption and a multiyear property slump.
paras.zh: 北京今年的增长严重依赖出口，但随着能源成本飙升以及制造业和出口激增，这一引擎面临着越来越大的压力，这引发了贸易伙伴日益增长的焦虑。与此同时，受消费疲软和多年房地产低迷的拖累，经济的其他领域仍然疲软。

paras.en: "It is clear that domestic imbalances between supply and demand continue rising," Eswar Prasad, an economics professor at Cornell University, said in an emailed note after the data release on Monday. "The government might become more sanguine and maintain a passive approach, rather than infusing stimulus into the economy in tandem with much-needed reforms," he added.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学经济学教授埃斯瓦尔·普拉萨德在周一数据发布后通过电子邮件发送的报告中表示：“很明显，国内供需失衡继续加剧。”他补充说：“政府可能会变得更加乐观并保持被动态度，而不是在急需的改革的同时向经济注入刺激措施。”

paras.en: Producer prices climbed at their fastest pace in over four years, rising 5% in September, while consumer inflation remains below 1%, reflecting persistent excess capacity and weak demand that are constraining businesses' pricing power. "This potentially leaves firms to absorb more of the cost shock through lower margins rather than higher selling prices," said Yue.
paras.zh: 生产者价格以四年多来最快的速度攀升，9月份上涨了5%，而消费者通胀仍低于1%，反映出产能持续过剩和需求疲软限制了企业的定价能力。 “这可能会让企业通过降低利润而不是提高售价来吸收更多的成本冲击，”岳说。

paras.en: Economists largely expect the People's Bank of China to hold benchmark lending rates unchanged through this year, leaving fiscal measures to do most of the work.
paras.zh: 经济学家普遍预计，中国央行今年将维持基准贷款利率不变，而让财政措施来完成大部分工作。

paras.en: While the decent growth pace may reduce the immediate pressure for Beijing to ramp up stimulus, Yue expects the implementation of already-announced measures to accelerate, supporting investment and activity in the coming quarters.
paras.zh: 虽然良好的增长速度可能会减轻北京加大刺激力度的直接压力，但岳预计已宣布的措施将加速实施，支持未来几个季度的投资和活动。

paras.en: Chinese authorities have stepped up fiscal support in recent weeks, including a package of targeted rate cuts and mortgage subsidies in late September. Earlier this month, it also allocated 550 billion yuan of unused debt quota to help ease local government financial strains and bolster infrastructure spending.
paras.zh: 中国当局最近几周加大了财政支持力度，包括 9 月底推出的一系列定向降息和抵押贷款补贴。本月早些时候，中国还分配了5500亿元未使用的债务额度，以帮助缓解地方政府财政压力并支持基础设施支出。

paras.en: Correction: This story has been revised to reflect that quarterly GDP growth was 4.5%.
paras.zh: 更正：本文经过修改，以反映季度 GDP 增长率为 4.5%。

articles.title: India’s Finance Minister says easy exits and excess liquidity fuel equity market's underperformance

paras.en: Excess liquidity in India's equity market has contributed to underperformance and may continue to do so, according to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.
paras.zh: 印度财政部长尼尔马拉·西塔拉曼 (Nirmala Sitharaman) 表示，印度股市的流动性过剩导致了业绩不佳，而且这种情况可能会继续下去。

paras.en: "Because of the ease of liquidity, ease of availability, people are even exiting easily" from equities, Sitharaman told CNBC in an exclusive interview on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok on Friday. However, the fundamentals of the Indian economy are "fine," she said.
paras.zh: 西塔拉曼周五在曼谷举行的国际货币基金组织与世界银行会议间隙接受 CNBC 独家采访时表示，“由于流动性和可用性的便利性，人们甚至可以轻松地退出股市”。不过，她表示，印度经济的基本面“良好”。

paras.en: Since January, India's key benchmark indexes have slipped nearly 12%, as per LSEG data, even though the country's economic growth has been resilient amid trade uncertainty and geopolitical shocks. India has been hit with record outflows by foreign investors from its equity markets, and Sitharaman said that continued capital outflows are one of the biggest risks for India in 2027.
paras.zh: 根据 LSEG 的数据，自 1 月份以来，印度的主要基准指数已下跌近 12%，尽管该国的经济增长在贸易不确定性和地缘政治冲击的情况下一直保持弹性。印度遭受了创纪录的外国投资者从其股市流出的打击，西塔拉曼表示，持续的资本外流是印度 2027 年面临的最大风险之一。

paras.en: Still, domestic capital continues to flood the market. Indian equity mutual funds have recorded net inflows every month since March 2021, according to data released by industry body Association of Mutual Funds in India earlier this month.
paras.zh: Still, domestic capital continues to flood the market.印度行业机构互惠基金协会本月早些时候发布的数据显示，自 2021 年 3 月以来，印度股票互惠基金每月都录得净流入。

paras.en: Multinational companies, private equity funds and foreign investors have been able to make partial or full exits from their investments at a premium. Between 2021 and 2025, Indian initial public offerings collectively raised $60.4 billion, of which "a staggering" $37.7 billion, or 63% of total proceeds, went to existing holders who sold their shares to the public, an EY report in August said.
paras.zh: 跨国公司、私募股权基金和外国投资者已经能够以溢价部分或全部退出其投资。安永 8 月份的一份报告称，2021 年至 2025 年间，印度首次公开募股总共筹集了 604 亿美元，其中“惊人的”377 亿美元（占总收益的 63%）流向了向公众出售股票的现有持有人。

paras.en: Foreign portfolio investors have sold direct Indian equities of over $33 billion so far this year, as per Indian depository firm NSDL. India has gained a reputation as an anti-artificial intelligence trade, while markets like Taiwan and Korea, with AI champions, have attracted strong investment flows.
paras.zh: 根据印度存款公司 NSDL 的数据，今年迄今为止，外国投资组合投资者已直接出售了超过 330 亿美元的印度股票。印度赢得了反人工智能贸易的声誉，而拥有人工智能冠军的台湾和韩国等市场则吸引了强劲的投资流。

paras.en: The flight of capital toward AI and the U.S., which otherwise moves toward different countries for different sectoral investments, is "a concern," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，资本流向人工智能和美国，否则资本会流向不同国家进行不同部门的投资，这是“一个令人担忧的问题”。

paras.en: Taiwan now has the largest market weighting in the MSCI Asia Pacific ex-Japan index at 29%, while Korea has moved into second place at 22%, as per a report by Goldman Sachs on Oct. 8. India's share has compressed from 19% a few years ago to 10%, it added.
paras.zh: 高盛10月8日的报告显示，台湾目前在MSCI亚太（日本除外）指数中的市场权重最大，为29%，而韩国则以22%跃居第二。印度的份额已从几年前的19%压缩至10%。

paras.en: But with the global AI rally showing cracks, Sitharaman said India wouldn't be "hurt" from any spillover if the bubble burst. India has not received the "AI kind of investments coming into different jurisdictions," she said.
paras.zh: 但随着全球人工智能涨势出现裂痕，西塔拉曼表示，如果泡沫破裂，印度不会受到任何溢出效应的“伤害”。她说，印度尚未收到“不同司法管辖区的人工智能投资”。

paras.en: Sitharaman, who is India's longest-serving finance minister to hold the office continuously, added that the South Asian country was "no longer a laggard" in the frontier tech space and investment was being made to set up semiconductor manufacturing.
paras.zh: 西塔拉曼是印度连续任职时间最长的财政部长，他补充说，这个南亚国家在前沿科技领域“不再落后”，并且正在投资建立半导体制造。

articles.title: Anthropic’s AI worm research raises new fears about smart device security

paras.en: Everything is a computer these days. Fridges, washing machines, televisions, and more are now outfitted with computer chips to give them new capabilities, and manufacturers called them “smart” even before ChatGPT came out. Now, though, researchers have strung 15 cheap TV boxes together to run an artificial intelligence model, raising the possibility that the computers inside these everyday gadgets could someday help spread autonomous, AI-powered malware.
paras.zh: 如今一切都是电脑。冰箱、洗衣机、电视等现在都配备了计算机芯片，赋予它们新的功能，甚至在 ChatGPT 出现之前，制造商就称它们为“智能”。不过现在，研究人员已经将 15 个廉价电视盒串在一起来运行人工智能模型，这提高了这些日常设备中的计算机有一天可能帮助传播由人工智能驱动的自主恶意软件的可能性。

paras.en: On Monday Anthropic released a blog post exploring this sort of attack. Researchers at the company tested how AI models might act as computer worms, programs that move between devices and leave copies of themselves behind, among everyday household gadgets. A worm that runs on smart devices instead of relying on a data center could prove difficult to shut down. Anthropic’s experiments suggest how that might happen—though they stop short of demonstrating the full threat.
paras.zh: 周一，Anthropic 发布了一篇博文探讨此类攻击。该公司的研究人员测试了人工智能模型如何充当计算机蠕虫，即在设备之间移动并在日常家用小工具中留下自身副本的程序。在智能设备上运行而不是依赖数据中心的蠕虫可能很难被关闭。 Anthropic 的实验表明了这种情况是如何发生的——尽管他们没有展示出完整的威胁。

paras.en: Typically, large language models (LLMs) are trained and run in data centers, which can contain hundreds of thousands of specialized chips called graphics processing units, or GPUs. “Just because you don’t have a big GPU doesn’t mean that you can’t be a host to one of these models,” says Jeffrey Ladish, founder and executive director of Palisade Research, a California-based AI safety nonprofit that studies the risk of AI systems slipping beyond human control, past malware to rogue behavior.
paras.zh: 通常，大型语言模型 (LLM) 在数据中心进行训练和运行，数据中心可能包含数十万个称为图形处理单元或 GPU 的专用芯片。 Palisade Research 的创始人兼执行董事杰弗里·拉迪什 (Jeffrey Ladish) 表示：“仅仅因为你没有大型 GPU，并不意味着你不能成为这些模型之一。”Palisade Research 是一家总部位于加利福尼亚州的人工智能安全非营利组织，主要研究人工智能系统脱离人类控制、从恶意软件到流氓行为的风险。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: In recent months, researchers have experimented with various types of computer worms, stapling AI models onto them to make them adaptive and harder to kill. Here, though, the researchers explored whether an AI model itself could be distributed as the worm, spreading its weights to new devices and running across even weak chips.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，研究人员对各种类型的计算机蠕虫进行了实验，将人工智能模型固定在它们身上，使它们具有适应性并且更难以杀死。不过，在这里，研究人员探索了人工智能模型本身是否可以作为蠕虫进行分发，将其权重分散到新设备上，甚至可以在较弱的芯片上运行。

paras.en: "Anybody with an open-weight model, with the right prompts and by brute-force luck, can find these worms," says computer scientist Vyas Sekar.
paras.zh: 计算机科学家维亚斯·塞卡 (Vyas Sekar) 表示：“任何拥有开放权重模型的人，只要有正确的提示，并凭借蛮力运气，就可以找到这些蠕虫。”

paras.en: Specifically, researchers working on Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team showed two key capabilities. First, they were able to split up a relatively small model—one from Google DeepMind’s open-weight Gemma line—across 15 TV boxes they had bought and networked themselves so that they could run the entire model by chaining these boxes together. Each individual box was too weak to run the model on its own. But LLMs can be split into layers, an arrangement in which each layer manipulates the data it receives and passes that revised data to the next layer. By giving each box the job of handling just a couple of these layers, the team was able to run Gemma entirely and get responses back from just the weak chips in these boxes.
paras.zh: 具体来说，Anthropic 前沿红队的研究人员展示了两项关键能力。首先，他们能够将一个相对较小的模型（来自 Google DeepMind 的开放式 Gemma 系列）拆分到他们购买的 15 个电视盒上，并自行联网，这样他们就可以通过将这些电视盒链接在一起来运行整个模型。每个单独的盒子都太弱，无法单独运行模型。但法学硕士可以分为几层，每层都处理它接收到的数据，并将修改后的数据传递到下一层。通过让每个盒子只处理几个这样的层，团队能够完全运行 Gemma 并仅从这些盒子中的薄弱芯片中获取响应。

paras.en: After that, the researchers tested how an AI worm might spread across devices in a virtual sandbox. A larger model—from the Chinese start-up Z.ai—managed to get a smaller model—one of Meta’s Llama models—running on the targets. But the larger model was too large to run on those weak devices itself, and it still relied on a separate server. This means the team did not show an AI worm capable of spreading and running itself on such devices. Anthropic argues that as small models become more capable, one could eventually use both methods.
paras.zh: 之后，研究人员测试了人工智能蠕虫如何在虚拟沙箱中跨设备传播。中国初创公司 Z.ai 的一个较大模型成功地在目标上运行了一个较小的模型（Meta 的 Llama 模型之一）。但较大的模型太大，无法在那些弱设备本身上运行，而且它仍然依赖于单独的服务器。这意味着该团队没有展示出能够在此类设备上传播和运行的人工智能蠕虫。 Anthropic 认为，随着小型模型变得更加强大，人们最终可以同时使用这两种方法。

paras.en: The research also raises the prospect of adaptation and improvement by suggesting that AI models could subsist on low-power devices and drift through the Internet, getting better at spreading as they go. Anthropic makes this clear in its blog post about the work, concluding that AI systems could soon be “passing on their adaptations to future copies of themselves.”
paras.zh: 该研究还提出，人工智能模型可以在低功耗设备上生存并在互联网上漂移，从而更好地传播，从而提出了适应和改进的前景。 Anthropic 在其有关这项工作的博客文章中明确指出了这一点，并得出结论，人工智能系统可能很快就会“将其适应能力传递给未来的自身副本”。

paras.en: Ladish believes the main lesson from the research is in how AI models could divvy up work across computers of all shapes and sizes. “Basically, compute is a resource that these models can use,” he says, pointing to everything from Apple MacBooks to data centers to everyday objects like smart TVs as possible sources of computing power if attackers can hack them.
paras.zh: 拉迪什认为，这项研究的主要教训是人工智能模型如何在各种形状和大小的计算机上分配工作。他说：“基本上，计算是这些模型可以使用的资源。”他指出，从苹果 MacBook 到数据中心，再到智能电视等日常用品，如果攻击者能够破解它们，它们都可能成为计算能力的来源。

paras.en: Not everyone thinks that the experiments amount to a new kind of threat, however. “I think there’s some caution that’s needed here to make sure we talk about what capabilities are new and transformative,” says Michael Bailey, a professor studying computer systems security at the Georgia Institute of Technology. He emphasizes avoiding “fearmongering” with the lessons taken away from this kind of work. Researchers already know how insecure devices like TV boxes can be. “We already had self-replicating malware,” says Bailey. “We had botnets.”
paras.zh: 然而，并不是所有人都认为这些实验构成了一种新的威胁。佐治亚理工学院研究计算机系统安全的教授迈克尔·贝利 (Michael Bailey) 表示：“我认为这里需要谨慎一些，以确保我们谈论哪些功能是新的和变革性的。”他强调要避免利用从此类工作中汲取的教训来“散布恐惧”。研究人员已经知道电视盒等设备有多不安全。 “我们已经有了自我复制的恶意软件，”贝利说。 “我们有僵尸网络。”

paras.en: “All of these are classical computer security threats,” adds Vyas Sekar, a professor of computer engineering at Carnegie Mellon University. According to Sekar, the bigger problem is that more people might be able to launch such attacks—a “democratization of being evil,” as he calls it. Sekar thinks this makes monitoring and restricting data flow between smart devices even more important.
paras.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学计算机工程教授 Vyas Sekar 补充道：“所有这些都是典型的计算机安全威胁。”塞卡认为，更大的问题是更多的人可能能够发起此类攻击——他称之为“邪恶的民主化”。 Sekar 认为这使得监控和限制智能设备之间的数据流变得更加重要。

paras.en: Even the risk of hijacking raw computing power on chips is not new. Hackers have long taken over other people’s computers to mine cryptocurrency. So while smart devices could face new attacks of the kind Anthropic describes, the underlying weakness is an old one: plenty of our gadgets are already easy to commandeer.
paras.zh: 甚至劫持芯片上的原始计算能力的风险也不是新鲜事。黑客长期以来一直接管其他人的计算机来挖掘加密货币。因此，虽然智能设备可能面临人类所描述的那种新的攻击，但潜在的弱点是一个古老的弱点：我们的许多小工具已经很容易被征用。

articles.title: Everything you need to know about flu season 2026

paras.en: The beginning of fall and back-to-school time means cold virus season has arrived. Usually, colds hit as lesser-evil infections before influenza season takes over. But already, the flu is popping up early in pockets of the U.S. Here’s why that might be and everything else you need to know as we head into the dreaded annual flu season.
paras.zh: 秋天的开始和返校时间意味着感冒病毒季节已经到来。通常，在流感季节到来之前，感冒是危害较小的感染。但流感已经在美国部分地区提前出现。这就是为什么会出现这种情况，以及在我们进入可怕的年度流感季节时您需要了解的所有其他信息。

paras.en: According to the Centers of Disease Control and Prevention’s latest FluView report, released on October 9, flu activity has been climbing since early September. Flu season in the U.S. generally begins gaining momentum in the fall, with activity peaking between December and February. But surveillance indicators show that certain strains of influenza are rising fast. The CDC’s latest data show a nationwide percent positivity rate for influenza—the percentage of all positive influenza tests—of 3.6 percent. That’s a sixfold increase compared with this time in 2025, when the rate was 0.6 percent.
paras.zh: 根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 10 月 9 日发布的最新 FluView 报告，自 9 月初以来，流感活动一直在攀升。美国的流感季节通常在秋季开始增强，并在 12 月至 2 月之间达到高峰。但监测指标显示，某些流感病毒株正在迅速上升。 CDC 的最新数据显示，全国范围内的流感阳性率（所有流感检测呈阳性的百分比）为 3.6%。与 2025 年同期的 0.6% 相比，这一数字增加了六倍。

paras.en: Parts of the U.S. are showing much higher positive rates. The CDC splits the country up into regions, and Region 9, which includes Arizona, California, Hawaii and Nevada, had 9.5 percent positivity, according to the latest data. Experts say that is exceptionally high for this time of year.
paras.zh: 美国部分地区的阳性率要高得多。 CDC 将全国分为多个区域，根据最新数据，第 9 区（包括亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、夏威夷州和内华达州）的阳性率为 9.5%。专家表示，这一数字在每年的这个时候都非常高。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “It’s not unheard of to see things rising at this stage,” says Andrew Pekosz, an immunologist at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. “But it’s also something that we probably shouldn’t be seeing until maybe November or December at the earliest.”
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学布隆伯格公共卫生学院的免疫学家安德鲁·佩科斯 (Andrew Pekosz) 表示：“现阶段情况上升的情况并非闻所未闻。” “但这也是我们最早可能要到 11 月或 12 月才能看到的事情。”

paras.en: Flu can be caused by different types of influenza, including influenza A (and its subtypes) and influenza B. Usually, flu season brings a mix of types. Right now, in the areas of the country with the highest positivity rates, H1N1, a subtype of influenza A, is dominant. According to the CDC, the most recent weekly testing data showed that 98.4 percent of the positive tests indicated H1N1 and that 1.6 percent revealed H3N2, another influenza A subtype.
paras.zh: 流感可由不同类型的流感引起，包括甲型流感（及其亚型）和乙型流感。通常，流感季节会出现多种类型的流感。目前，在全国阳性率最高的地区，甲型H1N1流感（甲型流感亚型）占主导地位。据 CDC 称，最近的每周检测数据显示，98.4% 的阳性检测结果显示 H1N1 流感，1.6% 的阳性检测结果显示另一种甲型流感亚型 H3N2。

paras.en: Still, experts say it’s too early to predict whether these spikes could signal a particularly severe winter flu season.
paras.zh: 不过，专家表示，现在预测这些激增是否预示着特别严重的冬季流感季节还为时过早。

paras.en: Will this year’s flu vaccines work well?
paras.zh: 今年的流感疫苗效果好吗？

paras.en: One of the best ways to protect yourself from the flu is to get a flu vaccine. Every year experts reformulate these vaccines depending on what strains of the virus are circulating or predicted to circulate during the coming winter season.
paras.zh: 保护自己免受流感侵害的最佳方法之一是接种流感疫苗。每年，专家都会根据即将到来的冬季正在传播或预计将传播的病毒株来重新配制这些疫苗。

paras.en: Whichever subtype dominates matters because it can help predict which groups will experience the greatest disease burden. It can also determine how well existing immunity will protect people, as well as how the year’s flu vaccines will perform.
paras.zh: 无论哪种亚型占主导地位都很重要，因为它可以帮助预测哪些群体将承受最大的疾病负担。它还可以确定现有免疫力对人们的保护效果如何，以及今年的流感疫苗的效果如何。

paras.en: H1N1 and H3N2 are both influenza A subtypes, but they are evolutionarily distinct and can affect people differently. H3N2-dominant seasons have historically been associated with particularly severe illness among older adults. H1N1, on the other hand, has had a greater effect on younger populations—but both can cause serious disease at any age.
paras.zh: H1N1 和 H3N2 都是甲型流感亚型，但它们在进化上不同，对人的影响也不同。历史上，H3N2 主导季节与老年人中特别严重的疾病有关。另一方面，H1N1 流感对年轻人的影响更大，但两者都可能在任何年龄段引起严重疾病。

paras.en: “The version [of H1N1] that’s circulating seems to be a little bit different from the vaccine strain that we have and from H1N1 strains that have circulated before. It’s what we call an antigenic drift,” Pekosz says. That could be why the virus is emerging so early, he adds. If it can evade prior immunity, the pathogen will be easier to transmit.
paras.zh: “正在流行的 H1N1 病毒版本似乎与我们现有的疫苗毒株以及之前流行的 H1N1 毒株略有不同。这就是我们所说的抗原漂移，”佩科斯说。他补充道，这可能就是该病毒如此早出现的原因。如果能够逃避事先的免疫，病原体就会更容易传播。

paras.en: But it’s still too early to know how that might influence the effectiveness of the current flu vaccines.
paras.zh: 但现在了解这可能如何影响当前流感疫苗的有效性还为时过早。

paras.en: When is the best time to get vaccinated?
paras.zh: 什么时候是接种疫苗的最佳时间？

paras.en: Trish Perl, a professor of internal medicine and a specialist in infectious disease at UT Southwestern Medical Center, says that right now is the best time to get a flu shot.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学西南医学中心内科教授兼传染病专家 Trish Perl 表示，现在是注射流感疫苗的最佳时机。

paras.en: “Immunity from the flu vaccine is strongest for about four to six months, and we usually expect flu to peak in December or January,” Pekosz says. “So a September or October vaccination will get you through the worst part of the flu season.”
paras.zh: “流感疫苗的免疫力在大约四到六个月内最强，我们通常预计流感在 12 月或 1 月达到高峰，”佩科斯说。 “因此，九月或十月的疫苗接种将帮助您度过流感季节最糟糕的时期。”

paras.en: Perl agrees—she says that she often tells her people to, at the very least, get a flu vaccine before Thanksgiving. Because after that, she says, people have unlimited excuses for why they can’t find the time.
paras.zh: 珀尔对此表示同意，她说她经常告诉她的人们至少在感恩节前接种流感疫苗。她说，因为在那之后，人们就会有无数的借口来解释为什么他们找不到时间。

paras.en: And with certain areas already seeing spikes, getting the shot earlier than usual may be best, Pekosz adds.
paras.zh: 佩科斯补充道，由于某些地区已经出现高峰，因此比平常更早进行注射可能是最好的选择。

paras.en: “The best time to get vaccinated is before you see influenza in your area,” he says.
paras.zh: “接种疫苗的最佳时间是在您所在地区出现流感之前，”他说。

paras.en: What about the newly approved mRNA vaccine for flu?
paras.zh: 新批准的流感 mRNA 疫苗怎么样？

paras.en: On August 5, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved Moderna’s mFLUSIVA, the first mRNA seasonal influenza vaccine, for adults aged 50 and older. In a phase 3 clinical trial, the vaccine was found to be 26.6 percent more effective at preventing the flu than a standard flu shot.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月 5 日，美国食品和药物管理局批准了 Moderna 的 mFLUSIVA，这是第一个针对 50 岁及以上成年人的 mRNA 季节性流感疫苗。在一项 3 期临床试验中，发现该疫苗预防流感的效果比标准流感疫苗高 26.6%。

paras.en: FDA approval and inclusion in federal vaccination recommendations—informed by guidance by the CDC’s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP)—are separate regulatory steps, however. The disruption to ACIP under the Trump administration has made incorporating newly approved vaccines into guidance more complicated.
paras.zh: 然而，FDA 的批准和纳入联邦疫苗接种建议（根据 CDC 免疫实践咨询委员会 (ACIP) 的指导）是单独的监管步骤。特朗普政府对 ACIP 的破坏使得将新批准的疫苗纳入指导变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Moderna had said the vaccine would be available at select retailers during the 2026–2027 flu season. But so far, access appears to be limited.
paras.zh: Moderna 曾表示，该疫苗将在 2026 年至 2027 年流感季节期间在部分零售商处出售。但到目前为止，访问似乎受到限制。

paras.en: Experts, including Pekosz and Perl, say that if people who qualify for the new mRNA vaccine have access to it, they should consider it. “The data would suggest that if you can get the mRNA vaccine, you probably will get a stronger response to most of the components in the vaccine than if you get the standard one. But again, the standard one is pretty good as well,” Pekosz says.
paras.zh: Pekosz 和 Perl 等专家表示，如果有资格获得新 mRNA 疫苗的人能够获得这种疫苗，他们应该考虑它。 “数据表明，如果你能获得 mRNA 疫苗，你可能会对疫苗中的大多数成分产生比标准疫苗更强的反应。但同样，标准疫苗也相当不错，”Pekosz 说。

paras.en: He and Perl are optimistic about the potential of mRNA technology to improve flu vaccines in the future. Because mRNA vaccines can be developed and manufactured more quickly than traditional shots, scientists could wait until later in the year before selecting which influenza strains to target. That added time could help us better predict which strains will circulate during flu season—ultimately meaning more effective vaccines.
paras.zh: 他和 Perl 对 mRNA 技术未来改进流感疫苗的潜力持乐观态度。由于 mRNA 疫苗的开发和生产速度比传统疫苗更快，因此科学家可以等到今年晚些时候再选择针对哪些流感病毒株。增加的时间可以帮助我们更好地预测哪些毒株将在流感季节传播——最终意味着更有效的疫苗。

paras.en: The best thing anyone can do right now is to get their flu shot as soon as possible. And if you do end up getting sick, Perl says not to forget about antivirals, such as Tamiflu, which can be very effective and, in many cases, could reduce the amount of time you are infectious.
paras.zh: 任何人现在能做的最好的事情就是尽快接种流感疫苗。珀尔说，如果你最终生病了，不要忘记抗病毒药物，例如达菲，它非常有效，并且在许多情况下可以减少你感染的时间。

articles.title: Here’s what scientists think about Theranos a decade after it imploded

paras.en: Around a decade ago Theranos, one of the buzziest science start-ups ever, imploded. Swamped by allegations of fraud, the actions of the company and its enigmatic CEO, Elizabeth Holmes, shone a harsh light on problems with scientific start-ups. Now scientists say these issues have only gotten worse.
paras.zh: 大约十年前，有史以来最热闹的科学初创企业之一希拉洛斯 (Theranos) 崩溃了。该公司及其神秘的首席执行官伊丽莎白·霍姆斯（Elizabeth Holmes）充斥着欺诈指控，其行为使科学初创企业的问题暴露无遗。现在科学家表示这些问题只会变得更糟。

paras.en: In a new documentary titled You Can See Everything, filmmaker Nathan Fielder follows Holmes in the lead-up to starting a prison sentence in May 2023, after she was found guilty of fraud.
paras.zh: 在一部名为《你可以看到一切》的新纪录片中，电影制片人内森·菲尔德 (Nathan Fielder) 追踪 Holmes 在被判犯有欺诈罪后于 2023 年 5 月开始入狱的过程。

paras.en: The film retraces the saga of Theranos, which claimed to have a machine that could perform hundreds of clinical tests using a single drop of blood. After years of fundraising, high-publicity support and partnerships with pharmacies to make the tests accessible, scientists and journalists revealed in 2015 that Theranos’s claims were false: there was no scientific evidence that its product worked.
paras.zh: 这部电影回顾了希拉洛斯的传奇故事，该公司声称拥有一台可以使用一滴血进行数百项临床测试的机器。经过多年的筹款、高调宣传支持以及与药店的合作以实现测试的可及性，科学家和记者在 2015 年揭露 Theranos 的说法是错误的：没有科学证据表明其产品有效。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Theranos is, in many ways, a cautionary tale and a relic of 2010s Silicon Valley. But for scientists, Theranos’s problems are anything but history.
paras.zh: 从很多方面来说，Theranos 都是一个警示故事，也是 2010 年代硅谷的遗迹。但对于科学家来说，希拉洛斯的问题绝非历史。

paras.en: John Ioannidis is a professor at Stanford University’s medical school and was among the first to question Theranos’s bona fides in a 2015 article. Eleven years later Ioannidis says he worries the problems of transparency and a lack of strong evidence in science and technology start-ups are, if anything, worse today.
paras.zh: 约翰·约安尼迪斯 (John Ioannidis) 是斯坦福大学医学院的教授，他是最早在 2015 年发表的一篇文章中质疑希拉洛斯善意的人之一。十一年后，约安尼迪斯表示，他担心科技初创企业的透明度和缺乏有力证据的问题在今天变得更糟。

paras.en: “I feel kind of uneasy about this being presented as a sensationalist, movie-quality story [about] a single bad apple because I see very similar phenotypes to Theranos,” Ioannidis says.
paras.zh: “我对这个故事被呈现为一个关于一个坏苹果的耸人听闻的电影级故事感到有点不安，因为我看到了与希拉洛斯非常相似的表型，”约安尼迪斯说。

paras.en: Ioannidis argues that, in some ways, claims of scientific progress are a public relations game. As private companies have become increasingly powerful agents in driving research forward, the trend has shifted fields away from more traditional, publicly funded research and academia.
paras.zh: 约安尼迪斯认为，在某些方面，声称科学进步是一种公共关系游戏。随着私营公司成为推动研究发展的越来越强大的推动者，这一趋势已经将领域从更传统的、公共资助的研究和学术界转移开。

paras.en: “Holmes is in jail, but the recipe of her success has been even more widely adopted,” he says.
paras.zh: “福尔摩斯入狱了，但她的成功秘诀却被更广泛地采用，”他说。

paras.en: Ian Papautsky, a microfluidics researcher at the University of Illinois Chicago, says that Theranos’s public downfall and time in the spotlight create a strong case for validating scientific findings. But he, too, worries that, as start-ups and private companies increasingly drive discovery, opportunities for secrecy or fraud may grow.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的微流体研究员伊恩·帕帕茨基 (Ian Papautsky) 表示，Theranos 的公众失败和备受关注的时间为验证科学发现提供了强有力的理由。但他也担心，随着初创企业和私营公司越来越多地推动发现，保密或欺诈的机会可能会增加。

paras.en: “Many of the start-ups are not transparent in their technology development,” he says. “On the one hand, you would argue that they have to be, because they’re trying to compete with everyone else. But that also makes it a lot easier to hide the mismanagement and all these other various issues.”
paras.zh: “许多初创企业的技术开发并不透明，”他说。 “一方面，你会说他们必须这样做，因为他们试图与其他人竞争。但这也使得隐藏管理不善和所有其他各种问题变得容易得多。”

paras.en: Holmes’s husband, Billy Evans, who also appears in the documentary, is himself quietly building a new blood testing company. The start-up, called Haemanthus, plans to use artificial intelligence tools to run diagnostic tests. Holmes is listed as a scientific adviser to the company, and Evans has raised millions of dollars in funding, according to NPR.
paras.zh: 福尔摩斯的丈夫比利·埃文斯（Billy Evans）也在纪录片中出现，他本人正在悄悄建立一家新的血液检测公司。这家名为 Haemanthus 的初创公司计划使用人工智能工具进行诊断测试。据 NPR 报道，霍姆斯被列为该公司的科学顾问，埃文斯已筹集了数百万美元的资金。

paras.en: “The idea is to put the band back together and do it all again,” Evans tells Fielder in the movie.
paras.zh: “我们的想法是让乐队重新组合起来，然后再做一遍，”埃文斯在电影中告诉菲尔德。

paras.en: Theranos has made it harder for academics who study blood testing or microfluidics to get funding, says Umut Gurkan, a biotechnology researcher at Case Western Reserve University. He creates blood testing products for conditions such as sickle cell anemia. Gurkan remembers going to Silicon Valley in 2015 to seek funding and being told, “We don’t invest in diagnostics anymore.”
paras.zh: 凯斯西储大学生物技术研究员乌穆特·古尔坎 (Umut Gurkan) 表示，希拉洛斯让研究血液检测或微流体的学者更难获得资金。他创造了针对镰状细胞性贫血等疾病的血液检测产品。 Gurkan 记得 2015 年前往硅谷寻求资金，并被告知“我们不再投资诊断技术”。

paras.en: Even as diagnostic technology has advanced, it remains difficult to bring it into markets, he says.
paras.zh: 他说，尽管诊断技术已经进步，但将其推向市场仍然很困难。

paras.en: “Trust in science is fragile, and ‘a drop of blood’ now sounds like a scam,” Gurkan says. “Honest companies trying to save lives pay that tax. And at the end of the day, patients and real people pay the price with lack of working diagnostics and technologies that deserve to be in the market.”
paras.zh: “对科学的信任是脆弱的，‘一滴血’现在听起来像是一个骗局，”古尔坎说。 “试图拯救生命的诚实公司缴纳了这笔税。最终，患者和现实中的人们因缺乏值得进入市场的有效诊断和技术而付出了代价。”

paras.en: As for Theranos’s claims: even after more than 10 years of advancement in clinical testing and microfluidics, its premise remains impossible, the researchers consulted for this article say—at least at the scale that Holmes promised. A drop of blood doesn’t hold nearly enough biological information to conduct the hundreds of tests that Theranos claimed.
paras.zh: 至于 Theranos 的说法：本文咨询的研究人员表示，即使在临床测试和微流体技术方面取得了十多年的进步，其前提仍然是不可能的——至少在霍姆斯承诺的规模上是不可能的。一滴血并不能容纳足够的生物信息来进行希拉洛斯声称的数百项测试。

paras.en: Theranos’s mission was noble, Papautsky says, but the science did not and does not hold up.
paras.zh: 帕帕茨基说，希拉洛斯的使命是崇高的，但科学过去和现在都站不住脚。

paras.en: “Doing multiplex testing on a small volume of blood is a good concept—it would be an important advancement in technology,” he says. “But having experts with the right knowledge and good management is very important, and it’s becoming more and more important these days. Expertise is not necessarily being valued as it used to be.”
paras.zh: “对少量血液进行多重检测是一个很好的概念，这将是技术的一个重要进步，”他说。 “但是拥有拥有正确知识和良好管理的专家非常重要，而且现在变得越来越重要。专业知识不一定像以前那样受到重视。”

articles.title: Scarred blood vessels may be one clue to APOE4’s Alzheimer’s risk
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: The gene APOE4 is the strongest common genetic risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease. But it’s still something of a mystery to researchers.
paras.zh: APOE4 基因是阿尔茨海默病最常见的遗传风险因素。但这对研究人员来说仍然是一个谜。

paras.en: Now, new work suggests one way the gene variant does its dirty work. It influences the production of scar tissue throughout vital vascular connections carrying blood to and from the brain, researchers report September 24 in Cell. This process may also contribute to the buildup of the protein amyloid-beta, which is thought to be one of the first signs of Alzheimer’s disease in the brain.
paras.zh: 现在，新的研究提出了基因变体进行肮脏工作的一种方式。研究人员于 9 月 24 日在《细胞》杂志上报道，它会影响将血液输送到大脑和从大脑输送血液的重要血管连接中疤痕组织的产生。这一过程也可能有助于β淀粉样蛋白的形成，这被认为是大脑中阿尔茨海默病的最初迹象之一。

paras.en: APOE4 is an allele, one of three slightly different, common forms of the APOE gene, which makes a protein that helps carry fats in the bloodstream. The variant is common among people who have Alzheimer’s disease. “If you had a room of 10 people with Alzheimer’s disease, and you asked how many of those people have the APOE4 allele, six of them would,” says neuroscientist Joel Blanchard of the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York City. Yet many people who carry APOE4 never develop the dementia-causing disease, leaving researchers trying to understand what the gene variant actually does to make the brain more vulnerable.
paras.zh: APOE4 是一种等位基因，是 APOE 基因的三种略有不同的常见形式之一，它产生一种有助于在血液中携带脂肪的蛋白质。这种变异在阿尔茨海默病患者中很常见。纽约市西奈山伊坎医学院的神经科学家乔尔·布兰查德 (Joel Blanchard) 表示：“如果房间里有 10 名患有阿尔茨海默氏症的人，你问其中有多少人携带 APOE4 等位基因，答案是其中有 6 人会携带。”然而，许多携带 APOE4 的人从未患上导致痴呆的疾病，这使得研究人员试图了解该基因变异实际上是如何使大脑更脆弱的。

paras.en: One clue came from people who seemed unusually resilient to that risk. In 2024, researchers examined more than 3,500 people, including some who carried two copies of APOE4 but had not developed Alzheimer’s. Genetic analysis showed that they had a mutation in their DNA that meant their blood vessels had far lower levels of a protein called fibronectin, a kind of cellular superglue that assists wound healing. The reserachers suggested that too much fibronectin could make it harder for the brain to clear amyloid-beta from the brain. A buildup of those plaques is a hallmark of the disease.
paras.zh: 一条线索来自那些似乎对这种风险异常有抵抗力的人。 2024 年，研究人员对 3,500 多人进行了检查，其中包括一些携带两个 APOE4 拷贝但并未患上阿尔茨海默病的人。基因分析显示，他们的 DNA 发生了突变，这意味着他们的血管中一种名为纤连蛋白的蛋白质的水平要低得多，纤连蛋白是一种有助于伤口愈合的细胞强力胶。研究人员认为，过多的纤连蛋白可能会使大脑更难清除大脑中的β淀粉样蛋白。这些斑块的堆积是该疾病的标志。

paras.en: That result pushed Blanchard and his colleagues to look more closely at blood vessels. “The prevailing thought in the field is basically that the Alzheimer’s disease is so bad that the blood vessels break down,” Blanchard says. ”But we wanted to ask the question: Is it the other way around?”
paras.zh: 这一结果促使布兰查德和他的同事更加仔细地研究血管。布兰查德说：“该领域普遍认为，阿尔茨海默病非常严重，以至于血管会破裂。” “但我们想问一个问题：情况是否相反？”

paras.en: Blanchard and his colleagues built an atlas that mapped gene expression — how DNA is read and converted into proteins — across the human brain vasculature at a cellular level. Stitching together data from three existing brainwide maps, their atlas represented 66,000 cells from 220 people. They team examined how this map differed in people with two copies of APOE4 compared with those with less harmful gene variants.
paras.zh: 布兰查德和他的同事建立了一个图谱，在细胞水平上绘制了人类大脑脉管系统的基因表达——DNA如何被读取并转化为蛋白质。他们的图谱将来自三张现有全脑图谱的数据拼接在一起，代表了 220 人的 66,000 个细胞。他们的团队研究了这张图谱在携带两个 APOE4 拷贝的人与那些危害较小的基因变异的人之间有何不同。

paras.en: APOE4 carriers had fewer pericytes, starfish-shaped cells that wrap around and stabilize blood vessels. They also had higher numbers of myofibroblasts, cells normally formed during tissue injury that pump out fibronectin, the team found.
paras.zh: APOE4 携带者的周细胞较少，周细胞是包裹并稳定血管的海星状细胞。研究小组发现，它们的肌成纤维细胞数量也较多，这些细胞通常在组织损伤期间形成，可产生纤连蛋白。

paras.en: The map offered a snapshot, but it couldn’t show whether the missing pericytes were actually transforming into myofibroblasts. The researchers turned to 3-D models of human brain tissue grown from stem cells. In models carrying two copies of APOE4, pericytes began taking on the characteristics of scar-producing myofibroblasts. The transformation also offered a possible explanation for the earlier clue from resilient APOE4 carriers: Myofibroblasts produce large amounts of fibronectin. And when the researchers prevented cells in their models from producing fibronectin, amyloid accumulation dropped.
paras.zh: 该图提供了一个快照，但它无法显示缺失的周细胞是否实际上正在转化为肌成纤维细胞。研究人员转向利用干细胞生长的人脑组织的 3D 模型。在携带两个 APOE4 拷贝的模型中，周细胞开始呈现出产生疤痕的肌成纤维细胞的特征。这一转变还为弹性 APOE4 携带者的早期线索提供了可能的解释：肌成纤维细胞产生大量纤连蛋白。当研究人员阻止模型中的细胞产生纤连蛋白时，淀粉样蛋白的积累就会减少。

paras.en: The researchers also found a possible trigger for the cellular switch. In the APOE4 models, signaling through the immune molecule TGF-beta helped drive pericytes toward the scar-producing state. Blocking that signaling in cell models and aged mice restored the proportion of blood vessels wrapped up by pericytes.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现了细胞开关的可能触发因素。在 APOE4 模型中，通过免疫分子 TGF-β 发出的信号有助于驱动周细胞进入疤痕生成状态。在细胞模型和老年小鼠中阻断该信号传导可以恢复被周细胞包裹的血管比例。

paras.en: The TGF-beta data are “particularly interesting,” because inhibiting the protein reversed some of APOE4’s effects on pericytes, says Abdel Ali Belaidi, a neuroscientist at the Florey Institute of Neuroscience and Mental Health in Parkville, Australia. But TGF-beta performs many jobs throughout the body, he says, making it a difficult molecule to target safely with a drug.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚帕克维尔弗洛里神经科学与心理健康研究所的神经科学家 Abdel Ali Belaidi 表示，TGF-β 数据“特别有趣”，因为抑制该蛋白可以逆转 APOE4 对周细胞的一些影响。但他说，TGF-β 在全身发挥着多种作用，这使得它成为一种难以用药物安全靶向的分子。

paras.en: And damage to the brain’s blood vessels is only one of the many ways APOE4 has been linked to Alzheimer’s. Other studies have shown that the gene variant alters inflammation and interacts with another Alzheimer’s-linked protein, tau. How all these changes lock together to link APOE4 so strongly to Alzheimer’s disease is a greater mystery than one study can solve. ”As a field, we’re all progressing toward an answer,” Blanchard says.
paras.zh: 对大脑血管的损害只是 APOE4 与阿尔茨海默病相关的众多方式之一。其他研究表明，该基因变异会改变炎症并与另一种阿尔茨海默病相关蛋白 tau 相互作用。所有这些变化如何结合在一起，使 APOE4 与阿尔茨海默病如此紧密地联系在一起，这是一项研究无法解决的更大谜团。 “作为一个领域，我们都在寻找答案，”布兰查德说。

articles.title: Voyager 1 is nearly one light-day from Earth. What’s out there?
articles.author: Lisa Grossman

paras.en: NASA’s Voyager 1 spacecraft has been breaking distance records for decades. Launched almost 50 years ago, it became the farthest human-built object from Earth when it overtook the pathfinding Pioneer 10 probe in 1998. It was the first spacecraft to leave the solar system’s protective bubble, and it will be humankind’s first emissary to the stars.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的航行者 1 号航天器几十年来一直在打破距离记录。它发射近 50 年前，于 1998 年超越了探路先锋 10 号探测器，成为距地球最远的人造物体。它是第一艘离开太阳系保护层的航天器，也将成为人类第一位前往星际的使者。

paras.en: The cameras on Voyager 1, along with those on its twin spacecraft, Voyager 2, captured powerful megastorms in the outer solar system, the first images of dozens of moons and never-before-seen details of the gossamer rings around Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Uranus. The images and data sent home have shaped theories of how the solar system formed and evolved, inspired subsequent missions and posed enough new questions to keep space scientists busy for decades.
paras.zh: 航海者一号及其孪生航天器航海者二号上的相机捕捉到了太阳系外层强大的超级风暴、数十颗卫星的第一张图像以及木星、土星、海王星和天王星周围薄纱环的前所未见的细节。发送回国的图像和数据塑造了太阳系如何形成和演化的理论，启发了后续的任务，并提出了足够多的新问题，让太空科学家忙了几十年。

paras.en: And this month, Voyager 1 will set another big record. On November 18 at 5:16:07 a.m. Eastern Standard Time, it will become the first spacecraft to reach one light-day from Earth: the distance light travels in 24 hours. That’s a journey of 25.9 billion kilometers, or more than four times the distance from the sun to Pluto. At that point, signals from Earth will take a full day to reach Voyager 1; it will take another day to hear back.
paras.zh: 本月，航海者一号将创下另一项重大纪录。东部标准时间 11 月 18 日凌晨 5:16:07，它将成为第一个距离地球达到一光日的航天器：光在 24 小时内传播的距离。这是 259 亿公里的旅程，是太阳到冥王星距离的四倍多。届时，来自地球的信号将需要一整天才能到达旅行者一号；又要一天才能收到回复。

paras.en: “I just never imagined [the mission] would last that long,” says Linda Spilker, a planetary scientist at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, Calif., who began working on Voyager shortly before the probes launched in 1977. Spilker was in Cape Canaveral, Fla., for the first launch. She even planned the births of her children, now in their 40s, around mission milestones. After stepping away to lead another mission, she is now back as Voyager head scientist.
paras.zh: “我只是没想到（这次任务）会持续那么久，”美国宇航局加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳喷气推进实验室的行星科学家琳达·斯皮尔克（Linda Spilker）说道，她在 1977 年探测器发射前不久就开始从事航行者号的工作。斯皮尔克在佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角进行了首次发射。她甚至围绕任务里程碑计划了自己 40 多岁孩子的出生。在离开领导另一项任务后，她现在重新担任航行者号首席科学家。

paras.en: Two other scientists have been with Voyager since the beginning. Others weren’t yet born when the spacecraft launched. “Voyager, to this day, is a multi-generational mission,” Spilker says. But it isn’t a mission of nostalgia. There’s still a world of discovery out beyond the solar system’s edge.
paras.zh: 另外两名科学家从一开始就一直在航海者号工作。当宇宙飞船发射时，其他人还没有出生。 “时至今日，Voyager 仍是一项需要几代人共同努力的任务，”Spilker 说道。但这不是怀旧的使命。太阳系边缘之外仍然有一个值得探索的世界。

paras.en: “Every piece of data, every day that goes by that we get data from the Voyagers, tells us something new,” says physicist Jamie Rankin of Princeton University, who started her Ph.D. in August 2012, the same month that Voyager 1 left the solar system for the cold, calm seas of interstellar space. “Every day, it’s in places nobody’s ever explored before.”
paras.zh: 普林斯顿大学的物理学家杰米·兰金 (Jamie Rankin) 说：“我们从航行者号获得的数据的每一天、每一天，都告诉我们一些新的东西。” 2012 年 8 月，航行者一号离开太阳系，前往寒冷、平静的星际空间海洋。 “每天，它都会出现在以前没有人探索过的地方。”

paras.en: The original mission of the Voyager probes was to explore the outer parts of our solar system, which until then had remained largely mysterious. A rare planetary alignment meant that a spacecraft launched in the late 1970s could swoop past Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, getting a gravitational boost from each planet that it passed. With these gravitational assists, the spacecraft could complete the tour in less than 15 years. Such an alignment won’t happen again until the 2150s.
paras.zh: 航行者号探测器的最初任务是探索太阳系的外部部分，在此之前，该部分在很大程度上仍然是神秘的。罕见的行星排列意味着 20 世纪 70 年代末发射的航天器可以飞越木星、土星、天王星和海王星，并从其经过的每颗行星获得引力助推。有了这些引力的帮助，飞船可以在不到 15 年的时间内完成这次旅行。这种排列直到 2150 年代才会再次发生。

paras.en: The project was a bold step for its time. When work began in the early 1970s, no spacecraft had gone farther than Mars. NASA set a conservative goal for the mission: flybys of Jupiter and Saturn. In 1972 and 1973, NASA launched two Pioneer probes, which made sure the trek was possible and gathered data along the way. As with Voyager, there were two spacecraft in case one failed.
paras.zh: 该项目在当时是一个大胆的一步。当工作于 20 世纪 70 年代初开始时，还没有航天器飞得比火星更远。美国宇航局为该任务设定了一个保守的目标：飞越木星和土星。 1972 年和 1973 年，美国宇航局发射了两个先锋探测器，确保了这次长途跋涉的可能性，并沿途收集了数据。与航行者号一样，有两艘航天器以防其中一艘失败。

paras.en: After nail-biting launches and a wait of nearly two years, the Voyagers began uncovering many of Jupiter’s and Saturn’s long-held secrets, including the volcanoes on Jupiter’s moon Io, details of Jupiter’s Great Red Spot and hints of geologic activity on Saturn’s moon Enceladus.
paras.zh: 经过紧张的发射和近两年的等待，航海者号开始揭开木星和土星的许多长期秘密，包括木星卫星木卫一上的火山、木星大红斑的细节以及土星卫星土卫二上地质活动的迹象。

paras.en: Mission accomplished, Voyager 2 went on to pass Uranus and Neptune. It took the first images of the planets’ rings and discovered more than a dozen moons along the way. The spacecraft also spotted a perpetually churning storm on Neptune and erupting geysers on Neptune’s moon Triton.
paras.zh: 任务完成后，航海家二号继续飞越天王星和海王星。它拍摄了第一张行星环的图像，并沿途发现了十多个卫星。该航天器还发现海王星上有一场持续翻腾的风暴，并在海王星的卫星海卫一上发现了间歇泉。

paras.en: “The highlights of Voyager were clearly the planetary encounters,” said Ed Stone, the mission’s original head scientist, in a NASA interview before his death in 2024. “We had a lifetime of discovery packed into each one.”
paras.zh: “航行者号的亮点显然是行星相遇，”该任务最初的首席科学家埃德·斯通 (Ed Stone) 在 2024 年去世前接受 NASA 采访时说道，“每一次探索都蕴含着我们一生的发现。”

paras.en: The uncontested stars of these encounters were the images shared in news reports and TV broadcasts as the planets and their moons came into view. Jupiter’s moon Io turned out to be a shocking splotchy orange color that looked like a pizza.
paras.zh: 这些相遇中无可争议的明星是当行星及其卫星进入视野时在新闻报道和电视广播中分享的图像。木星的卫星木卫一呈令人震惊的斑点橙色，看起来像披萨。

paras.en: A humble navigation image of that moon led to one of the most surprising discoveries of the entire mission. Four days past Voyager 1’s closest approach to Jupiter, after the excitement had died down, project astronomer Linda Morabito of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory started processing additional images of Io. These images had been taken after the flyby, when Voyager was looking back over its shoulder.
paras.zh: 那颗卫星的一张简陋的导航图像带来了整个任务中最令人惊讶的发现之一。航海者一号最接近木星四天后，兴奋消退后，喷气推进实验室的项目天文学家琳达·莫拉比托开始处理木卫一的更多图像。这些照片是在飞越之后拍摄的，当时航行者号回头望去。

paras.en: As Morabito enhanced one image’s brightness, she spotted an odd bulbous formation protruding from Io’s edge. “What’s that?” she asked herself. Her supervisor had the same reaction: “Jesus, what’s that?” she later recalled him saying.
paras.zh: 当莫拉比托增强了一张图像的亮度时，她发现了一个奇怪的球状结构从木卫一的边缘突出。 “那是什么？”她问自己。她的主管也有同样的反应：“天哪，那是什么？”她后来回忆起他说的话。

paras.en: The bulb turned out to be a volcanic plume — an erupting fire fountain extending 250 kilometers above Io’s surface. It was the first discovery of active volcanism anywhere other than Earth, and it transformed our view of the outer solar system. Instead of a cold, inert icebox, this was a bubbling and dynamic region.
paras.zh: 事实证明，这个灯泡是火山羽流——一个喷发的火焰喷泉，延伸到木卫一表面上方 250 公里处。这是在地球以外的任何地方首次发现活火山活动，它改变了我们对外太阳系的看法。这里不是一个冰冷、惰性的冰箱，而是一个冒泡、充满活力的区域。

paras.en: The findings inspired many future missions. While visiting Jupiter from 1995 to 2003, the Galileo probe found that Europa may have a subsurface ocean that could be hospitable to life. When the Cassini probe orbited Saturn from 2004 to 2017, it discovered that the moon Enceladus also has a potentially habitable ocean that spews icy geysers into space.
paras.zh: 这些发现启发了许多未来的任务。伽利略号探测器在 1995 年至 2003 年访问木星时发现木卫二可能存在适合生命生存的地下海洋。当卡西尼号探测器于 2004 年至 2017 年绕土星运行时，它发现土卫二卫星也有一个潜在的宜居海洋，该海洋向太空喷出冰冷的间歇泉。

paras.en: In 1990, with Voyager 1 about 6 billion kilometers from the sun, astronomer Carl Sagan convinced mission leaders to turn the spacecraft backward for one last look at the planets. Voyager 1 took a family portrait in which Earth appeared faintly as a “pale blue dot,” Sagan said. “Everyone you love, everyone you know, everyone you ever heard of, every human being who ever was, lived out their lives … on a mote of dust suspended in a sunbeam,” he wrote in the 1994 book Pale Blue Dot.
paras.zh: 1990 年，航海家一号距离太阳约 60 亿公里，天文学家卡尔·萨根说服任务领导人将航天器向后转动，以便最后一次观察行星。萨根说，航海者一号拍摄了一张全家福，其中地球隐隐约约地呈现为“淡蓝色的点”。 “你所爱的每一个人、你认识的每一个人、你听说过的每一个人、曾经存在过的每一个人，都在悬浮在阳光中的一粒尘埃上度过了自己的一生，”他在 1994 年出版的《淡蓝点》一书中写道。

paras.en: To save power, Voyager 2’s cameras were shut off in 1989. After the family portrait, Voyager 1’s cameras were also turned off. Where the spacecraft were headed, there wouldn’t be much to see.
paras.zh: 为了节省电力，航海家二号的相机在1989年被关闭。全家福之后，航海家一号的相机也被关闭。宇宙飞船所前往的地方，不会有太多可看的东西。

paras.en: The probes were now on their way out of the solar system along their own separate paths, both headed toward a mysterious boundary that no human emissary had ever crossed. In this next phase of their voyage, no one knew what to expect. How long would the spacecraft keep communicating? How far would the powerful forces that drive the sun reach? And what would it be like to taste interstellar space?
paras.zh: 探测器现在正沿着各自不同的路径离开太阳系，都朝着人类使者从未跨越过的神秘边界前进。在他们航行的下一阶段，没有人知道会发生什么。宇宙飞船还能保持通信多久？驱动太阳的强大力量能到达多远？品尝星际空间会是什么样的感觉？

paras.en: For its first 35 years in space, Voyager 1 was swaddled in the solar wind. This stream of hot, charged particles flows constantly from the sun, forming a vast bubble called the heliosphere. The bubble surrounds the solar system, protecting it from cosmic radiation; it extends billions of kilometers past the planets up to a boundary called the heliopause. Heliophysicists consider this boundary, where the solar wind bumps into interstellar space, the edge of the solar system, although the sun’s gravitational influence extends much farther.
paras.zh: 在太空航行的头 35 年里，旅行者 1 号一直沐浴在太阳风中。这种炽热的带电粒子流不断从太阳中流出，形成一个巨大的气泡，称为日光层。气泡包围着太阳系，保护其免受宇宙辐射；它延伸了数十亿公里，穿过行星，到达称为日球层顶的边界。太阳物理学家认为这个边界是太阳风撞击星际空间的地方，即太阳系的边缘，尽管太阳的引力影响范围更远。

paras.en: Scientists expected the Voyagers to cross the heliopause, but they didn’t know when — or what the spacecraft would find when they did. Rankin had just started her Ph.D. at Caltech when in August 2012 Voyager 1 detected an abrupt jump in the number of high-energy cosmic rays alongside a drop in solar particles, hinting that the spacecraft had crossed the boundary. But magnetic field measurements suggested otherwise. Instead, those measurements indicated that the sun still exerted some influence. The interstellar magnetic field diverted around the heliosphere like a river around a rock.
paras.zh: 科学家们预计航海家号将穿越日球层顶，但他们不知道何时，也不知道当他们穿越时飞船会发现什么。兰金刚刚开始攻读博士学位。 2012 年 8 月，航行者 1 号在加州理工学院检测到高能宇宙射线数量突然增加，同时太阳粒子数量下降，这暗示航天器已经跨越了边界。但磁场测量表明情况并非如此。相反，这些测量表明太阳仍然施加了一些影响。星际磁场在日光层周围转移，就像河流围绕岩石一样。

paras.en: A Voyager instrument that could have settled the question of whether the probe had passed the heliopause was no longer working. But scientists got a lucky break in April 2013 when an eruption on the sun sent a pressure wave rippling outward. It set the electrons around Voyager 1 vibrating, which allowed scientists to estimate the density of charged particles nearby.
paras.zh: 原本可以解决探测器是否已通过日球层顶问题的航行者号仪器已不再工作。但科学家们在 2013 年 4 月迎来了一次幸运的突破，当时太阳的喷发发出了向外扩散的压力波。它使航行者一号周围的电子振动，从而使科学家能够估计附近带电粒子的密度。

paras.en: The results showed that Voyager 1 had in fact crossed the heliopause on August 25, 2012, when it was about 18 billion kilometers away, or 120 times Earth’s distance from the sun. Data from Voyager 2 later backed up that finding. “This is the beginning of a new era of exploration for us,” Stone told Science News in 2013.
paras.zh: 结果显示，航海家一号实际上已于 2012 年 8 月 25 日穿越日球层顶，当时距离太阳约 180 亿公里，是地球与太阳距离的 120 倍。来自航行者 2 号的数据后来支持了这一发现。 “这对我们来说是一个新探索时代的开始，”斯通在 2013 年告诉《科学新闻》。

paras.en: But the line between our solar system and interstellar space isn’t solid. The sun’s reach extends farther than anyone expected, and “this boundary is not very sharp or very thin,” says physicist Jeewoo Park of NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Md.
paras.zh: 但我们的太阳系和星际空间之间的界限并不牢固。马里兰州格林贝尔特美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的物理学家 Jeewoo Park 表示，太阳的覆盖范围比任何人预期的都要远，而且“这个边界并不是很尖锐或很薄”。

paras.en: With Voyager on the other side of the heliopause, particle speeds and gas temperatures have dropped. The magnetic field is weaker. Even dust particles are about half as abundant compared with inside the heliosphere. “For the most part, it’s been very quiet and very consistent,” Rankin says.
paras.zh: 随着航海者号位于日球层顶的另一侧，粒子速度和气体温度都下降了。磁场较弱。即使是尘埃颗粒的数量也只有日光层内部的一半左右。 “在大多数情况下，它非常安静且非常一致，”兰金说。

paras.en: But it’s not entirely silent. In four instances, scientists saw spikes in the magnetic field strength and particle density measurements around the probe. After the fourth, in mid-2020, those numbers have remained high. No one knows why. Perhaps Voyager 1 continues to ride the aftershocks of solar eruptions, says Park, who reported on the events in June in the Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 但它并非完全沉默。在四个例子中，科学家们发现探测器周围的磁场强度和粒子密度测量值出现峰值。在 2020 年中期第四次之后，这些数字仍然很高。没有人知道为什么。帕克说，也许旅行者一号会继续承受太阳喷发的余震，他在六月份的《天体物理学杂志》上报道了这一事件。

paras.en: Where pure interstellar space begins is still an open question. So is the heliosphere’s shape. Most scientists think it is elongated, like a comet, but others think it is a sphere or even a croissant.
paras.zh: 纯粹的星际空间从哪里开始仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。日光层的形状也是如此。大多数科学家认为它是细长的，就像彗星一样，但也有人认为它是一个球体，甚至是一个羊角面包。

paras.en: Space telescopes launched in 2008 and 2025, the Interstellar Boundary Explorer and Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe, could help answer that question.
paras.zh: 2008 年和 2025 年发射的太空望远镜、星际边界探测器和星际测绘与加速探测器可以帮助回答这个问题。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Voyager probes are silently sailing onward. Scientists estimate that the onboard power sources that keep the crafts’ instruments running will dry up in 10 to 15 years, preventing them from sending data back to Earth. Our conversation will come to an end. But the journey goes on.
paras.zh: 与此同时，航海者号探测器正在悄然前行。科学家估计，维持飞船仪器运行的机载电源将在 10 到 15 年内枯竭，导致它们无法将数据发送回地球。我们的谈话将结束。但旅程仍在继续。

paras.en: Voyager 2 will approach a red dwarf star known as Ross 248 in about 42,000 years, coming within 700 light-days. It will be 44,000 years before Voyager 1 next encounters another star, Gliese 445, at a similar distance. “The Voyagers become our silent ambassadors, a little bit of us that continues into space,” Spilker says.
paras.zh: 航行者 2 号将在大约 42,000 年后接近一颗名为罗斯 248 的红矮星，距离不到 700 光日。 44,000 年后，航海家 1 号在相似的距离下再次遇到另一颗恒星 Gliese 445。 “航行者号成为我们沉默的大使，是我们继续进入太空的一部分，”斯皮尔克说。

paras.en: They carry a message, should anyone find it, contained on the Golden Record. A copy of the phonograph record, which is plated in gold, rides on each of the probes. The long-distance dispatches feature sights and sounds of Earth, including a map of the solar system; images of Earth’s monuments; greetings in dozens of languages; and the sounds of whale song, laughter, classical composers and Navajo chants.
paras.zh: 它们携带着金唱片中包含的信息，如果有人发现的话。每个探头上都装有一张镀金的留声机唱片。远程调度以地球的景象和声音为特色，包括太阳系地图；地球古迹的图像；用数十种语言问候；还有鲸鱼的歌声、笑声、古典作曲家和纳瓦霍圣歌的声音。

paras.en: That time capsule captures the optimism and promise of the mission, Spilker says. “It may well outlast humanity.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔克说，这个时间胶囊捕捉到了任务的乐观情绪和承诺。 “它很可能比人类更长寿。”

articles.title: Tiny implants can use the body itself to talk to each other
articles.author: Brendan Pierson

paras.en: Medical implants are getting smaller and smarter. But getting them to talk to each other remains tricky.
paras.zh: 医疗植入物变得越来越小、越来越智能。但让他们互相交谈仍然很棘手。

paras.en: Now, researchers have developed a way for tiny implantable devices to send electrical signals through the body’s own tissues. The approach could offer a low-power way for implants to work together, with one detecting a symptom and another delivering treatment, the team reports September 24 in Science.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员已经开发出一种微型植入设备通过人体自身组织发送电信号的方法。该团队于 9 月 24 日在《科学》杂志上报道，这种方法可以为植入物提供一种低功耗的协同工作方式，其中一个植入物检测症状，另一个提供治疗。

paras.en: Currently, getting devices to communicate through tissue comes with trade-offs. Some medical devices, such as insulin pumps linked to glucose monitors, use Bluetooth, which relies on radio signals. Receiving those signals requires power even when a device is only listening, increasing the need for battery power and making devices harder shrink. Radio signals also weaken as they travel through body tissue, limiting how far apart communicating devices can be.
paras.zh: 目前，让设备通过组织进行通信需要权衡。一些医疗设备，例如与血糖监测仪连接的胰岛素泵，使用依赖于无线电信号的蓝牙。即使设备只是在监听，接收这些信号也需要电力，这增加了对电池电力的需求，并使设备更难缩小。无线电信号在穿过身体组织时也会减弱，从而限制了通信设备之间的距离。

paras.en: The new network called SWANS, the Smart Wireless Autonomous Networking System, works differently. A wearable external hub or implant generates an electric pulse that produces a small current in the surrounding tissue. Tiny implants can detect those electrical signals while using almost no power when they are only listening. And without large batteries, those implants can be small enough to inject through a syringe.
paras.zh: 名为 SWANS（智能无线自治网络系统）的新网络的工作方式有所不同。可穿戴外部集线器或植入物产生电脉冲，在周围组织中产生小电流。微小的植入物可以检测这些电信号，而当它们仅在监听时几乎不消耗电力。如果没有大电池，这些植入物可以足够小，可以通过注射器注射。

paras.en: To demonstrate how the network works, the team attached motion sensors to the front legs of rats. When the animals moved their front legs, the system’s external hub sent signals through their bodies to neurostimulator implants in the sciatic nerves, causing muscles in the back legs to contract.
paras.zh: 为了演示该网络的工作原理，该团队将运动传感器安装在老鼠的前腿上。当动物移动前腿时，系统的外部中枢通过它们的身体向坐骨神经中的神经刺激器植入物发送信号，导致后腿的肌肉收缩。

paras.en: The synchronized limbs weren’t really the point. The experiment was designed to show that signals could travel through the body, linking different kinds of devices, says Alex Abramson, a biomedical engineer at Georgia Tech in Atlanta. It was “a proof of concept showing that you can really connect this system to anything.”
paras.zh: 同步肢体并不是真正的重点。亚特兰大佐治亚理工学院的生物医学工程师亚历克斯·艾布拉姆森 (Alex Abramson) 表示，该实验旨在证明信号可以穿过身体传播，连接不同类型的设备。这是“一个概念证明，表明你真的可以将这个系统连接到任何东西。”

paras.en: Abramson says a network of smart implants could automatically deliver a drug or stimulate a neuron exactly when needed to treat complex conditions like Parkinson’s disease. Simple signals can be sent from one implant to another, while an external hub can coordinate more complex networks of sensors and devices, possibly using artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 艾布拉姆森说，智能植入物网络可以在需要治疗帕金森病等复杂疾病时自动输送药物或刺激神经元。简单的信号可以从一个植入物发送到另一个植入物，而外部集线器可以协调更复杂的传感器和设备网络，可能使用人工智能。
