paras.en: Before the new network can be used in humans, researchers will need to show that the electrical signals do not cause unintended problems like heart rhythm disruptions. Such issues have not turned up in the experiments in rats yet, but the technology will need to be tested over longer periods of time and in larger animals, Abramson says.
paras.zh: 在新网络用于人类之前，研究人员需要证明电信号不会导致心律紊乱等意外问题。艾布拉姆森说，此类问题尚未在大鼠实验中出现，但该技术需要在更长时间和更大的动物中进行测试。

paras.en: Materials engineer Amir Alavi says the network’s potential could grow as other technologies improve, including wearables, AI systems and miniature, battery-free implantable sensors like those his lab is developing. “There are now several really interesting directions converging,” says Alavi, of at the University of Pittsburgh’s Swanson School of Engineering. “If those pieces eventually come together, you could have implants that are much smaller, simpler, longer-lived, and more connected than what we have today.”
paras.zh: 材料工程师阿米尔·阿拉维 (Amir Alavi) 表示，随着其他技术的进步，包括可穿戴设备、人工智能系统和微型无电池植入式传感器（如他的实验室正在开发的传感器），该网络的潜力可能会增长。 “现在有几个非常有趣的方向正在融合，”匹兹堡大学斯旺森工程学院的阿拉维说。 “如果这些部件最终组合在一起，你可能会拥有比我们今天的植入物更小、更简单、寿命更长、连接性更强的植入物。”

articles.title: One Blood Type Seems to Carry a Higher Risk of Type 2 Diabetes
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: Depending on your blood type, it's possible you could carry a higher diabetes risk, research suggests.
paras.zh: 研究表明，根据您的血型，您患糖尿病的风险可能更高。

paras.en: According to a 2024 review, people with blood type B – either positive or negative – face a slightly higher risk of developing type 2 diabetes than people with non-B blood types.
paras.zh: 根据 2024 年的一项审查，B 型血（无论是阳性还是阴性）的人患 2 型糖尿病的风险略高于非 B 型血的人。

paras.en: About 28 percent, on average. That might not seem huge, but it may be significant enough to tip the scales if other risk factors are involved.
paras.zh: 平均约为 28%。这可能看起来并不大，但如果涉及其他风险因素，它可能足以扭转局面。

paras.en: "Numerous systematic reviews with meta-analyses have been published, which explored correlations between ABO and Rhesus blood groups with various health outcomes," wrote a team led by epidemiologist Fang-Hua Liu of Shengjing Hospital of China Medical University.
paras.zh: 中国医科大学盛京医院流行病学家刘芳华领导的研究小组写道：“已经发表了大量荟萃分析系统综述，探讨了 ABO 血型和恒河猴血型与各种健康结果之间的相关性。”

paras.en: "However, to date, the association between these blood groups and human health outcomes remains controversial. The current umbrella review included 51 systematic reviews with meta-analysis articles with 270 associations.
paras.zh: “然而，迄今为止，这些血型与人类健康结果之间的关联仍然存在争议。当前的总体审查包括 51 项系统审查和荟萃分析文章，涉及 270 项关联。

paras.en: "We recalculated each association and found only one [instance of] convincing evidence for an association between blood group B and type 2 diabetes mellitus risk compared with the non-B blood group."
paras.zh: “我们重新计算了每项关联，发现与非 B 血型相比，只有一个令人信服的证据证明 B 型血与 2 型糖尿病风险之间存在关联。”

paras.en: Human blood is categorized into eight main groups based on the sugars and proteins, or lack thereof, present on the surface of your red blood cells.
paras.zh: 根据红细胞表面存在的糖和蛋白质或缺乏糖和蛋白质，人类血液分为八个主要类别。

paras.en: A, B, and AB types are based on the presence of antigens – sugar molecules that can trigger an immune response. O-type blood has no A or B antigens. Meanwhile, Rhesus (Rh) factors are proteins that determine blood compatibility and give your blood its positive or negative designation.
paras.zh: A、B 和 AB 类型基于抗原（可以触发免疫反应的糖分子）的存在。 O型血没有A或B抗原。同时，恒河猴 (Rh) 因子是决定血液相容性并赋予您的血液阳性或阴性名称的蛋白质。

paras.en: Previous studies have suggested that these subtle differences in our blood cells may be linked to increased vulnerability to certain diseases.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，我们的血细胞中的这些细微差异可能与某些疾病的脆弱性增加有关。

paras.en: Liu and colleagues embarked on their study to systematically evaluate links between blood type and disease across a catalog of around 270 different health outcomes.
paras.zh: Liu 和同事开始研究，系统地评估大约 270 种不同健康结果的血型和疾病之间的联系。

paras.en: A systematic review is a study that reviews published papers on a given topic and analyzes their results collectively. An umbrella review compiles systematic reviews – a sort of giant synthesis that provides a wider overview.
paras.zh: 系统综述是一项回顾已发表的特定主题论文并集体分析其结果的研究。伞式评论汇集了系统评论——一种提供更广泛概述的巨型综合。

paras.en: Think of individual studies as trees; a systematic review is like standing outside a copse, while an umbrella review is like flying a drone over a whole forest of copses.
paras.zh: 将个人研究视为树木；系统审查就像站在一片小树林外，而伞式审查就像在整个小树林上空驾驶无人机。

paras.en: "We systematically searched PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and several regional databases on the date from inception until Feb 16, 2024, to identify systematic reviews with meta-analyses of observational studies evaluating associations between ABO as well as Rh blood groups and diverse health outcomes," the researchers explained.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说：“从成立之日起至 2024 年 2 月 16 日，我们系统地检索了 PubMed、Web of Science、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane 图书馆和几个区域数据库，以通过对评估 ABO 血型和 Rh 血型与不同健康结果之间关联的观察性研究进行荟萃分析来确定系统评价。”

paras.en: To sort through the 270 reported links between blood group and disease, the researchers put each one through a series of statistical stress tests designed to weed out weak or unreliable findings.
paras.zh: 为了对 270 种报告的血型与疾病之间的联系进行排序，研究人员对每一种血型进行了一系列统计压力测试，旨在剔除薄弱或不可靠的发现。

paras.en: They examined the strength of the evidence, whether results were consistent across different studies, and whether the datasets were large enough to be trustworthy.
paras.zh: 他们检查了证据的强度、不同研究的结果是否一致，以及数据集是否足够大以至于值得信赖。

paras.en: They also checked for signs of bias, such as small studies exaggerating effects or an unusually high number of positive results.
paras.zh: 他们还检查了是否存在偏见迹象，例如夸大影响的小型研究或异常多的阳性结果。

paras.en: Crucially, they asked whether each association would likely hold up if tested again in future research. Most of the associations didn't pass these checks.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，他们询问如果在未来的研究中再次进行测试，每个关联是否可能成立。大多数协会都没有通过这些检查。

paras.en: In the end, just one link, between blood type B and type 2 diabetes, met the highest standard of evidence.
paras.zh: 最终，只有 B 型血和 2 型糖尿病之间的一个联系符合最高证据标准。

paras.en: That suggests that the link is real, albeit relatively small: just 28 percent higher than the current baseline. That's much smaller than the risk associated with diet, weight, or lifestyle.
paras.zh: 这表明这种联系是真实的，尽管相对较小：仅比当前基线高 28%。这比与饮食、体重或生活方式相关的风险要小得多。

paras.en: Just 50 grams of processed meat a day, for example, increases the risk of type 2 diabetes by 37 percent. A sedentary lifestyle can increase the risk by 112 percent. And being overweight is one of the strongest risk factors known.
paras.zh: 例如，每天仅吃 50 克加工肉类，就会使患 2 型糖尿病的风险增加 37%。久坐的生活方式会使风险增加 112%。超重是已知的最严重的风险因素之一。

paras.en: The researchers also didn't examine what might drive this increased risk. A 2025 study suggests that the gut microbiome may be involved; however, further investigation is needed.
paras.zh: 研究人员也没有研究是什么可能导致这种风险增加。 2025 年的一项研究表明肠道微生物组可能参与其中；然而，还需要进一步调查。

paras.en: The results do suggest that there's a real, tangible association between blood type and type 2 diabetes – one that people can factor into how they think about their own risk.
paras.zh: 结果确实表明，血型和 2 型糖尿病之间存在真实、切实的关联——人们可以将这种关联纳入他们对自身风险的看法中。

paras.en: Still, your blood type alone won't make or break your diabetes risk. Diet, activity levels, and weight matter far more – this is just one more piece of a puzzle scientists are still putting together.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，您的血型本身并不会增加或降低患糖尿病的风险。饮食、活动水平和体重更为重要——这只是科学家们仍在拼凑的难题的又一个部分。

paras.en: The research was published in BMC Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在 BMC Medicine 上。

articles.title: A Saline Injection Could Offer Longer Relief From Carpal Tunnel Pain
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Typing with numb fingers, struggling to hold a pen, or waking with an aching hand can make everyday life exhausting for people with carpal tunnel syndrome.
paras.zh: 用麻木的手指打字、费力地握笔或醒来时手部酸痛，都会使腕管综合症患者的日常生活变得疲惫不堪。

paras.en: The condition develops when a nerve supplying the hand becomes squeezed inside a narrow passage at the wrist. Pressure can disrupt the nerve's signals, causing pain, tingling, numbness, and weakness.
paras.zh: 当支配手的神经在手腕的狭窄通道内受到挤压时，就会出现这种情况。压力会扰乱神经信号，导致疼痛、刺痛、麻木和虚弱。

paras.en: Now, a small trial has found that injecting saline around the trapped nerve could ease symptoms for longer than a steroid injection.
paras.zh: 现在，一项小型试验发现，在受困神经周围注射生理盐水可以比注射类固醇更长时间地缓解症状。

paras.en: Relief persisted for six months after the saline procedure, by which time the initial benefits of steroid injection alone had largely faded.
paras.zh: 盐水注射后，缓解持续了六个月，此时单独注射类固醇的最初效果已基本消失。

paras.en: The saline is used to open up space between tissues. In the procedure, called hydrodissection, a clinician uses ultrasound to guide a fine needle alongside the nerve. The sterile salt solution is injected around it, separating it from tissues that restrict its movement.
paras.zh: 盐水用于打开组织之间的空间。在称为水解剖的手术中，临床医生使用超声波引导细针沿着神经行进。将无菌盐溶液注入其周围，将其与限制其运动的组织分开。

paras.en: This aims to help the nerve move more freely. A steroid injection eases symptoms by reducing inflammation and swelling.
paras.zh: 这样做的目的是帮助神经更自由地活动。类固醇注射可通过减少炎症和肿胀来缓解症状。

paras.en: "This relieves the pressure on the nerve and improves patients' symptoms," radiologist Anupama Tandon, from University College of Medical Sciences and Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital in India, told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 印度大学医学学院和 Guru Teg Bahadur 医院的放射科医生 Anupama Tandon 告诉 ScienceAlert：“这可以减轻神经压力并改善患者的症状。”

paras.en: The researchers wanted to establish how much benefit came from separating the tissues. Most earlier hydrodissection studies included medication in the injected fluid, so it was hard to tell whether the procedure or the drug deserved the credit.
paras.zh: 研究人员想要确定分离组织能带来多少好处。大多数早期的水解剖研究都在注射液中加入了药物，因此很难判断该过程或药物是否值得赞扬。

paras.en: Led by radiologist Anindita Bose from Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Hospital, the team studied 39 adults whose symptoms had persisted for more than three months, despite treatments such as medication or wrist splints.
paras.zh: 由圣雄甘地医学院和医院的放射科医生 Anindita Bose 领导的研究小组对 39 名成年人进行了研究，尽管他们接受了药物或手腕夹板等治疗，但症状仍持续超过三个月。

paras.en: Some had the condition in both hands, so the trial included 63 wrists.
paras.zh: 有些人双手都有这种情况，因此试验包括 63 只手腕。

paras.en: Each wrist was randomly assigned to one of three treatments. One group received hydrodissection with saline alone. Another received a steroid injection without the tissue-separating procedure. The third received hydrodissection with steroid added to the saline.
paras.zh: 每只手腕被随机分配接受三种治疗中的一种。一组仅用盐水进行水解剖。另一个人接受了类固醇注射，但没有进行组织分离程序。第三个接受了在盐水中添加类固醇的水解剖。

paras.en: All treatments were guided by ultrasound. The steroid-containing injections also included a local anesthetic. The researchers then followed changes in pain, numbness, and difficulty using the hand, with ultrasound scans checking nerve swelling during the first three months.
paras.zh: 所有治疗均由超声波引导。含有类固醇的注射剂还包括局部麻醉剂。然后，研究人员在头三个月内通过超声波扫描检查神经肿胀，跟踪疼痛、麻木和用手困难的变化。

paras.en: All three treatments helped initially. The difference emerged over the following months: Pain returned in the steroid-only group, while relief continued in the saline-only hydrodissection group.
paras.zh: 所有三种治疗最初都有帮助。在接下来的几个月里，差异出现了：仅使用类固醇的组疼痛再次出现，而仅使用盐水的组疼痛继续缓解。

paras.en: Adding steroid to hydrodissection did not clearly improve the results.
paras.zh: 在水分离中添加类固醇并没有明显改善结果。

paras.en: Ultrasound images supported the patients' reports. Nerve swelling decreased more in both hydrodissection groups than in the group given steroid injections alone.
paras.zh: 超声图像支持了患者的报告。与单独注射类固醇的组相比，两个水解剖组的神经肿胀减少得更多。

paras.en: These findings support the researchers' explanation that separating the nerve from surrounding tissues contributes to relief. However, the trial had no group that received a dummy injection, so the contribution of patients' treatment expectations could not be assessed separately.
paras.zh: 这些发现支持了研究人员的解释，即将神经与周围组织分开有助于缓解疼痛。然而，该试验没有接受模拟注射的组，因此无法单独评估患者治疗期望的贡献。

paras.en: Tandon described a young typist whose pain and numbness had become so disruptive that her job was at risk. Medication and a wrist splint had failed to help.
paras.zh: 坦登描述了一位年轻的打字员，她的疼痛和麻木已经变得如此严重，以至于她的工作面临风险。药物和手腕夹板都没有帮助。

paras.en: "Post hydrodissection, she had improvement in her symptoms and was able to resume her work," Tandon said.
paras.zh: 坦登说：“水解剖后，她的症状有所改善，并能够恢复工作。”

paras.en: Treatment took around 15 minutes and required no hospital stay. No major complications were observed. Some participants experienced mild pain and swelling that settled within a few days. One experienced tingling during needle placement, with no lasting neurological effects reported.
paras.zh: 治疗大约需要 15 分钟，无需住院。没有观察到重大并发症。一些参与者经历了轻微的疼痛和肿胀，但几天后就消失了。一名患者在置针过程中出现刺痛感，但没有报告持久的神经系统影响。

paras.en: Larger studies are needed to establish how reliably the procedure works and how long relief lasts. This trial involved a small number of people at one center, with follow-up ending at six months. It did not directly compare hydrodissection with surgery.
paras.zh: 需要进行更大规模的研究来确定该程序的可靠性以及缓解效果的持续时间。这项试验涉及一个中心的少数人，随访期为六个月。它没有直接比较水分离术和手术。

paras.en: "It is beneficial for mild to moderate CTS [carpal tunnel syndrome]," Tandon said, "while severe cases require surgery."
paras.zh: “这对轻度至中度 CTS（腕管综合症）有益，”坦登说，“而严重的病例则需要手术。”

paras.en: The team has begun a longer study comparing saline with dextrose, a type of sugar, to investigate which fluid provides more lasting relief.
paras.zh: 该团队已经开始一项长期研究，比较盐水和葡萄糖（一种糖），以调查哪种液体能提供更持久的缓解作用。

paras.en: The research has been published in Radiology.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《放射学》杂志上。

articles.title: New Form of Superconductor Behavior Discovered That We've Never Seen Before
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Materials in a superconducting state are of huge interest to scientists.
paras.zh: 超导状态的材料引起了科学家的极大兴趣。

paras.en: That's because of rare properties – primarily the ability to conduct electricity with zero resistance, with nothing lost to heat – that promise to transform computing, energy grids, and transport.
paras.zh: 这是因为其罕见的特性——主要是零电阻导电的能力，且不会因热量而损失——有望改变计算、能源网格和运输。

paras.en: This phenomenon happens when free electrons condense into a low-energy quantum state at very cold temperatures, pairing up into what are called Cooper pairs so they can zip through materials without interference.
paras.zh: 当自由电子在极冷的温度下凝结成低能量子态时，就会发生这种现象，配对成所谓的库珀对，这样它们就可以不受干扰地穿过材料。

paras.en: Back in 2007, scientists predicted the existence of a more exotic type of electron movement, called a pair density wave (PDW), where the Cooper pairs form specific patterns while moving, like ripples on sand.
paras.zh: 早在 2007 年，科学家就预测存在一种更奇特的电子运动类型，称为电子对密度波 (PDW)，其中库珀对在运动时形成特定的图案，就像沙子上的波纹一样。

paras.en: Now a team led by researchers from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign has found compelling evidence of PDWs on the surface of the metal uranium ditelluride, with their results published in PNAS.
paras.zh: 现在，由伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校研究人员领导的团队在金属二碲化铀表面发现了令人信服的PDW证据，他们的研究结果发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。

paras.en: What's more, the patterns were found to persist outside of the standard superconducting state, something that's never been seen before.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，这些模式被发现在标准超导状态之外仍然存在，这是以前从未见过的。

paras.en: "Pair density waves are the Cheshire Cat's grin of superconductivity," says physicist Eduardo Fradkin from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校的物理学家爱德华多·弗拉德金 (Eduardo Fradkin) 表示：“密度波对是超导性中柴郡猫的笑容。”

paras.en: "They are the vestige that remains once the phase itself has disappeared.
paras.zh: “它们是灵态本身消失后留下的痕迹。

paras.en: "In conventional superconductors, Cooper pairs form when the full phase transition occurs, but in this system, their observation in PDWs above the transition point shows that they are formed beforehand in a different state."
paras.zh: “在传统的超导体中，库珀对在完全相变发生时形成，但在这个系统中，它们在转变点上方的 PDW 中的观察表明它们是预先在不同的状态下形成的。”

paras.en: Uranium ditelluride becomes a superconductor below about 2.1 Kelvin (about -271 °C or -456 °F) and is of particular interest to researchers as it's thought to be a rare 'spin-triplet' superconductor, in which paired electrons also have a tiny magnetic orientation.
paras.zh: 二碲化铀在温度低于约 2.1 开尔文（约 -271 °C 或 -456 °F）时成为超导体，研究人员对此特别感兴趣，因为它被认为是一种罕见的“自旋三重态”超导体，其中成对电子也具有微小的磁性取向。

paras.en: Signs of PDWs had previously been detected in the metal, and here the researchers took a closer look using a custom-made, high-quality form of uranium ditelluride.
paras.zh: 此前曾在金属中检测到 PDW 的迹象，研究人员使用定制的高质量二碲化铀进行了仔细观察。

paras.en: The material was probed via a vector magnetic field scanning tunneling microscope (STM), which can measure magnetic responses in multiple, arbitrary directions.
paras.zh: 通过矢量磁场扫描隧道显微镜（STM）对该材料进行探测，该显微镜可以测量多个任意方向的磁响应。

paras.en: "A key advantage of our experiment was the newly developed vector-magnet equipment, which provides an unusually large magnetic-field range along multiple directions," says physicist Zhen Zhu from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校的物理学家朱震说：“我们实验的一个关键优势是新开发的矢量磁体设备，它可以沿多个方向提供异常大的磁场范围。”

paras.en: "By systematically varying both the magnitude and direction of the field, together with temperature, we could track how these modes evolved and build confidence that the behavior we observed was intrinsic."
paras.zh: “通过系统地改变场的大小和方向以及温度，我们可以跟踪这些模式是如何演变的，并建立我们观察到的行为是内在的信心。”

paras.en: The researchers added theoretical models to explain the charge patterns they were seeing below the critical temperature required for superconductivity, and at a point significantly above it, too.
paras.zh: 研究人员添加了理论模型来解释他们在超导所需的临界温度以下以及在显着高于该临界温度时所看到的电荷模式。

paras.en: "Thanks to new methods for growing higher-quality samples, we were able to observe spectral signatures that respond to temperature and magnetic fields exactly as pair density waves should," says physicist Vidya Madhavan from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校的物理学家维迪亚·马达万 (Vidya Madhavan) 表示：“得益于培养更高质量样本的新方法，我们能够观察到对温度和磁场做出完全响应的光谱特征，正如对密度波应有的那样。”

paras.en: "We even showed that the modes persist above the temperature at which superconductivity disappears, a tell-tale theoretical prediction that has not been convincingly observed before now."
paras.zh: “我们甚至证明，这些模式在超导性消失的温度以上仍然存在，这是一个有说服力的理论预测，但此前尚未被令人信服地观察到。”

paras.en: This doesn't mean bulk superconductivity is happening in uranium ditelluride at higher temperatures, but it does help physicists understand how Cooper pairs function and how they can exist outside of the conventional superconducting state.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着二碲化铀在较高温度下会发生体超导，但它确实有助于物理学家了解库珀对如何发挥作用以及它们如何存在于常规超导状态之外。

paras.en: It could also help researchers better understand the physics needed to develop superconductors at higher temperatures. Such advances could eventually make these materials more widely usable.
paras.zh: 它还可以帮助研究人员更好地了解在更高温度下开发超导体所需的物理原理。这些进步最终可能使这些材料得到更广泛的使用。

paras.en: There's another electron ripple state called charge density waves (CDWs), where some electrons take on non-uniform patterns. Understanding how these waves are connected to PDWs will be crucial in interpreting experimental results in the future.
paras.zh: 还有另一种电子波纹状态，称为电荷密度波 (CDW)，其中一些电子呈现不均匀的图案。了解这些波如何与 PDW 连接对于解释未来的实验结果至关重要。

paras.en: "PDWs are tricky to analyze in real materials, because they behave like conventional superconductors in some experiments, and like CDWs in [others]," says physicist Julian May-Mann from Stanford University.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学的物理学家朱利安·梅-曼 (Julian May-Mann) 表示：“在实际材料中分析 PDW 很棘手，因为它们在某些实验中表现得像传统超导体，而在其他实验中则像 CDW。”

paras.en: "Confirming the existence of a PDW requires both high-quality experimental data as well as careful theoretical analysis."
paras.zh: “确认PDW的存在既需要高质量的实验数据，也需要仔细的理论分析。”

paras.en: The research has been published in PNAS.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。

articles.title: Scientists discover a surprising twist in Japan's 7,300-year-old volcanic apocalypse

paras.en: Scientists discover a surprising twist in Japan's 7,300-year-old volcanic apocalypse
paras.zh: 科学家在日本 7,300 年前的火山灾难中发现了惊人的转折

paras.en: - A catastrophic volcanic eruption 7,300 years ago devastated Japan, but new research reveals that its impact on prehistoric populations was far more complex than previously believed. While some communities disappeared or declined, others unexpectedly flourished as survivors migrated, adapted, and found new ways to thrive.
paras.zh: - 7,300 年前的一场灾难性火山喷发摧毁了日本，但新的研究表明，它对史前人类的影响远比之前认为的复杂得多。虽然一些社区消失或衰落，但随着幸存者迁移、适应并找到新的发展方式，另一些社区却出人意料地蓬勃发展。

paras.en: A massive volcanic eruption that struck Japan about 7,300 years ago had a devastating impact on prehistoric communities, but its aftermath was far more complicated than scientists once believed. While some populations declined or disappeared from affected areas, others continued to grow despite the destruction.
paras.zh: 大约 7,300 年前袭击日本的大规模火山喷发对史前社区造成了毁灭性影响，但其后果远比科学家曾经认为的复杂。虽然受影响地区的一些种群数量减少或消失，但其他种群尽管遭到破坏，但仍继续增长。

paras.en: An international research team led by Lund University investigated how the Kikai-Akahoya eruption changed population patterns across Japan. Their findings challenge the idea that the disaster either completely wiped out nearby communities or left them largely unaffected. Instead, the researchers uncovered a surprising mix of population decline, migration, adaptation, and growth.
paras.zh: 由隆德大学领导的一个国际研究小组调查了吉凯-阿卡霍亚火山喷发如何改变了日本各地的人口模式。他们的发现挑战了这样一种观点，即这场灾难要么完全摧毁了附近的社区，要么基本上未受影响。相反，研究人员发现了人口下降、迁移、适应和增长的令人惊讶的组合。

paras.en: A Catastrophic Volcanic Eruption in Ancient Japan
paras.zh: 古代日本的灾难性火山喷发

paras.en: When the Kikai-Akahoya volcano erupted beneath the sea approximately 7,300 years ago, Japan was home to Jomon communities that depended on hunting and gathering for survival.
paras.zh: 大约 7,300 年前，当 Kikai-Akahoya 火山在海底喷发时，日本是依靠狩猎和采集为生的绳文社区的家园。

paras.en: "This eruption must have been devastating, exploding out of the seabed with little warning. It battered the Japanese islands with powerful earthquakes and enormous tsunamis, and then blanketed the landscape with meters of volcanic ash," explains senior author Peter Jordan, professor in archaeology at Lund University.
paras.zh: 隆德大学考古学教授、资深作者彼得·乔丹（Peter Jordan）解释说：“这次火山喷发一定是毁灭性的，它在没有任何预警的情况下从海底爆炸出来。它以强烈的地震和巨大的海啸袭击了日本岛屿，然后用数米厚的火山灰覆盖了整个地区。”

paras.en: For decades, archaeologists have disagreed about what happened to the people living near the eruption. One theory describes an almost complete apocalypse, with human populations abruptly disappearing from areas closest to the eruption. Another suggests that some communities managed to survive even relatively close to the disaster.
paras.zh: 几十年来，考古学家对于火山喷发附近居民的遭遇一直存在分歧。一种理论描述了一场几乎彻底的灾难，人口从最接近火山喷发的地区突然消失。另一项研究表明，一些社区甚至在距离灾难相对较近的地方也设法幸存下来。

paras.en: The new findings indicate that neither explanation fully captures what happened. The eruption severely damaged ecosystems, forced people from their homes, and made some regions uninhabitable. Yet evidence also points to remarkable adaptability among survivors, with certain populations actually increasing after the catastrophe.
paras.zh: 新的发现表明，这两种解释都没有完全反映所发生的事情。火山喷发严重破坏了生态系统，迫使人们离开家园，并使一些地区无法居住。然而，证据也表明幸存者具有显着的适应能力，某些种群在灾难后实际上有所增加。

paras.en: "The disaster caused major loss of life. However, survivors migrated, forged new social relations, innovated new kinds of economy, and appear to have found creative ways to exist and later thrive in the new post-disaster conditions," says lead author Enrico Crema, professor at Cambridge University.
paras.zh: “这场灾难造成了重大生命损失。然而，幸存者迁移，建立了新的社会关系，创新了新的经济形式，并且似乎找到了创造性的生存方式，并在灾后的新条件下蓬勃发展，”第一作者、剑桥大学教授恩里科·克雷马说。

paras.en: How the Volcanic Disaster Reshaped Japan's Population
paras.zh: 火山灾难如何重塑日本人口

paras.en: The researchers identified striking differences in how communities across Japan responded to the eruption.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，日本各地社区对火山喷发的反应存在显着差异。

paras.en: In southern Kyushu, Jomon populations had already been shrinking long before the volcano erupted. By the time the disaster occurred, relatively few people remained in the region, which was primarily visited by highly mobile groups of foragers.
paras.zh: 在九州南部，早在火山爆发之前，绳文人口就已经在减少。灾难发生时，该地区的人口相对较少，主要是流动性很强的采集者群体。

paras.en: Northern Kyushu followed a very different pattern. Its population had been increasing before the eruption, and that growth continued through the catastrophe and afterward, even though the surrounding ecosystems experienced extensive and lasting damage. The researchers suggest that people fleeing the most severely affected regions may have contributed to this unexpected population growth.
paras.zh: 九州北部则遵循着截然不同的模式。在火山喷发之前，其人口一直在增加，并且在灾难期间和之后持续增长，尽管周围的生态系统遭受了广泛而持久的破坏。研究人员认为，逃离受影响最严重地区的人们可能是造成这种意外人口增长的原因。

paras.en: Evidence also indicates that survivors who had lived inland relocated toward the northern coast. Marine ecosystems in these areas recovered relatively quickly, providing valuable food resources. By developing new ways to take advantage of the sea's abundance, these communities may have supported further population growth.
paras.zh: 有证据还表明，居住在内陆的幸存者迁往北部海岸。这些地区的海洋生态系统恢复相对较快，提供了宝贵的食物资源。通过开发利用海洋资源的新方法，这些社区可能支持了人口的进一步增长。

paras.en: Perhaps even more surprising, the researchers identified population changes in parts of Japan much farther from the eruption.
paras.zh: 也许更令人惊讶的是，研究人员发现距离火山喷发较远的日本部分地区的人口变化。

paras.en: These distant regions had experienced population growth before the catastrophe, but afterward, that growth stalled or even reversed. Such widespread demographic consequences had not previously been recognized.
paras.zh: 这些偏远地区在灾难发生前经历了人口增长，但灾难之后，增长停滞甚至逆转。此前并未认识到如此广泛的人口影响。

paras.en: Several possible explanations could account for these changes. The eruption may have caused temporary climate disruptions that affected communities across Japan. Another possibility involves severe tooth wear among deer and wild boar, two important food sources for the Jomon (possibly a consequence of the animals grazing in ash-covered landscapes). Other volcanic effects on human health and living conditions may also have contributed.
paras.zh: 有几种可能的解释可以解释这些变化。这次火山喷发可能造成了暂时的气候破坏，影响了日本各地的社区。另一种可能性涉及鹿和野猪的严重牙齿磨损，这是绳文人的两种重要食物来源（可能是动物在灰烬覆盖的地区放牧的结果）。火山对人类健康和生活条件的其他影响也可能有所贡献。

paras.en: Together, these findings suggest that the consequences of a massive natural disaster can extend well beyond the areas experiencing the most immediate destruction.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明，大规模自然灾害的后果可能远远超出遭受最直接破坏的地区。

paras.en: According to Jordan, the results demonstrate that the effects of catastrophes are rarely straightforward. Even when faced with overwhelming destruction, human communities can respond in different ways, depending on their circumstances and the choices available to them.
paras.zh: 乔丹表示，结果表明灾难的影响很少是直接的。即使面临压倒性的破坏，人类社区也可以根据自己的情况和可用的选择以不同的方式做出反应。

paras.en: "This study helps in creating a deeper understanding of the contingent ways in which cultures and societies cope with sudden shocks and catastrophes. Even in the most impossible situations, survivors and communities have choices, however limited: they need to act and make decisions; they need to adjust, collaborate, and find new connections and social networks," he concludes.
paras.zh: “这项研究有助于更深入地了解文化和社会应对突发冲击和灾难的偶然方式。即使在最不可能的情况下，幸存者和社区也有选择，无论选择多么有限：他们需要采取行动并做出决定；他们需要调整、合作并寻找新的联系和社交网络，”他总结道。

paras.en: Materials provided by Lund University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由隆德大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Enrico R. Crema, Mitsuhiro Kuwahata, Junzo Uchiyama, Ari Junno, Felix Riede, Peter D. Jordan. Divergent demographic responses to the Kikai-Akahoya volcanic catastrophe in mid-Holocene Japan. Science Advances, 2026; 12 (42) DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aeh7197
paras.zh: - Enrico R. Crema、Mitsuhiro Kuwahata、Junzo Uchiyama、Ari Junno、Felix Riede、Peter D. Jordan。日本全新世中期 Kikai-Akahoya 火山灾难的不同人口反应。科学进展，2026； 12 (42) DOI：10.1126/sciadv.aeh7197

articles.title: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish

paras.en: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
paras.zh: 神奇蘑菇成分使攻击性鱼类不再战斗

paras.en: Scientists discovered that the psychedelic compound in magic mushrooms can calm highly aggressive fish without disrupting their normal social behavior.
paras.zh: 科学家发现，迷幻蘑菇中的迷幻化合物可以安抚高度攻击性的鱼类，而不会扰乱它们的正常社会行为。

paras.en: - A psychedelic compound found in magic mushrooms appears to have an unexpected effect: calming highly aggressive fish. Researchers discovered that low doses of psilocybin significantly reduced aggressive attacks in mangrove rivulus fish without disrupting their normal social interactions. The findings suggest psilocybin may selectively calm escalating aggression rather than simply suppressing all behavior.
paras.zh: - 在迷幻蘑菇中发现的迷幻化合物似乎具有意想不到的效果：使高度攻击性的鱼平静下来。研究人员发现，低剂量的裸盖菇素可显着减少红树林河溪鱼的攻击性攻击，而不会破坏其正常的社交互动。研究结果表明，裸盖菇素可以选择性地平息不断升级的攻击行为，而不是简单地抑制所有行为。

paras.en: Psilocybin, the psychedelic substance found in more than 200 species of mushrooms, appears to have an unexpected effect on aggressive fish. Most mushrooms containing this compound belong to the gilled mushroom genus Psilocybe. In mammals, psilocybin interacts with serotonin receptors in the brain, influencing emotions and behaviors such as mood, appetite, and aggression. However, scientists still know relatively little about how the substance affects social interactions among animals.
paras.zh: 裸盖菇素是一种在 200 多种蘑菇中发现的迷幻物质，它似乎对攻击性鱼类具有意想不到的效果。大多数含有这种化合物的蘑菇属于裸盖菇属。在哺乳动物中，裸盖菇素与大脑中的血清素受体相互作用，影响情绪和行为，如情绪、食欲和攻击性。然而，科学家们对该物质如何影响动物之间的社会互动仍然知之甚少。

paras.en: To investigate this question, researchers in Canada examined the effects of psilocybin on the amphibious mangrove rivulus fish (Kryptolebias marmoratus). Their findings, published in Frontiers in Behavioral Neuroscience, suggest that even a brief exposure to a low dose can significantly reduce aggressive behavior without disrupting normal social interactions.
paras.zh: 为了研究这个问题，加拿大的研究人员研究了裸盖菇素对两栖红树林河鱼（Kryptolebias marmoratus）的影响。他们发表在《行为神经科学前沿》上的研究结果表明，即使是短暂接触低剂量也可以显着减少攻击性行为，而不会破坏正常的社交互动。

paras.en: "We show that an acute, low dose of psilocybin significantly reduces activity and aggressive attack behavior during social interactions in adult mangrove rivulus fish, a species that is naturally highly aggressive," said first author Dayna Forsyth, a research associate and former MSc student at Acadia University in Nova Scotia.
paras.zh: “我们发现，急性、低剂量的裸盖菇素可显着降低成年红树林河溪鱼在社交互动过程中的活动和攻击性攻击行为，红树林河溪鱼是一种天生具有高度攻击性的物种，”第一作者、新斯科舍省阿卡迪亚大学的助理研究员、前理学硕士生戴娜·福赛思 (Dayna Forsyth) 说。

paras.en: "These findings provide the first evidence that psilocybin can selectively reduce escalated aggression in a vertebrate model without suppressing social interaction," added senior author Dr. Suzie Currie, a biologist at The University of British Columbia.
paras.zh: “这些发现提供了第一个证据，证明裸盖菇素可以选择性地减少脊椎动物模型中的攻击性升级，而不抑制社会互动，”资深作者、不列颠哥伦比亚大学生物学家 Suzie Currie 博士补充道。

paras.en: Why Scientists Studied Aggressive Mangrove Rivulus Fish
paras.zh: 为什么科学家研究攻击性红树林河鱼

paras.en: Mangrove rivulus fish are naturally combative, particularly when they encounter another member of their species. Their aggressive responses are easy to recognize and measure, allowing researchers to detect even small changes in behavior.
paras.zh: 红树林河溪鱼天生好斗，特别是当它们遇到同种的其他成员时。它们的攻击性反应很容易识别和测量，使研究人员能够检测到行为的微小变化。

paras.en: These fish also have an unusual reproductive ability. They can fertilize themselves, producing offspring that are genetically identical. This makes them especially useful for experiments because scientists can minimize genetic variation and more confidently attribute behavioral differences to psilocybin rather than inherited traits.
paras.zh: 这些鱼还具有不寻常的繁殖能力。它们可以自我受精，产生基因相同的后代。这使得它们对于实验特别有用，因为科学家可以最大限度地减少遗传变异，并更自信地将行为差异归因于裸盖菇素而不是遗传特征。

paras.en: For the experiment, the researchers worked with three genetically distinct lines of fish bred in the laboratory. One group received psilocybin, another provided the fish used to provoke social interactions, and the third helped researchers measure how much psilocybin entered and accumulated in the animals' bodies.
paras.zh: 在这项实验中，研究人员使用了实验室培育的三种基因不同的鱼类。一组接受裸盖菇素，另一组提供用于激发社交互动的鱼，第三组帮助研究人员测量有多少裸盖菇素进入并在动物体内积累。

paras.en: The researchers first established a baseline for each fish's behavior. They placed a fish into a tank already occupied by another fish, with the two separated by a fiberglass mesh barrier and an opaque cover. The mesh prevented physical contact while allowing the fish to see and smell each other once the cover was removed.
paras.zh: 研究人员首先为每条鱼的行为建立了基线。他们将一条鱼放入已经被另一条鱼占据的鱼缸中，两条鱼用玻璃纤维网屏障和不透明的盖子隔开。网状结构可以防止身体接触，同时一旦盖子被移除，鱼就可以看到对方并闻到对方的气味。

paras.en: After allowing five minutes for the fish to adjust to their shared environment, the team removed the opaque cover and recorded their interactions.
paras.zh: 在让鱼适应共享环境五分钟后，研究小组移除了不透明的盖子并记录了它们的互动。

paras.en: The following day, 24 hours after the initial observation, the researchers placed the same fish in water containing dissolved psilocybin. Following 20 minutes of exposure, they returned it to the tank with the same fish it had encountered previously. The opaque cover was then removed again so the researchers could observe any changes in behavior.
paras.zh: 第二天，即初次观察 24 小时后，研究人员将同一条鱼放入含有溶解的裸盖菇素的水中。暴露20分钟后，他们将它与之前遇到的同一条鱼一起放回水箱中。然后再次移除不透明的盖子，以便研究人员可以观察行为的任何变化。

paras.en: Magic Mushroom Compound Reduces Aggressive Attacks
paras.zh: 神奇蘑菇化合物可减少攻击性攻击

paras.en: The results revealed a striking change. Fish exposed to psilocybin moved around less and displayed fewer bursts of aggressive swimming than fish that had not received the substance.
paras.zh: 结果显示出显着的变化。与未接受裸盖菇素的鱼相比，接触裸盖菇素的鱼游动较少，并且表现出较少的攻击性游动。

paras.en: To assess these changes, the scientists measured overall activity (time spent moving) and several signs of aggression (including swimming bursts). These rapid bursts are particularly important because they indicate that an encounter is escalating toward an attack, even when the fish cannot make physical contact.
paras.zh: 为了评估这些变化，科学家们测量了整体活动（移动时间）和几种攻击性迹象（包括游泳爆发）。这些快速爆发特别重要，因为它们表明遭遇正在升级为攻击，即使鱼无法进行身体接触。

paras.en: "Swimming bursts are high-energy attack behaviors that represent an escalation of aggression towards the stimulus fish without making physical contact," explained Currie. "Other types of aggressive behaviors, like head-on displays, are more about communication and social assessment and require very little energy."
paras.zh: 柯里解释说：“爆发性游泳是一种高能量的攻击行为，代表着在没有身体接触的情况下对刺激鱼的攻击性升级。” “其他类型的攻击行为，比如正面展示，更多的是关于沟通和社会评估，并且需要很少的能量。”

paras.en: Interestingly, psilocybin did not suppress every form of aggressive or social behavior. While the fish became less likely to engage in intense, energy-demanding attacks, their less physically demanding social displays remained largely unchanged.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，裸盖菇素并没有抑制所有形式的攻击性或社会行为。虽然这些鱼不太可能进行激烈的、需要能量的攻击，但它们对体力要求较低的社交表现基本保持不变。

paras.en: "Psilocybin's calming effect appears to selectively reduce energetically costly, escalated behaviors while lower-energy social display behaviors remained largely unchanged," said Forsyth. "This suggests that this compound can selectively dampen escalated social conflict rather than shutting down behavior altogether."
paras.zh: 福赛斯说：“赛洛西宾的镇静作用似乎可以选择性地减少耗费精力的升级行为，而低能量的社交表现行为则基本保持不变。” “这表明这种化合物可以选择性地抑制不断升级的社会冲突，而不是完全阻止行为。”

paras.en: The compound also reduced general activity. When placed alongside another member of their species, fish treated with psilocybin spent less time swimming than untreated controls.
paras.zh: 该化合物还降低了一般活性。当与同一物种的另一个成员放在一起时，经过裸盖菇素处理的鱼比未经处理的对照鱼游泳的时间更少。

paras.en: Together, these findings suggest that psilocybin may influence specific aspects of aggressive behavior rather than simply making animals less responsive to their surroundings.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明裸盖菇素可能会影响攻击行为的特定方面，而不仅仅是使动物对周围环境的反应减弱。

paras.en: What the Findings Could Mean for Psychedelic Research
paras.zh: 这些发现对迷幻剂研究意味着什么

paras.en: The researchers believe animal studies like this one could eventually help scientists better understand how psychedelic compounds influence behavior and identify possible directions for therapeutic research.
paras.zh: 研究人员相信，像这样的动物研究最终可以帮助科学家更好地了解迷幻化合物如何影响行为，并确定治疗研究的可能方向。

paras.en: By examining which social responses are most sensitive to psilocybin, researchers may be able to uncover biological mechanisms that are difficult to investigate directly in people. Such insights could ultimately inform studies of potential clinical applications.
paras.zh: 通过研究哪些社会反应对裸盖菇素最敏感，研究人员或许能够揭示难以直接在人类身上研究的生物机制。这些见解最终可以为潜在临床应用的研究提供信息。

paras.en: However, the team emphasized that the findings should not be interpreted as evidence of a treatment for aggression in humans. The experiment involved fish, did not evaluate any clinical intervention, and cannot establish whether similar effects would occur in people.
paras.zh: 然而，研究小组强调，这些发现不应被解释为治疗人类攻击行为的证据。该实验涉及鱼类，没有评估任何临床干预，也无法确定类似的效果是否会发生在人类身上。

paras.en: There are also important questions about how long the calming effect lasts. The researchers examined only single doses and short exposure periods. They did not investigate repeated treatments, long-term behavioral changes, or whether the fish might adapt to the substance over time.
paras.zh: 还有一个重要的问题是镇静效果能持续多久。研究人员仅检查了单剂量和短暴露时间。他们没有调查重复治疗、长期行为变化，或者鱼是否会随着时间的推移而适应这种物质。

paras.en: Additional experiments will be necessary to determine whether psilocybin's ability to reduce aggressive attacks can persist beyond the brief period examined in this study.
paras.zh: 还需要进行额外的实验来确定裸盖菇素减少攻击性攻击的能力是否能够在本研究检查的短暂时期后持续存在。

paras.en: "Future studies can build on this work to explore how psilocybin alters neural signaling, which serotonin pathways are involved, and why some aspects of social behavior are affected while others are not," concluded Currie. "These are questions that are difficult or impossible to answer directly in humans."
paras.zh: “未来的研究可以在这项工作的基础上探索裸盖菇素如何改变神经信号传导、涉及哪些血清素途径，以及为什么社会行为的某些方面受到影响而其他方面却没有受到影响，”柯里总结道。 “这些问题很难或不可能在人类身上直接回答。”

paras.en: - Dayna Forsyth, Nicoletta Faraone, Simon G. Lamarre, Suzanne Currie. The magic of mushrooms: psilocybin influences behavior in the mangrove rivulus fish, Kryptolebias marmoratus. Frontiers in Behavioral Neuroscience, 2026; 20 DOI: 10.3389/fnbeh.2026.1767175
paras.zh: - Dayna Forsyth、Nicoletta Faraone、Simon G. Lamarre、Suzanne Currie。蘑菇的魔力：裸盖菇素影响红树林溪流鱼（Kryptolebias marmoratus）的行为。行为神经科学前沿，2026； 20 DOI：10.3389/fnbeh.2026.1767175

articles.title: Scientists link a strange sugar in red meat to a 63% higher diabetes risk

paras.en: Scientists link a strange sugar in red meat to a 63% higher diabetes risk
paras.zh: 科学家将红肉中的一种奇怪的糖与糖尿病风险增加 63% 联系起来

paras.en: - European Association for the Study of Diabetes
paras.zh: - 欧洲糖尿病研究协会

paras.en: - A study of nearly 90,000 adults found that people consuming the most of a little-known sugar found in red meat had a 63% higher risk of developing type 2 diabetes. Scientists suspect the sugar may trigger chronic inflammation, potentially revealing a hidden connection between red meat and diabetes that goes beyond weight gain.
paras.zh: - 一项针对近 90,000 名成年人的研究发现，食用红肉中一种鲜为人知的糖分最多的人，患 2 型糖尿病的风险会增加 63%。科学家怀疑糖可能会引发慢性炎症，这可能揭示红肉和糖尿病之间的隐藏联系，而不仅仅是体重增加。

paras.en: A sugar naturally present in red meat may help explain why eating these foods has been associated with a higher risk of type 2 diabetes. Preliminary findings from a large observational study suggest that people who consume the most of this sugar face a substantially greater risk of developing the disease, potentially because of its effects on the immune system and chronic inflammation.
paras.zh: 红肉中天然存在的糖可能有助于解释为什么吃这些食物会增加患 2 型糖尿病的风险。一项大型观察性研究的初步结果表明，摄入最多这种糖的人患这种疾病的风险要大得多，这可能是因为它对免疫系统和慢性炎症的影响。

paras.en: The sugar, known as N-glycolylneuraminic acid (Neu5Gc), is particularly common in beef and lamb. Researchers found that participants with the highest intake of meat-derived Neu5Gc had a 63% higher risk of developing type 2 diabetes (T2D) compared with those who consumed the least.
paras.zh: 这种糖被称为 N-乙醇酰神经氨酸 (Neu5Gc)，在牛肉和羊肉中特别常见。研究人员发现，与肉类 Neu5Gc 摄入量最少的参与者相比，摄入肉类 Neu5Gc 最多的参与者患 2 型糖尿病 (T2D) 的风险高出 63%。

paras.en: The association remained statistically significant after researchers accounted for several established diabetes risk factors, including physical activity, overall diet, smoking, and existing health conditions. It became weaker after body mass index (BMI) was also considered, but remained significant.
paras.zh: 在研究人员考虑了几个已确定的糖尿病风险因素（包括体力活动、总体饮食、吸烟和现有健康状况）后，这种关联在统计上仍然显着。在考虑体重指数（BMI）后，它变得更弱，但仍然显着。

paras.en: The findings were presented at the Annual Meeting of The European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) in Milan, Italy.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在意大利米兰举行的欧洲糖尿病研究协会 (EASD) 年会上。

paras.en: “Our findings support chronic inflammation as a specific mechanism linking red meat consumption with T2D, partly beyond the amount of red meat a person eats and partly independent of body fat,” said lead author Dr. Leopold Fezeu from the Université Sorbonne Paris Nord, Bobigny, France.
paras.zh: 法国博比尼巴黎北索邦大学的主要作者 Leopold Fezeu 博士说：“我们的研究结果支持慢性炎症是一种将红肉摄入与 T2D 联系起来的特定机制，部分超出了一个人吃红肉的量，部分与身体脂肪无关。”

paras.en: The researchers also observed that diabetes risk generally increased with greater consumption of meat-derived Neu5Gc, particularly among those with the highest exposure.
paras.zh: 研究人员还观察到，糖尿病风险通常会随着肉类 Neu5Gc 摄入量的增加而增加，尤其是那些摄入量最高的人。

paras.en: “Although we do not know exactly what levels of Neu5Gc trigger an immune response, our data suggest that higher intakes of meat-derived Neu5Gc are associated with a progressively higher risk of T2D.”
paras.zh: “虽然我们不知道到底什么水平的 Neu5Gc 会引发免疫反应，但我们的数据表明，较高的肉类来源的 Neu5Gc 摄入量与逐渐升高的 T2D 风险相关。”

paras.en: Why a Sugar in Red Meat May Trigger Inflammation
paras.zh: 为什么红肉中的糖可能会引发炎症

paras.en: Neu5Gc is produced naturally by most mammals, but humans lost the ability to make it following an ancient mutation in the CMAH gene. Despite this evolutionary change, the sugar can still enter the human body through food.
paras.zh: Neu5Gc 是大多数哺乳动物自然产生的，但人类在 CMAH 基因的古老突变后失去了制造它的能力。尽管发生了这种进化变化，糖仍然可以通过食物进入人体。

paras.en: It occurs in red meat (particularly beef and lamb), with smaller amounts also found in dairy products.
paras.zh: 它存在于红肉（特别是牛肉和羊肉）中，乳制品中也存在少量。

paras.en: After Neu5Gc is consumed, the body absorbs it and can incorporate it into human tissues. Because humans do not naturally produce the molecule, the immune system may recognize it as foreign. Scientists classify it as a xeno-autoantigen, a foreign substance that becomes incorporated into the body's own tissues and can provoke an immune reaction.
paras.zh: Neu5Gc被消耗后，身体会吸收它并可以将其融入人体组织中。由于人类不会自然产生这种分子，因此免疫系统可能会将其识别为外来分子。科学家将其归类为异种自身抗原，这是一种融入人体自身组织并能引发免疫反应的外来物质。

paras.en: In response, the immune system produces antibodies against Neu5Gc. The resulting prolonged immune activity, called xenosialitis (xenosialitis), has previously been associated with cardiovascular disease and cancer.
paras.zh: 作为回应，免疫系统会产生针对 Neu5Gc 的抗体。由此产生的长期免疫活动被称为异唾液炎（xenosialitis），此前已被认为与心血管疾病和癌症有关。

paras.en: Researchers suspect that this persistent inflammatory response could also contribute to type 2 diabetes. However, before this investigation, no large prospective study had examined whether dietary Neu5Gc might promote diabetes through chronic inflammation.
paras.zh: 研究人员怀疑这种持续的炎症反应也可能导致 2 型糖尿病。然而，在这项研究之前，还没有大型前瞻性研究检验饮食 Neu5Gc 是否可能通过慢性炎症促进糖尿病。

paras.en: Nearly 90,000 Adults Studied Over Several Years
paras.zh: 几年来近 90,000 名成年人接受了研究

paras.en: To investigate the possible connection, the scientists analyzed dietary and health information from 89,953 adults participating in NutriNet-Santé, a large French observational study that follows people over time to examine how nutrition and lifestyle influence health.
paras.zh: 为了调查可能的联系，科学家们分析了参与 NutriNet-Santé 的 89,953 名成年人的饮食和健康信息，这是一项法国大型观察性研究，随着时间的推移对人们进行跟踪，以检查营养和生活方式如何影响健康。

paras.en: Participants were 42 years old on average, and 79% were women. None had type 2 diabetes or cancer when they entered the study.
paras.zh: 参与者平均年龄 42 岁，其中 79% 是女性。参加研究时，没有人患有 2 型糖尿病或癌症。

paras.en: Each person completed three 24-hour dietary records. The research team then used a validated food database to calculate how much Neu5Gc participants were likely consuming based on the measured amounts of the sugar in different foods.
paras.zh: 每人完成三份24小时饮食记录。然后，研究小组使用经过验证的食物数据库，根据测量的不同食物中的糖含量来计算 Neu5Gc 参与者可能摄入的量。

paras.en: The analysis included a broad range of red meats, such as beef, lamb, pork, rabbit, goat, and game. Processed meats (such as bacon, sausages and cured meats) were evaluated as a separate category, while dairy products were analyzed independently.
paras.zh: 分析包括多种红肉，如牛肉、羊肉、猪肉、兔肉、山羊肉和野味。加工肉类（如培根、香肠和腌肉）作为一个单独的类别进行评估，而乳制品则进行独立分析。

paras.en: Using the dietary information, the researchers estimated total Neu5Gc intake from all reported foods. They then ranked participants separately by sex according to their intake of meat-derived Neu5Gc and divided them into five equally sized groups (quintiles).
paras.zh: 利用饮食信息，研究人员估计了所有报告食物中 Neu5Gc 的总摄入量。然后，他们根据肉类 Neu5Gc 的摄入量，按性别对参与者分别进行排名，并将他们分为五个大小相等的组（五分位数）。

paras.en: Diabetes risk was compared across these groups, using those with the lowest intake as the reference.
paras.zh: 使用摄入量最低的人群作为参考，比较这些人群的糖尿病风险。

paras.en: During a median follow-up period of 7.2 years, researchers recorded 966 new cases of type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 在中位随访 7.2 年期间，研究人员记录了 966 例新的 2 型糖尿病病例。

paras.en: Higher Red Meat Sugar Intake Linked to 63% Greater Diabetes Risk
paras.zh: 红肉糖摄入量越高，糖尿病风险增加 63%

paras.en: The results showed a significant relationship between meat-derived Neu5Gc consumption and the likelihood of developing type 2 diabetes. The association became particularly pronounced among participants with the highest estimated intake.
paras.zh: 结果显示，肉类 Neu5Gc 摄入量与患 2 型糖尿病的可能性之间存在显着关系。这种关联在估计摄入量最高的参与者中尤为明显。

paras.en: Compared with the lowest intake group, individuals in the highest group had a 63% greater risk of developing the disease. Those in the second-highest group had a 41% greater risk (men and women combined).
paras.zh: 与最低摄入量组相比，最高摄入量组的个体患这种疾病的风险增加了 63%。第二高组的人的风险高出 41%（男性和女性合计）。

paras.en: These estimates accounted for potentially influential factors, including age, sex, exercise habits, overall dietary quality, smoking, and existing medical conditions.
paras.zh: 这些估计考虑了潜在的影响因素，包括年龄、性别、运动习惯、整体饮食质量、吸烟和现有的医疗状况。

paras.en: The researchers also examined how much meat participants typically consumed.
paras.zh: 研究人员还检查了参与者通常消耗多少肉类。

paras.en: Among men in the highest Neu5Gc intake group, median red meat consumption was 97 grams daily (136 g including processed meat). For women, the corresponding amount was 73 grams (96 g).
paras.zh: 在 Neu5Gc 摄入量最高的男性中，每天红肉摄入量中位数为 97 克（包括加工肉类为 136 克）。对于女性来说，相应的量是73克（96克）。

paras.en: By comparison, men in the lowest intake group consumed a median of just 5 grams of red meat per day (21 g), while women consumed 0 grams (9 g).
paras.zh: 相比之下，摄入量最低组中的男性平均每天仅消耗 5 克红肉（21 克），而女性则消耗 0 克（9 克）。

paras.en: The relationship between Neu5Gc and diabetes was observed in both sexes, with no statistically significant evidence that it differed between men and women (see tables in notes to editors).
paras.zh: Neu5Gc 与糖尿病之间的关系在两性中均观察到，但没有统计学上显着的证据表明男性和女性之间存在差异（参见编者注中的表格）。

paras.en: The findings were also consistent when differences in total calorie intake were considered.
paras.zh: 当考虑总热量摄入的差异时，结果也是一致的。

paras.en: Researchers noticed that the increase in diabetes risk was especially steep at higher levels of Neu5Gc exposure. One possible explanation is that the immune system begins to respond more strongly after enough of the foreign sugar has accumulated in body tissues, although this proposed threshold mechanism has not been confirmed.
paras.zh: 研究人员注意到，当 Neu5Gc 暴露水平较高时，糖尿病风险的增加尤其急剧。一种可能的解释是，在身体组织中积累了足够的外来糖后，免疫系统开始做出更强烈的反应，尽管这种提出的阈值机制尚未得到证实。

paras.en: Importantly, when the analysis additionally accounted for the total amount of red meat consumed, the relationship between Neu5Gc and diabetes weakened and was no longer statistically significant. The direction of the association remained the same, however.
paras.zh: 重要的是，当分析另外考虑红肉消耗总量时，Neu5Gc 与糖尿病之间的关系减弱，不再具有统计显着性。然而，协会的方向保持不变。

paras.en: This means the researchers cannot determine whether Neu5Gc itself (rather than other components of red meat) is responsible for the increased risk. The findings suggest it could contribute to the relationship, but they do not establish that the sugar acts independently of red meat consumption.
paras.zh: 这意味着研究人员无法确定 Neu5Gc 本身（而不是红肉的其他成分）是否导致风险增加。研究结果表明，它可能有助于这种关系，但他们并没有证实糖的作用独立于红肉的摄入。

paras.en: Diabetes Risk May Extend Beyond Weight Gain
paras.zh: 糖尿病风险可能不仅仅限于体重增加

paras.en: Another notable finding was that obesity appeared to explain only a relatively small portion of the association.
paras.zh: 另一个值得注意的发现是，肥胖似乎只能解释这种关联的一小部分。

paras.en: According to the researchers' estimates, obesity accounted for approximately 13% of the relationship between meat-derived Neu5Gc consumption and type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 据研究人员估计，肉食性 Neu5Gc 摄入与 2 型糖尿病之间的关系中，肥胖约占 13%。

paras.en: This suggests that factors unrelated to excess body weight may contribute substantially to the observed connection.
paras.zh: 这表明与体重超重无关的因素可能对观察到的联系有重大贡献。

paras.en: One possibility is that immune reactions to Neu5Gc produce chronic inflammation that interferes with insulin-producing cells or tissues that normally respond to insulin. Such effects could potentially increase the likelihood of developing type 2 diabetes even without substantial weight gain.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是，对 Neu5Gc 的免疫反应会产生慢性炎症，干扰通常对胰岛素做出反应的胰岛素产生细胞或组织。即使体重没有大幅增加，这种影响也可能会增加患 2 型糖尿病的可能性。

paras.en: However, additional studies are necessary to establish whether these inflammatory processes actually explain the association.
paras.zh: 然而，还需要进行更多研究来确定这些炎症过程是否真正解释了这种关联。

paras.en: Why Dairy Products Showed Different Results
paras.zh: 为什么乳制品表现出不同的结果

paras.en: Although Neu5Gc occurs in both red meat and dairy products, the researchers found an important difference between these dietary sources.
paras.zh: 尽管 Neu5Gc 存在于红肉和乳制品中，但研究人员发现这些饮食来源之间存在重要差异。

paras.en: Higher consumption of Neu5Gc from dairy products was not associated with an increased risk of type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 乳制品中 Neu5Gc 的摄入量增加与 2 型糖尿病风险增加无关。

paras.en: This finding may reflect the relatively small amounts of Neu5Gc in cow's milk compared with red meats such as beef and lamb. The typically smaller amounts of Neu5Gc consumed through dairy servings may also contribute to the difference.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能反映出，与牛肉和羊肉等红肉相比，牛奶中的 Neu5Gc 含量相对较少。通过乳制品摄入的 Neu5Gc 通常较少，也可能导致这种差异。

paras.en: When the scientists considered Neu5Gc intake from all dietary sources combined, participants in the highest intake group had a 37% greater risk of developing type 2 diabetes compared with those in the lowest group.
paras.zh: 当科学家将所有饮食来源的 Neu5Gc 摄入量综合考虑时，摄入量最高组的参与者患 2 型糖尿病的风险比摄入量最低组的参与者高出 37%。

paras.en: That association appeared to be driven primarily by Neu5Gc obtained from red meat.
paras.zh: 这种关联似乎主要是由从红肉中获得的 Neu5Gc 驱动的。

paras.en: “Together, these findings suggest that the association between Neu5Gc and T2D may depend on its dietary source, with meat-derived Neu5Gc showing a stronger association with T2D risk than total dietary Neu5Gc,” said Dr. Fezeu. “There may be differences between sources, or other components of red meat may contribute.”
paras.zh: Fezeu 博士说：“总而言之，这些研究结果表明，Neu5Gc 与 T2D 之间的关联可能取决于其饮食来源，肉类来源的 Neu5Gc 与总膳食 Neu5Gc 相比，与 T2D 风险的关联性更强。” “来源之间可能存在差异，或者红肉的其他成分可能有所贡献。”

paras.en: Could Changing Protein Sources Lower Diabetes Risk?
paras.zh: 改变蛋白质来源可以降低糖尿病风险吗？

paras.en: The findings raise the possibility that reducing dietary exposure to meat-derived Neu5Gc could eventually become one approach to lowering diabetes risk.
paras.zh: 这些发现提出了一种可能性，即减少饮食中接触肉类衍生的 Neu5Gc 最终可能成为降低糖尿病风险的一种方法。

paras.en: However, researchers emphasize that studies are still needed to determine whether replacing foods rich in Neu5Gc with other protein sources would actually produce measurable health benefits.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员强调，仍需要进行研究来确定用其他蛋白质来源替代富含 Neu5Gc 的食物是否真的会产生可衡量的健康益处。

paras.en: “Given how common red meat is in Western diets, the strong association between meat-derived Neu5Gc and T2D risk is an important finding. Future research should explore whether reducing exposure to meat-derived Neu5Gc, for example by favoring poultry or plant-based proteins over beef and lamb, which have the highest Neu5Gc content, could help prevent T2D. Studies directly measuring anti-Neu5Gc antibodies in large cohorts would also help to directly test the xenosialitis mechanism in humans.”
paras.zh: “考虑到红肉在西方饮食中的普遍性，肉源性 Neu5Gc 与 T2D 风险之间的密切关联是一个重要的发现。未来的研究应该探讨是否减少接触肉源性 Neu5Gc（例如通过选择家禽或植物性蛋白质而不是 Neu5Gc 含量最高的牛肉和羊肉）是否有助于预防 T2D。在大群体中直接测量抗 Neu5Gc 抗体的研究也将有助于直接测试异种唾液炎机制。人类。”

paras.en: The research team plans to investigate how Neu5Gc interacts with other substances found in red meat, including heme iron (a form of dietary iron), and how these components may collectively relate to diabetes risk.
paras.zh: 研究小组计划研究 Neu5Gc 如何与红肉中发现的其他物质相互作用，包括血红素铁（膳食铁的一种形式），以及这些成分如何与糖尿病风险相关。

paras.en: They also intend to measure antibodies against Neu5Gc directly. Doing so could help determine whether the proposed immune response is an important biological mechanism connecting red meat consumption with type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 他们还打算直接测量针对 Neu5Gc 的抗体。这样做可以帮助确定所提出的免疫反应是否是将红肉消费与 2 型糖尿病联系起来的重要生物学机制。

paras.en: The researchers caution that their findings are preliminary and have not yet been validated. The reported estimates could change once the final analysis is completed.
paras.zh: 研究人员警告说，他们的发现是初步的，尚未得到验证。一旦最终分析完成，报告的估计可能会发生变化。

paras.en: Because the study was observational, it cannot establish that Neu5Gc causes type 2 diabetes or identify precisely which factors are responsible for the higher risk.
paras.zh: 由于该研究是观察性的，因此无法确定 Neu5Gc 是否会导致 2 型糖尿病，也无法准确确定哪些因素导致较高的风险。

paras.en: Although the analysis accounted for several established diabetes risk factors, unmeasured lifestyle and social influences could still have affected the results.
paras.zh: 尽管该分析考虑了几个已确定的糖尿病危险因素，但未测量的生活方式和社会影响仍然可能影响结果。

paras.en: There were also limitations in how dietary exposure was assessed. Neu5Gc consumption was estimated using participants' food records rather than measured directly, and the researchers did not account for possible dietary changes during the follow-up period. Both factors could have introduced errors into the exposure estimates.
paras.zh: 饮食暴露的评估方式也存在局限性。 Neu5Gc 的消耗量是根据参与者的食物记录估算的，而不是直接测量的，研究人员没有考虑随访期间可能的饮食变化。这两个因素都可能给暴露估计带来错误。

paras.en: The findings therefore offer a potential new explanation for the established connection between red meat consumption and diabetes, but further investigation is needed to determine whether Neu5Gc directly contributes to the disease.
paras.zh: 因此，这些发现为红肉摄入与糖尿病之间已建立的联系提供了一个潜在的新解释，但需要进一步研究以确定 Neu5Gc 是否直接导致该疾病。

paras.en: Table 1. Median Meat Consumption by Neu5Gc Intake
paras.zh: 表 1. Neu5Gc 摄入量的肉类消费中位数

paras.en: The table shows typical daily meat consumption in each of the five groups, ranked according to estimated intake of meat-derived Neu5Gc.
paras.zh: 该表显示了五组中每组的典型每日肉类消耗量，并根据肉类来源的 Neu5Gc 的估计摄入量进行排名。

paras.en: Participants were assigned to these groups based on their estimated Neu5Gc intake, calculated from all reported foods and their measured Neu5Gc content.
paras.zh: 参与者根据估计的 Neu5Gc 摄入量（根据所有报告的食物和测量的 Neu5Gc 含量计算）被分配到这些组。

paras.en: The meat consumption figures represent the typical amounts eaten by participants in each group. They do not establish a specific risk threshold or indicate how much meat can be considered safe.
paras.zh: 肉类消费数据代表每组参与者的典型食用量。他们没有建立具体的风险阈值或表明多少肉可以被认为是安全的。

paras.en: Table 2. Type 2 Diabetes Risk by Neu5Gc Intake
paras.zh: 表 2. Neu5Gc 摄入量的 2 型糖尿病风险

paras.en: Results for men and women combined, using the fully adjusted statistical model.
paras.zh: 使用完全调整的统计模型将男性和女性的结果相结合。

paras.en: The results suggest a similar association in men and women, without a statistically significant difference between the sexes.
paras.zh: 结果表明，男性和女性之间存在类似的关联，但性别之间没有统计学上的显着差异。

paras.en: However, relatively few diabetes cases occurred within each sex-specific intake group, making the separate estimates less precise. For this reason, the researchers presented their principal findings using the combined data.
paras.zh: 然而，每个特定性别摄入组中发生的糖尿病病例相对较少，使得单独的估计不太精确。因此，研究人员利用合并数据提出了他们的主要发现。

paras.en: Materials provided by European Association for the Study of Diabetes. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲糖尿病研究协会提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: 'Let's all choose to make tomorrow better', Artemis II astronauts honored with Stephen Hawking Medal at Starmus
articles.author: Daisy Dobrijevic

paras.en: TENERIFE, CANARY ISLANDS — The Artemis II astronauts may have traveled hundreds of thousands of miles away from Earth to the moon, but they made sure the rest of us didn't miss out on the adventure.
paras.zh: 加那利群岛特内里费岛——阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员可能已经从地球出发数十万英里来到月球，但他们确保我们其他人不会错过这次冒险。

paras.en: Now, their efforts to bring the wonders of space exploration back down to Earth have earned them one of science communication's most prestigious honors: the Stephen Hawking Medal.
paras.zh: 现在，他们将太空探索的奇迹带回地球的努力为他们赢得了科学传播界最负盛名的荣誉之一：斯蒂芬·霍金奖章。

paras.en: NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover, alongside Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen, accepted the award on Saturday (Oct. 17), during the opening ceremony of the Starmus VIII festival. The honor recognizes all four crew members, including NASA astronaut Christina Koch, who wasn't in attendance.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局宇航员 Reid Wiseman 和 Victor Glover 以及加拿大航天局宇航员 Jeremy Hansen 于周六（10 月 17 日）在 Starmus VIII 节日开幕式上接受了该奖项。该荣誉表彰了所有四名机组人员，包括没有出席的美国宇航局宇航员克里斯蒂娜·科赫。

paras.en: For Wiseman, the experience of seeing our home planet from the vicinity of the moon carried a powerful message.
paras.zh: 对于怀斯曼来说，从月球附近看到我们的家园星球的经历传递了一个强有力的信息。

paras.en: "If we could take each of you 250,000 miles away from this planet, 400,000 kilometers away from planet Earth, and you would see Earth the size of your thumb. It's tiny," Wiseman told the audience.
paras.zh: “如果我们能把你们每个人带到距离这个星球 25 万英里、距离地球 40 万公里的地方，你们就会看到地球只有拇指大小。它很小，”怀斯曼告诉观众。

paras.en: "When you're there looking through the moon, back at this tiny Earth, the only thing you feel is love, peace, hope, unity", he continued. "Those aren't the right words, but that is all you feel."
paras.zh: “当你透过月球，回到这个小小的地球时，你唯一感受到的就是爱、和平、希望、团结，”他继续说道。 “这些词不恰当，但这就是你的感受。”

paras.en: During their historic Artemis II mission, the astronauts did far more than put NASA's Orion spacecraft through its paces. Through live communications, interviews and glimpses into life aboard the spacecraft, not to mention the jaw-dropping photos that just keep on coming, they helped turn an extraordinarily complex mission into something people worldwide could experience and connect with.
paras.zh: 在历史性的阿耳忒弥斯二号任务中，宇航员所做的不仅仅是让美国宇航局的猎户座飞船完成其任务。通过现场交流、采访和对飞船上生活的一瞥，更不用说不断出现的令人瞠目结舌的照片，他们帮助将一项极其复杂的任务变成了全世界人民都可以体验和联系的东西。

paras.en: And that's exactly what the Stephen Hawking Medal is designed to celebrate.
paras.zh: 这正是斯蒂芬·霍金奖章旨在庆祝的目的。

paras.en: Established in 2016 by physicist Stephen Hawking and Starmus, the award honors those who have gone above and beyond to make science accessible, engaging and inspiring.
paras.zh: 该奖项由物理学家史蒂芬·霍金和 Starmus 于 2016 年设立，旨在表彰那些在让科学变得易于理解、引人入胜和鼓舞人心方面做出卓越贡献的人们。

paras.en: The Artemis II crew joins some pretty impressive company. Previous recipients include Apollo 11 moonwalker Buzz Aldrin, naturalist David Attenborough, primatologist Jane Goodall and astrophysicist Neil DeGrasse Tyson.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号船员加入了一些相当令人印象深刻的公司。此前的获奖者包括阿波罗 11 号月球漫步者巴兹·奥尔德林、自然学家大卫·阿滕伯勒、灵长类动物学家简·古道尔和天体物理学家尼尔·德格拉斯·泰森。

paras.en: This year's ceremony marks the medal's 10th anniversary, with filmmaker Ridley Scott also among the 2026 honourees.
paras.zh: 今年的颁奖典礼标志着该奖章成立 10 周年，电影制片人雷德利·斯科特 (Ridley Scott) 也是 2026 年获奖者之一。

paras.en: "It's a special thrill for us at Starmus to be able to honor the intrepid Artemis II crew members in the same way that we honored the Apollo astronauts who paved the way to the moon over 50 years ago," Starmus co-founder and Queen guitarist Brian May said in a statement ahead of the ceremony.
paras.zh: Starmus 联合创始人兼皇后乐队吉他手布莱恩·梅 (Brian May) 在仪式前的一份声明中表示：“对于 Starmus 来说，能够像向 50 多年前为登月之路铺平道路的阿波罗宇航员一样向勇敢的阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员致敬，这对我们来说是一种特别的兴奋。”

paras.en: Wiseman left the audience with one final thought.
paras.zh: 怀斯曼给观众留下了最后一个想法。

paras.en: "When you come home to this beautiful planet, you realise that it's in every single one of us to choose to make tomorrow better," he said. "So let's all choose to make tomorrow better".
paras.zh: “当你回到这个美丽的星球时，你会意识到我们每个人都有选择让明天变得更美好，”他说。 “所以让我们都选择让明天更美好”。

paras.en: Starmus VIII runs from Oct. 17-22 across Tenerife and La Palma in the Canary Islands. This year's festival, themed "The Search for Truth", brings together leading scientists, astronauts, musicians and artists to celebrate scientific discovery and explore the importance of evidence and scientific thinking.
paras.zh: Starmus VIII 将于 10 月 17 日至 22 日运行，穿越加那利群岛的特内里费岛和拉帕尔马岛。今年的节日以“寻找真理”为主题，汇集了领先的科学家、宇航员、音乐家和艺术家，庆祝科学发现并探索证据和科学思维的重要性。

paras.en: Daisy Dobrijevic joined Space.com in February 2022, having previously worked as a staff writer for All About Space magazine. She completed an editorial internship with BBC Sky at Night Magazine and worked at the National Space Centre, communicating space science to the public.
paras.zh: Daisy Dobrijevic 于 2022 年 2 月加入 Space.com，此前曾担任《All About Space》杂志的特约撰稿人。她完成了 BBC Sky 夜间杂志的编辑实习，并在国家航天中心工作，向公众传播空间科学。

paras.en: Daisy holds a PhD in plant physiology and a Master's in Environmental Science. Based in Nottingham, U.K., she covers all things space, with a special focus on solar activity and space weather. She also has a keen interest in astrotourism and is always on the lookout for the next northern lights adventure.
paras.zh: 黛西拥有植物生理学博士学位和环境科学硕士学位。她居住在英国诺丁汉，研究太空的所有事物，特别关注太阳活动和太空天气。她还对天文旅游有着浓厚的兴趣，并且总是在寻找下一次北极光冒险。

paras.en: She will join Hurtigruten as an onboard astronomer for a northern lights sailing in January 2027.
paras.zh: 她将作为船上天文学家加入海达路德号，于 2027 年 1 月进行北极光航行。

articles.title: 10 best places to see the 2027 total solar eclipse in Spain
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: Spain is one of the easiest places in the world to experience the total solar eclipse on Aug. 2, 2027. The so-called "eclipse of the century" first makes landfall in Andalucía, where totality will last up to 4 minutes and 40 seconds during mid-morning, with the sun comfortably high at around 38-42 degrees above the horizon in the eastern sky. Excellent roads, plentiful accommodation and Málaga's international airport make this an obvious alternative to North Africa and the Middle East.
paras.zh: 西班牙是世界上最容易在 2027 年 8 月 2 日看到日全食的地方之一。这场所谓的“世纪日全食”首先在安达卢西亚登陆，那里的日全食将在上午中旬持续长达 4 分 40 秒，东方天空中太阳的高度约为地平线 38-42 度。优良的道路、充足的住宿和马拉加的国际机场使其成为北非和中东的明显替代选择。

paras.en: However, choosing where to watch requires some thought. Southern Spain's narrowing shape funnels the path toward the Strait of Gibraltar, potentially concentrating huge numbers of eclipse chasers around Tarifa, the Costa del Sol and the British Overseas Territory of Gibraltar during the peak summer holiday season.
paras.zh: 然而，选择观看地点需要一些思考。西班牙南部的形状逐渐变窄，形成通往直布罗陀海峡的通道，在夏季假期高峰期间，可能会在塔里法、太阳海岸和英国海外领土直布罗陀周围聚集大量日食追逐者。

paras.en: From busy Mediterranean beaches to mountain villages, here's where to see the total solar eclipse on Aug. 2, 2027 in southern Spain. All times, totality durations and historical cloud cover data come from Time and Date.
paras.zh: 从繁忙的地中海海滩到山村，这里是 2027 年 8 月 2 日在西班牙南部观看日全食的地点。所有时间、总持续时间和历史云量数据均来自时间和日期。

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:45 a.m. CEST; 4 minutes, 40 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:45； 4分40秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 38 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经38度

paras.en: At the southernmost tip of mainland Europe, where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Mediterranean Sea, Tarifa is likely to be one of the country's busiest eclipse-watching locations because it will experience the longest totality in mainland Spain. Just 9 miles (14 km) across the Strait of Gibraltar from Morocco, the historic port town is known for its whitewashed old town, the medieval Castle of Guzmán el Bueno and its long, sandy beaches. Los Lances and Valdevaqueros offer wide horizons and plenty of open space.
paras.zh: 塔里法位于欧洲大陆最南端，大西洋与地中海的交汇处，可能是该国最繁忙的日食观测地点之一，因为它将经历西班牙大陆最长的日全食。这座历史悠久的港口小镇距离摩洛哥仅 9 英里（14 公里），横跨直布罗陀海峡，以其粉刷成白色的老城区、中世纪古兹曼埃尔布埃诺城堡及其绵长的沙滩而闻名。洛斯兰斯和巴尔德瓦克罗斯拥有广阔的视野和充足的开放空间。

paras.en: Location: Málaga province, Andalucía, Spain
paras.zh: 地点：西班牙安达卢西亚马拉加省

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:46 a.m. CEST; 3 minutes, 13 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:46； 3分13秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 38 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经38度

paras.en: For eclipse chasers who would rather head into the mountains than join the crowds on the Costa del Sol, Gaucín is an intriguing alternative. One of Andalucía's classic pueblos blancos, the whitewashed village occupies a spectacular position in the mountains above the coast, crowned by the ruins of Castillo del Águila. Its elevated setting offers sweeping views across the surrounding countryside towards Gibraltar and, on clear days, the mountains of North Africa. Crucially, heading inland doesn't sacrifice too much totality.
paras.zh: 对于那些宁愿进山也不愿加入太阳海岸人群的日食追逐者来说，高辛是一个有趣的选择。这座粉刷成白色的村庄是安达卢西亚经典的白色村庄之一，在海岸上方的群山中占据着壮观的位置，最顶端是阿吉拉城堡遗址。其地势较高，可以将周围乡村直至直布罗陀的景色尽收眼底，在晴朗的日子里，还可以看到北非的山脉。至关重要的是，前往内陆并不会牺牲太多整体性。

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:45 a.m. CEST; 4 minutes, 29 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:45； 4分29秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 38 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经38度

paras.en: Few places in Europe could provide a more dramatic setting for totality than Gibraltar, the tiny British Overseas Territory dominated by its famous 1,398-foot (426-meter) limestone Rock. However, eclipse chasers will need to view either from The Rock or its east coast, where elevated viewpoints and beaches face the Mediterranean and the eclipsed sun. However, Gibraltar has a potential complication — the easterly Levanter wind can create a distinctive cap of cloud over the Rock even when surrounding skies are clear. Another issue is accommodation, which is already at a premium. See Gibraltar Eclipse 2027.
paras.zh: 欧洲很少有地方能比直布罗陀提供更引人注目的全食环境，这是一块小小的英国海外领土，以其著名的 1,398 英尺（426 米）石灰岩为主。然而，日食追逐者需要从岩石区或其东海岸观看，那里的高处观景台和海滩面向地中海和日食。然而，直布罗陀有一个潜在的复杂情况——即使周围的天空晴朗，东风黎凡特风也会在直布罗陀上空形成独特的云层。另一个问题是住宿，这已经很昂贵了。请参阅 2027 年直布罗陀日食。

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:45 a.m. CEST; 4 minutes, 24 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:45； 4分24秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 38 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经38度

paras.en: Immediately north of Gibraltar, La Línea de la Concepción occupies the sandy isthmus between the Bay of Gibraltar and the Mediterranean Sea. Its location creates one of Spain's most distinctive possibilities for eclipse photography. On the Mediterranean side, Playa de Santa Bárbara is a wide sandy beach north of the border, with the immense Rock of Gibraltar rising to the south — a potentially spectacular foreground. The city has around 9 miles (14 kilometers) of coastline, providing plenty of alternatives for eclipse viewing.
paras.zh: 拉利内亚德拉康塞普西翁紧邻直布罗陀以北，占据直布罗陀湾和地中海之间的沙质地峡。它的地理位置创造了西班牙最独特的日食摄影可能性之一。在地中海一侧，圣巴巴拉海滩 (Playa de Santa Bárbara) 是边境以北的一片宽阔沙滩，南面是巨大的直布罗陀岩石，这是一个潜在的壮观前景。该市拥有约 9 英里（14 公里）的海岸线，为观看日食提供了多种选择。

paras.en: Location: Costa del Sol, Málaga province
paras.zh: 地点：马拉加省太阳海岸

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:46 a.m. CEST; 3 minutes, 41 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:46； 3分41秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 38 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经38度

paras.en: About an hour's drive southwest of Málaga Airport, Estepona is one of the Costa del Sol's most attractive resort towns, with a pedestrianized old quarter of whitewashed streets, colorful flowerpots and squares centered on Plaza de las Flores. For eclipse day, the mile-long Playa de la Rada is the obvious gathering place, with its broad Mediterranean horizon and proximity to the town center. Other attractions include Estepona Marina and the Sierra Bermeja mountains rising behind the coast.
paras.zh: 埃斯特波纳位于马拉加机场西南方向约一小时车程处，是太阳海岸最具吸引力的度假小镇之一，这里有老城区的步行街、粉刷成白色的街道、色彩缤纷的花盆和以弗洛雷斯广场为中心的广场。在日食日，一英里长的拉达海滩 (Playa de la Rada) 是明显的聚集地，这里拥有广阔的地中海地平线，并且靠近市中心。其他景点包括埃斯特波纳码头和海岸后面拔地而起的贝尔梅哈山脉。

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:45 a.m. CEST; 2 minutes, 56 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:45； 2分56秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 37 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经37度

paras.en: Historic Cádiz occupies a narrow peninsula jutting into the Atlantic and is packed with reminders of its long maritime past, including the Cádiz Cathedral, the Roman Theatre and Torre Tavira, one of more than 100 watchtowers once used to spot approaching ships. For eclipse day, the long, sandy Playa de la Victoria offers plenty of open space, while La Caleta provides a more historic setting between two coastal castles.
paras.zh: 历史悠久的加的斯占据了一个伸入大西洋的狭窄半岛，到处都是让人想起其悠久航海历史的遗迹，包括加的斯大教堂、罗马剧院和塔维拉塔（曾经用于发现来往船只的 100 多座瞭望塔之一）。在日食日，绵长的维多利亚海滩 (Playa de la Victoria) 提供了充足的开放空间，而拉卡莱塔 (La Caleta) 则在两座沿海城堡之间提供了更具历史意义的环境。

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:48 a.m. CEST; 2 minutes
paras.zh: 日全食开始时间和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:48； 2分钟

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 39 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经39度

paras.en: Málaga may lose some duration compared with locations farther west, but it makes up for it with excellent transport links, plentiful accommodation and all the attractions of a major Mediterranean city. It combines the hilltop Gibralfaro Castle and Moorish Alcazaba with a Roman theatre, cathedral, museums and a lively historic center. For eclipse day, the obvious option is the coast. La Malagueta beach is within walking distance of the city center, while numerous beaches extend east and west along the Costa del Sol.
paras.zh: 与更西边的地方相比，马拉加可能会损失一些时间，但它以其良好的交通网络、充足的住宿和地中海主要城市的所有景点弥补了这一点。它将山顶的吉布拉法罗城堡和摩尔人阿尔卡萨瓦与罗马剧院、大教堂、博物馆和热闹的历史中心融为一体。对于日食来说，显而易见的选择是海岸。拉马拉格塔 (La Malagueta) 海滩距离市中心仅几步之遥，众多海滩沿着太阳海岸 (Costa del Sol) 向东和向西延伸。

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:47 a.m. CEST; 2 minutes, 46 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始时间和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:47； 2分46秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 39 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经39度

paras.en: One of the best-known resorts on Spain's Costa del Sol, Torremolinos combines a long Mediterranean beachfront with easy access to Málaga and its international airport. Its 4-mile (6-kilometer) promenade links broad sandy beaches, including Playa del Bajondillo and Playa de la Carihuela, offering plenty of potential eclipse-watching spots with views toward the eastern sky. For a higher vantage point, nearby Mount Calamorro rises almost 2,600 feet (800 meters) above Benalmádena, with panoramic views across the Costa del Sol and, on clear days, towards Gibraltar and North Africa.
paras.zh: 托雷莫利诺斯是西班牙太阳海岸最著名的度假胜地之一，拥有绵长的地中海海滨，可轻松前往马拉加及其国际机场。其长 4 英里（6 公里）的海滨长廊连接着宽阔的沙滩，包括 Playa del Bajondillo 和 Playa de la Carihuela，提供了许多潜在的日食观赏点，可以欣赏到东方天空的景色。若想获得更高的观景点，附近的卡拉莫罗山 (Mount Calamorro) 海拔约 800 米（2,600 英尺），俯瞰贝纳尔马德纳 (Benalmádena)，可以欣赏到太阳海岸的全景，天气晴朗时还可以看到直布罗陀和北非的全景。

paras.en: Location: Costa del Sol, Málaga province
paras.zh: 地点：马拉加省太阳海岸

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:46 a.m. CEST; 3 minutes, 21 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:46； 3分21秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 38 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经38度

paras.en: Marbella has around 17 miles (27 kilometers) of Mediterranean coastline, so eclipse chasers will have dozens of beaches to choose from, from San Pedro de Alcántara in the west to Cabopino in the east. Options include the sandy beaches and dunes around Cabopino, Las Chapas, Puerto Banús and San Pedro de Alcántara, all with open views across the Mediterranean. Away from the beach, Marbella offers a whitewashed old town centered on Plaza de los Naranjos, while the Sierra Blanca mountains provide a dramatic backdrop to the resort.
paras.zh: 马贝拉拥有约 17 英里（27 公里）的地中海海岸线，因此日食追逐者将有数十个海滩可供选择，从西部的圣佩德罗德阿尔坎塔拉到东部的卡波皮诺。选项包括卡波皮诺、拉斯查帕斯、巴努斯港和圣佩德罗德阿尔坎塔拉周围的沙滩和沙丘，所有这些都可以欣赏到地中海的开阔景色。马贝拉远离海滩，拥有以洛斯纳兰霍斯广场为中心的粉刷成白色的老城区，而布兰卡山脉则为度假村提供了引人注目的背景。

paras.en: Location: Costa Tropical, Granada province
paras.zh: 地点：格拉纳达省热带海岸

paras.en: Start of totality and duration: 10:49 a.m. CEST; 1 minute, 57 seconds
paras.zh: 日全食开始和持续时间：欧洲中部夏令时间上午 10:49； 1分57秒

paras.en: Altitude of the sun: 39 degrees above east
paras.zh: 太阳高度角：东经39度

paras.en: Close to the northern edge of the path of totality, Motril gets a shorter eclipse than destinations farther west, but could be among the quieter places on Spain's Mediterranean coast from which to experience it. The largest town on Granada's Costa Tropical sits between the Mediterranean and the foothills of the Sierra de Lújar, with the Sierra Nevada rising beyond. Nearby Playa Granada and Playa Poniente offer broad coastal views.
paras.zh: 莫特里尔靠近全食路径的北部边缘，比更西边的目的地经历的日食时间更短，但可能是西班牙地中海沿岸较为安静的体验日食的地方之一。格拉纳达热带海岸最大的城镇位于地中海和卢哈尔山脉山麓之间，内华达山脉耸立在远处。附近的格拉纳达海滩 (Playa Granada) 和波尼恩特海滩 (Playa Poniente) 享有广阔的海岸景观。

paras.en: Jamie is an experienced science and travel journalist, stargazer and eclipse chaser who writes about exploring the night sky, solar and lunar eclipses, the Northern Lights, moon-gazing, astro-travel, astronomy and space exploration. He is the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com, author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners, co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and a senior contributor at Forbes.
paras.zh: 杰米是一位经验丰富的科学和旅行记者、观星者和日食追踪者，撰写有关探索夜空、日食和月食、北极光、观月、天体旅行、天文学和太空探索的文章。他是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑、《A Stargazing Program For Beginners》的作者、《The Eclipse Effect》的合著者以及《福布斯》的高级撰稿人。
