articles.title: How mini-constellations could more quickly bring new tech to Europe, and to orbit
articles.author: Space Inventor

paras.en: When the European thermal-imagery company constellr began working with Space Inventor on its next generation of satellites, some of the most important details of the spacecraft had yet to be finalized.
paras.zh: 当欧洲热成像公司 constellr 开始与 Space Inventor 合作开发下一代卫星时，航天器的一些最重要的细节尚未最终确定。

paras.en: The Munich-based firm knew it wanted its HiVE, or High-precision Versatile Ecosphere, constellation to measure temperatures from space with the precision needed for agricultural applications and urban planning. But the requirements for the payload’s size, weight and power were still evolving.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于慕尼黑的公司知道它希望其 HiVE（高精度多功能生态圈）星座能够以农业应用和城市规划所需的精度从太空测量温度。但对有效载荷的尺寸、重量和功率的要求仍在不断变化。

paras.en: That presented what can be a familiar tradeoff in the small satellite community. Work on satellite buses often begins before every detail of a payload has been finalized. If engineers lock in the spacecraft design too early, the payload may need to conform to the bus. If the payload needs new iterations, the bus may require an extensive – and expensive – redesign.
paras.zh: 这在小型卫星领域是一种常见的权衡。卫星总线的工作通常在有效载荷的每个细节最终确定之前就开始了。如果工程师过早锁定航天器设计，有效载荷可能需要符合总线。如果有效负载需要新的迭代，总线可能需要进行广泛且昂贵的重新设计。

paras.en: But Space Inventor, the Danish manufacturer, took a different approach. Instead of demanding the payload fit a standardized satellite bus, it adapted its BIG CAT 600 bus as constellr’s requirements evolved.
paras.zh: 但丹麦制造商 Space Inventor 采取了不同的方法。它没有要求有效载荷适合标准化卫星总线，而是随着 constellr 要求的变化而调整其 BIG CAT 600 总线。

paras.en: “We needed a platform built around the payload, not the other way around,” said Marius Bierdel, constellr’s co-founder and vice president of program management. “Space Inventor’s system-level approach means our thermal sensors perform exactly as designed once they’re in orbit.”
paras.zh: constellr 联合创始人兼项目管理副总裁 Marius Bierdel 表示：“我们需要一个围绕有效载荷构建的平台，而不是相反。” “Space Inventor 的系统级方法意味着我们的热传感器一旦进入轨道，就能完全按照设计运行。”

paras.en: That ability to repeatedly modify the spacecraft is the centerpiece of Space Inventor’s pitch to operators who need to build payload-centric mini-constellations. Unlike megaconstellations numbering in the hundreds or thousands, mini-constellations typically range from a few satellites to a few dozen and can target specific geographies or niche capabilities.
paras.zh: 反复修改航天器的能力是 Space Inventor 向需要建造以有效载荷为中心的迷你星座的运营商推销的核心内容。与数百或数千个巨型星座不同，迷你星座通常从几颗到几十颗卫星不等，可以针对特定的地理位置或利基功能。

paras.en: “These are high state-of-the-art payloads that often are still in development when we start building the bus,” said Jan Smolders, the chief commercial officer at Space Inventor. As one batch is being built, he said, Space Inventor is already applying lessons learned to the design of the next.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 首席商务官简·斯莫尔德斯 (Jan Smolders) 表示：“这些都是最先进的有效载荷，当我们开始建造巴士时，这些有效载荷通常仍在开发中。”他说，随着一批产品的制造，Space Inventor 已经将吸取的经验教训应用于下一批产品的设计中。

paras.en: “The standardization is in the satellite modules, not in the bus,” he added.
paras.zh: “标准化在于卫星模块，而不是总线，”他补充道。

paras.en: Mini-constellations occupy a middle ground in the satellite market.
paras.zh: 迷你星座在卫星市场中占据中间地位。

paras.en: Their smaller scale offers flexibility. Operators may want to incorporate lessons from the first satellites into later iterations. Or, as technology advances, they may want to upgrade the instruments.
paras.zh: 它们较小的规模提供了灵活性。运营商可能希望将第一批卫星的经验教训纳入以后的迭代中。或者，随着技术的进步，他们可能想要升级仪器。

paras.en: Space Inventor designed its BIG CAT family of services for exactly those moments.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 正是为了这些时刻而设计了 BIG CAT 系列服务。

paras.en: The BIG CAT 100, 300 and 600 platforms are sized for different spacecraft classes, but each is configurable rather than fixed. That means if a mission suddenly needs more power, improved pointing performance or a new communications capability, Space Inventor can often accommodate these changes by swapping out bus modules, rather than redesigning a spacecraft from scratch.
paras.zh: BIG CAT 100、300 和 600 平台的尺寸适合不同的航天器类别，但每个平台都是可配置的而不是固定的。这意味着，如果任务突然需要更多功率、改进的指向性能或新的通信能力，Space Inventor 通常可以通过更换总线模块来适应这些变化，而不是从头开始重新设计航天器。

paras.en: That philosophy of iteration is especially helpful in rapidly changing fields such as thermal imaging, space domain awareness and in-orbit servicing. It also means Space Inventor can avoid locking in a design around requirements developed years before launch.
paras.zh: 这种迭代理念对于快速变化的领域尤其有用，例如热成像、空间域感知和在轨服务。这也意味着 Space Inventor 可以避免围绕发射前几年制定的要求锁定设计。

paras.en: Space Inventor pairs its modular approach with another strategy: making most of its components itself.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 将其模块化方法与另一种策略相结合：自行制造大部分组件。

paras.en: The company manufactures nearly all of its components – with the exception of propulsion – in house at its factory in Aalborg, Denmark, offering more control over its design and less exposure to the volatility of the supply chain.
paras.zh: 该公司几乎所有部件（推进装置除外）均在其位于丹麦奥尔堡的工厂内部生产，从而对其设计提供了更多控制权，并减少了供应链波动的风险。

paras.en: If a new requirement calls for a modified PCB, Space Inventor can update the design, machine a revised housing, assemble the new component and test the change, all under the same roof. Such a change ordered from an outside supplier might take about six weeks. Space Inventor can make the same change in roughly one week, Smolders said.
paras.zh: 如果新要求需要修改 PCB，Space Inventor 可以更新设计、加工修改后的外壳、组装新组件并测试更改，所有这些都在同一屋檐下进行。从外部供应商处订购的此类变更可能需要大约六周的时间。斯莫尔德斯说，Space Inventor 可以在大约一周内做出同样的改变。

paras.en: “Because we make everything in house, we can easily add new modules to facilitate changing requirements, very fast,” he said.
paras.zh: “因为所有东西都是我们内部制造的，所以我们可以非常快速地轻松添加新模块，以适应不断变化的需求，”他说。

paras.en: This gives Space Inventor tighter quality control and reduces exposure to supply chain shortages.
paras.zh: 这使得 Space Inventor 能够进行更严格的质量控制，并减少供应链短缺的风险。

paras.en: Space Inventor also maintains a stock of its components, allowing it to offer next-day shipping. That reduces the risk that a small component or a supplier delay holds up the production of a spacecraft.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 还保留其组件库存，使其能够提供次日发货。这降低了因小部件或供应商延误而阻碍航天器生产的风险。

paras.en: For mini-constellation operators, this model makes it easier to change later satellites based on what they’ve learned from earlier ones.
paras.zh: 对于迷你星座运营商来说，这种模型可以更轻松地根据从早期卫星中学到的知识来更换后来的卫星。

paras.en: The same configurable approach that Space Inventor uses for commercial missions also underpins its offerings for the defense community.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 用于商业任务的相同可配置方法也支撑了其为国防界提供的产品。

paras.en: Rather than only offering military customers a satellite bus, the company can pair a BIG CAT platform with a mission-specific payload to provide a turnkey system.
paras.zh: 该公司不仅可以为军事客户提供卫星总线，还可以将 BIG CAT 平台与特定任务的有效载荷配对，以提供交钥匙系统。

paras.en: Space Inventor’s defense-specific Apex Predator series includes BC Lynx and BC Leopard, two turnkey surveillance solutions built on its BIG CAT platform.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 的国防专用 Apex Predator 系列包括 BC Lynx 和 BC Leopard，这是两种基于其 BIG CAT 平台构建的交钥匙监控解决方案。

paras.en: Lynx is designed to detect radio-frequency emissions, geolocate their source and identify activity that may warrant further investigation. Leopard can then be tasked with capturing high-resolution optical or thermal imagery in the same area.
paras.zh: Lynx 旨在检测射频发射、定位其来源并识别可能需要进一步调查的活动。然后 Leopard 的任务是在同一区域捕获高分辨率光学或热图像。

paras.en: The approach follows a “tip-and-cue” model, with one sensor identifying a potential target and then directing another sensor to collect more detailed information.
paras.zh: 该方法遵循“提示和提示”模型，其中一个传感器识别潜在目标，然后指示另一个传感器收集更详细的信息。

paras.en: The company has also developed a business case for detecting and investigating maritime activity in the heavily trafficked Baltic Sea, bordered by NATO members and Russia. There, Lynx satellites can identify anomalous RF emissions that could reveal dark vessels or help locate sources of GPS spoofing. It can then cue a Leopard satellite to collect additional intelligence.
paras.zh: 该公司还开发了一个商业案例，用于探测和调查与北约成员国和俄罗斯接壤的交通繁忙的波罗的海的海上活动。在那里，Lynx 卫星可以识别异常射频发射，从而揭示黑暗船只或帮助定位 GPS 欺骗源。然后它可以提示 Leopard 卫星收集更多情报。

paras.en: This space-based approach to surveillance, Smolders argues, offers a cost-effective complement to expensive drones and stealth aircraft that can only monitor a relatively contained area at once.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔德斯认为，这种基于太空的监视方法为昂贵的无人机和隐形飞机提供了一种经济有效的补充，因为这些飞机只能同时监视相对封闭的区域。

paras.en: “For the cost of one or two F-35s, you can actually get the intelligence to tell those planes where to go,” he said. “Affordable, proven ISR capability is ready to deploy in Europe today, with Space Inventor at the forefront of turning that capability into operational missions, but the decision-makers need to know about it.”
paras.zh: “只需花费一两架 F-35 的成本，你实际上就可以获得告诉这些飞机要去哪里的情报，”他说。 “如今，经济实惠、经过验证的 ISR 能力已准备好在欧洲部署，Space Inventor 处于将这种能力转化为作战任务的最前沿，但决策者需要了解这一点。”

articles.title: NASA Satellites Observe Historic 2026 El Niño

paras.en: A phenomenon rarer than a solar eclipse and more powerful than any single storm system is unfolding this fall, and NASA is tracking it closely.
paras.zh: 今年秋天，一种比日食更罕见、比任何单一风暴系统更强大的现象正在发生，美国宇航局正在密切跟踪它。

paras.en: El Niño is a natural climate pattern that emerges roughly every two to seven years marked by warmer-than-normal water temperatures in parts of the equatorial Pacific. NASA scientists are keeping watch as it flips trade winds, redistributes ocean heat, scrambles rain patterns, and raises sea surface height across parts of the Pacific.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候模式，大约每两到七年出现一次，其特点是赤道太平洋部分地区的水温高于正常水平。美国宇航局的科学家们正在密切关注它翻转信风、重新分配海洋热量、扰乱降雨模式以及提高太平洋部分地区海面高度的情况。

paras.en: As of October, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) has said that there's an 83% chance that the strongest El Niño since 1950 is currently unfolding. People around the world, including farmers, firefighters, and coastal communities, are already experiencing the effects in different ways.
paras.zh: 截至 10 月，美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 表示，自 1950 年以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象目前有 83% 的可能性正在发生。世界各地的人们，包括农民、消防员和沿海社区，已经以不同的方式感受到了这些影响。

paras.en: Follow along with these maps as NASA tracks El Niño from its epicenter in the equatorial Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 跟随这些地图，美国宇航局从赤道太平洋的震中追踪厄尔尼诺现象。

paras.en: One of the first clues appeared in satellite imagery in January 2026, when a swell of warm water called a Kelvin wave was spotted near Micronesia in the western Pacific. Kelvin waves are slow-moving pulses of water thousands of miles long. Like underwater freeways, they transfer heat from west to east across the Pacific. The warm water heats the air directly above it, making it rise. The change in air pressures weakens or even reverses the trade winds that typically blow in the opposing direction, from the Americas toward Asia, causing sea levels in the eastern Pacific to rise further, and waters to warm even more. This chain reaction signifies the start of an El Niño.
paras.zh: 最早的线索之一出现在 2026 年 1 月的卫星图像中，当时在西太平洋密克罗尼西亚附近发现了一股被称为开尔文波的温水涌流。开尔文波是数千英里长的缓慢移动的水脉冲。就像水下高速公路一样，它们将热量从西向东穿过太平洋传递。温水加热其正上方的空气，使其上升。气压的变化削弱甚至逆转了通常从美洲吹向亚洲的相反方向的信风，导致东太平洋海平面进一步上升，海水进一步变暖。这种连锁反应标志着厄尔尼诺现象的开始。

paras.en: The map above shows that by early April, those Kelvin waves had reached the eastern Pacific, and sea surface temperatures had begun to warm. Warm water expands in volume, elevating local sea levels in some areas by as much as 1 to 1.3 feet (30 to 40 centimeters). The higher-than-normal water can be seen sloshing toward South America then moving up the coast to California. Sea levels that are six to eight inches (15 to 20 centimeters) lower than normal are visible around Indonesia and northern Australia.
paras.zh: 上面的地图显示，到四月初，那些开尔文波已经到达东太平洋，海面温度开始变暖。温暖的海水体积膨胀，使某些地区的当地海平面上升 1 至 1.3 英尺（30 至 40 厘米）。可以看到高于正常水平的水流向南美洲流动，然后沿着海岸移动到加利福尼亚州。印度尼西亚和澳大利亚北部地区的海平面比正常水平低 6 至 8 英寸（15 至 20 厘米）。

paras.en: “Kelvin waves are like the heartbeat of El Niño,” said Josh Willis, project scientist for sea level missions at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. “And our sea level satellites let us peer into the ocean and watch every beat.”
paras.zh: “开尔文波就像厄尔尼诺现象的心跳，”南加州美国宇航局喷气推进实验室海平面任务项目科学家乔什·威利斯说。 “我们的海平面卫星让我们能够窥视海洋并观察每一个心跳。”

paras.en: Scientists have used satellite altimetry to track the height of the ocean with ultraprecision since 1993. That unbroken data record continues today with the Sentinel-6 satellites. State-of-the-art radar altimeters aboard these satellites survey millions of square miles of ocean in a single day, complementing NOAA’s fleet of ocean sensors and buoys drifting and diving through the water below.
paras.zh: 自 1993 年以来，科学家们一直使用卫星测高法来超精确地追踪海洋高度。今天，Sentinel-6 卫星继续保持着这一不间断的数据记录。这些卫星上最先进的雷达高度计可在一天内勘测数百万平方英里的海洋，补充了 NOAA 的海洋传感器和在水下漂流和潜水的浮标群。

paras.en: Warmer-than-normal seawater is one of the best-known indicators of El Niño. Already, sea surface temperatures in the eastern Pacific are about 3 degrees Fahrenheit (1.7 degrees Celsius) warmer than the long-term average and could jump another fraction of a degree in the coming months, Willis said.
paras.zh: 海水温度高于正常水平是厄尔尼诺现象最著名的指标之一。威利斯说，东太平洋的海面温度已经比长期平均温度高出约 3 华氏度（1.7 摄氏度），并且在未来几个月可能会再上升零点几度。

paras.en: Satellites carrying microwave and infrared radiometers can see through and around clouds to measure heat energy at the sea surface. Satellites in 2026 mapped the band of warmer-than-normal water as it expanded throughout the spring. The band, seen in dark red, stretches for millions of square miles from the heart of the Pacific to the coast of South America. Ocean temperatures can influence weather patterns around the world. Air above the water’s surface carries heat and moisture into the atmosphere, seeding rainstorms and rearranging weather patterns across the globe.
paras.zh: 携带微波和红外辐射计的卫星可以透过云层及其周围来测量海面的热能。 2026 年，卫星绘制出了比正常温度更高的水带在整个春季扩张的情况。这条带呈深红色，从太平洋中心一直延伸到南美洲海岸，绵延数百万平方英里。海洋温度可以影响世界各地的天气模式。水面上方的空气将热量和湿气带入大气中，引发暴雨并重新调整全球的天气模式。

paras.en: El Niño’s warm waters also change the color of the ocean. A NASA satellite is tracking these subtle shifts in hues, as equatorial Pacific waters have become measurably more blue over the last several months.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象的温暖海水也会改变海洋的颜色。美国宇航局的一颗卫星正在追踪这些微妙的色调变化，因为过去几个月赤道太平洋水域明显变得更加蓝色。

paras.en: “Some people think of water as being just blue, but it's amazing the multitude of colors the ocean can be,” said Matthew Kehrli, a lead research scientist for the PACE (Plankton, Aerosol, Cloud, ocean Ecosystem) satellite team at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.
paras.zh: “有些人认为水只是蓝色的，但令人惊讶的是海洋可以有多种颜色，”位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的 NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心 PACE（浮游生物、气溶胶、云、海洋生态系统）卫星团队的首席研究科学家 Matthew Kehrli 说。

paras.en: This spectrum is in part thanks to microscopic plants called phytoplankton, which form the basis of the marine food web. There are thousands of different species of phytoplankton, which come in shades like teal, brown, or green. This year, in areas of the Pacific Ocean along the equator that are typically lush with phytoplankton and greener as a result, these hues are waning.
paras.zh: 这种光谱在一定程度上要归功于被称为浮游植物的微型植物，它们构成了海洋食物网的基础。浮游植物有数千种，颜色有青色、棕色或绿色。今年，在赤道沿岸的太平洋地区，这些地区通常浮游植物茂盛，因此变得更加绿色，这些色调正在减弱。

paras.en: This is an expected effect of El Niño. Phytoplankton thrive in cool, nutrient-rich waters, but during an El Niño, the weakening trade winds reduce the upwelling of nutrient-rich deep water to the ocean surface. With limited food supply, phytoplankton abundance drops. This decline can trigger cascading effects across the marine food web, forcing other marine life to relocate to new feeding grounds.
paras.zh: 这是厄尔尼诺现象的预期影响。浮游植物在凉爽、营养丰富的水域中繁衍生息，但在厄尔尼诺现象期间，信风减弱，减少了营养丰富的深水向海洋表面的上涌。由于食物供应有限，浮游植物丰度下降。这种下降可能会引发整个海洋食物网的连锁效应，迫使其他海洋生物迁移到新的觅食地。

paras.en: This year’s El Niño is the first since PACE launched in 2024, providing new views of the phenomenon. The Ocean Color Instrument aboard PACE observes the ocean in hyperspectral color — across several hundred different wavelengths of visible, near-infrared, and ultraviolet light — monitoring phytoplankton and other ocean-color changes in near-real time. With PACE data, researchers calculate the average color of the ocean, simplifying spectra of light into a single number, known as apparent visible wavelength.
paras.zh: 今年的厄尔尼诺现象是 PACE 自 2024 年启动以来的首次出现，为这一现象提供了新的视角。 PACE 上的海洋颜色仪器以高光谱颜色观察海洋——跨越数百个不同波长的可见光、近红外和紫外光——近乎实时地监测浮游植物和其他海洋颜色变化。利用 PACE 数据，研究人员计算海洋的平均颜色，将光谱简化为一个数字，即表观可见波长。

paras.en: The 2026 map above shows the green area along the equator in the western Pacific Ocean shrink as a bluer shade fills in, indicating fewer phytoplankton. In contrast, the map from 2025 shows how the green-hued section stays steady over time.
paras.zh: 上面的 2026 年地图显示，西太平洋赤道沿线的绿色区域随着蓝色阴影的填充而缩小，表明浮游植物减少。相比之下，2025 年的地图显示绿色部分如何随着时间的推移保持稳定。

paras.en: “You have expectations of what you would think would happen,” Kehrli said. “But to visually see the results with the data products that you’re working with in real time is gratifying.”
paras.zh: “你对自己认为会发生的事情抱有期望，”凯尔利说。 “但是实时直观地看到您正在使用的数据产品的结果是令人欣慰的。”

paras.en: NASA scientists will continue to monitor the signs and impacts of this El Niño with its fleet of Earth-observing satellites.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局科学家将继续利用地球观测卫星监测厄尔尼诺现象的迹象和影响。

paras.en: “El Niño touches almost all of us in some way every time it occurs,” Willis said. “While many have seen what it can do, we look to the ocean to understand why.”
paras.zh: “厄尔尼诺现象每次发生时都会以某种方式影响我们所有人，”威利斯说。 “虽然许多人已经看到了它的作用，但我们还是希望通过海洋来了解其中的原因。”

paras.en: View and download these data visualizations here.
paras.zh: 在此处查看并下载这些数据可视化。

articles.title: NASA to Help Unlock Mysteries of Mars’ Moons in Upcoming Mission

paras.en: NASA is playing an important role in JAXA’s (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) MMX (Martian Moons eXploration) mission, to advance our understanding of Mars’ moons and build on the agency’s long history of exploring the Red Planet.
paras.zh: NASA 在 JAXA（日本宇宙航空研究开发机构）的 MMX（火星卫星探索）任务中发挥着重要作用，以增进我们对火星卫星的了解，并以该机构探索这颗红色星球的悠久历史为基础。

paras.en: The mission aims to characterize and determine the origin of Mars’ moons Phobos and Deimos and deliver a sample of Phobos to Earth. The MMX spacecraft is targeting launch from JAXA’s Tanegashima Space Center in Japan at 3:41 p.m. EDT on Monday, Oct. 19 (4:41 a.m. JST on Tuesday, Oct. 20).
paras.zh: 该任务旨在描述和确定火星卫星火卫一和火卫二的起源，并将火卫一样本运送到地球。 MMX 航天器计划于下午 3 点 41 分从日本 JAXA 种子岛航天中心发射。美国东部时间 10 月 19 日星期一（日本标准时间 10 月 20 日星期二凌晨 4:41）。

paras.en: “The samples from MMX will bring forth paradigm-shifting science on the Mars system for generations to come, especially as NASA prepares to send the first humans to Mars,” said Nicky Fox, associate administrator, Science Mission Directorate, NASA Headquarters in Washington. “The NASA-JAXA sample curation partnership is extremely valuable, and I am proud that NASA Science is supporting MMX sample curation and will be sharing portions of these samples for study as we continue to expand humanity’s understanding of the universe for the benefit of all.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部科学任务理事会副局长尼基·福克斯 (Nicky Fox) 表示：“来自 MMX 的样本将为子孙后代带来火星系统范式转变的科学，特别是在美国宇航局准备将第一批人类送往火星之际。” “NASA-JAXA 样本管理合作伙伴关系非常有价值，我很自豪 NASA Science 正在支持 MMX 样本管理，并将分享这些样本的部分内容以供研究，因为我们将继续扩大人类对宇宙的了解，造福所有人。”

paras.en: NASA’s contributions to the mission include the Mars-moon Exploration with Gamma rays and Neutrons (MEGANE) spectrograph instrument, the Pneumatic Sampler (P-Sampler) technology demonstration, and communications and navigation support from the agency’s Deep Space Network, as well as funding United States scientists participating on the MMX science team.
paras.zh: NASA 对该任务的贡献包括伽马射线和中子火星月球探索 (MEGANE) 摄谱仪、气动采样器 (P-Sampler) 技术演示、该机构深空网络的通信和导航支持，以及资助参与 MMX 科学团队的美国科学家。

paras.en: Scientists have long debated the origin of Mars’ two moons. The data and samples collected by the MMX mission will help answer essential questions about the origins of these moons and the history of the solar system.
paras.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直在争论火星两颗卫星的起源。 MMX 任务收集的数据和样本将有助于回答有关这些卫星起源和太阳系历史的基本问题。

paras.en: “Phobos and Deimos may be the remains of a massive impact on Mars that sent material into orbit around the planet, or they could be ancient asteroids that were captured by Mars’ gravity billions of years ago,” said Tom Statler, MMX program executive and program scientist at NASA Headquarters. “Having the answer will help illuminate that early era when Earth and the other inner planets may have been acquiring much of their water and organic compounds.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局总部 MMX 项目执行官兼项目科学家汤姆·斯塔特勒 (Tom Statler) 表示：“火卫一和火卫二可能是对火星发生大规模撞击的遗迹，这些撞击将物质送入了环绕地球的轨道，也可能是数十亿年前被火星引力捕获的古老小行星。” “找到答案将有助于阐明地球和其他内行星可能已经获取大量水和有机化合物的早期时代。”

paras.en: The MEGANE (pronounced meh-GAH-nay, the Japanese word for eyeglasses) spectrograph will help scientists “see” what Phobos is made of by measuring neutrons and gamma rays emitted from the moon’s surface and determining its chemical elemental composition, which will provide important clues about its origin.
paras.zh: MEGANE（发音为meh-GAH-nay，日语中眼镜的意思）摄谱仪将通过测量从月球表面发射的中子和伽马射线并确定其化学元素成分，帮助科学家“了解”火卫一的构成，这将提供有关其起源的重要线索。

paras.en: Mounted on one of the spacecraft’s landing legs, the P-Sampler is designed to collect a ground sample from Phobos. The system gathers surface material using bursts of high-pressure nitrogen gas, complementing JAXA’s C-Sampler, which will extract cores from a few inches deeper. NASA will obtain and curate about 15% of the total returned sample at the agency’s Johnson Space Center Astromaterials Lab in Houston, making it available for research for decades.
paras.zh: P-Sampler 安装在航天器的一个着陆腿上，旨在从火卫一收集地面样本。该系统利用高压氮气爆发来收集表面材料，与 JAXA 的 C-Sampler 相辅相成，后者将从几英寸深的地方提取岩心。 NASA 将在该机构位于休斯敦的约翰逊航天中心天体材料实验室获取并保管返回样本总量的约 15%，使其可用于数十年的研究。

paras.en: Another key part of NASA’s contribution to MMX is its scientific partnership with JAXA. NASA-supported researchers are working alongside international colleagues to help reveal the story of Phobos and will use mission data and returned samples to uncover new clues about the moon’s origin and the evolution of the Mars system.
paras.zh: NASA 对 MMX 贡献的另一个关键部分是其与 JAXA 的科学合作伙伴关系。美国宇航局支持的研究人员正在与国际同事合作，帮助揭示火卫一的故事，并将利用任务数据和返回的样本来发现有关月球起源和火星系统演化的新线索。

paras.en: The MMX spacecraft will arrive at Mars in August 2027 to begin its survey of the Red Planet’s two moons. After surveying Phobos in detail, the spacecraft will collect a sample of the moon’s surface no earlier than December 2028 and deliver it to Earth in 2031.
paras.zh: MMX 航天器将于 2027 年 8 月抵达火星，开始对这颗红色星球的两颗卫星进行勘测。在对火卫一进行详细勘察后，该航天器将不早于2028年12月收集月球表面样本，并于2031年将其运送到地球。

paras.en: The MEGANE instrument was developed by the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory. Honeybee Robotics, a Blue Origin company, developed the spacecraft’s pneumatic sampler mechanism. NASA’s contributions to the MMX mission were developed under the agency’s Discovery Program. The Discovery Program is managed by NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, for the agency’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington.
paras.zh: MEGANE 仪器由约翰霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室开发。蓝色起源公司旗下的蜜蜂机器人公司开发了航天器的气动采样器机构。 NASA 对 MMX 任务的贡献是在该机构的发现计划下开发的。发现计划由美国宇航局位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的马歇尔太空飞行中心为该机构位于华盛顿的科学任务理事会管理。

paras.en: For more information about the MMX mission, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 MMX 任务的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: karen.c.fox@nasa.gov / alana.r.johnson@nasa.gov
paras.zh: karen.c.fox@nasa.gov / alana.r.johnson@nasa.gov

articles.title: Isaias Dims the Gulf Coast

paras.en: After a quiet start to the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season, Isaias became the season’s first hurricane on October 8 as it tracked toward the U.S. Gulf Coast. The storm brought heavy rain and flash flooding to parts of the Southeast, including Alabama and the Florida Panhandle, and winds that toppled trees and downed power lines, leaving many people in the dark.
paras.zh: 2026 年大西洋飓风季节平静地开始后，伊萨亚斯于 10 月 8 日向美国墨西哥湾沿岸移动，成为该季节的第一场飓风。这场风暴给东南部部分地区带来了大雨和山洪暴发，包括阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州狭长地带，狂风吹倒了树木，压倒了电线，使许多人陷入黑暗。

paras.en: Isaias made landfall near Destin, Florida, on the evening of October 9 as a Category 2 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 105 miles (170 kilometers) per hour. Gusts topped 100 miles per hour along a corridor west of the storm’s center, according to the National Weather Service, with preliminary reports showing a 117-mile-per-hour gust in Oriole Beach and a 102-mile-per-hour gust at Pensacola City Hall.
paras.zh: 伊萨亚斯于 10 月 9 日晚在佛罗里达州德斯坦附近登陆，为 2 级飓风，最大持续风速为每小时 105 英里（170 公里）。据国家气象局称，风暴中心以西走廊的阵风速度达到了每小时 100 英里，初步报告显示金莺海滩的阵风速度达到了每小时 117 英里，彭萨科拉市政厅的阵风速度达到了每小时 102 英里。

paras.en: These areas of high winds overlapped a broader area west of the storm’s eye where satellite images showed substantial decreases in nighttime lights. The image pair above shows nighttime lights before and after the storm. The left image is a composite of August 2026 data representing typical conditions, and the right image shows lights on October 11, after most of the storm’s clouds had cleared.
paras.zh: 这些强风区域与风暴眼以西的更广阔区域重叠，卫星图像显示夜间灯光大幅减少。上面的图像对显示了暴风雨前后的夜间灯光。左图是代表典型条件的 2026 年 8 月数据的合成图，右图显示了 10 月 11 日风暴的大部分云层散去后的灯光。

paras.en: The data depicted in the images, provided by Ranjay Shrestha of NASA's Black Marble science team, come from the Black Marble HD product. The product uses data from the VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) on the NOAA-20 satellite, which has a day-night band that detects light emitted and reflected at night. The team processed the data to account for changes in the landscape, the atmosphere, and phase of the Moon, and to filter out stray light that does not come from electric lights. Dark gray, hash-marked areas show where clouds prevented VIIRS from collecting data. The nighttime lights are shown over a base map from the Landsat 9 satellite.
paras.zh: 图像中描绘的数据由 NASA Black Marble 科学团队的 Ranjay Shrestha 提供，来自 Black Marble HD 产品。该产品使用 NOAA-20 卫星上 VIIRS（可见红外成像辐射计套件）的数据，该卫星具有昼夜波段，可检测夜间发射和反射的光。该团队对数据进行处理，以考虑景观、大气和月相的变化，并过滤掉并非来自电灯的杂散光。深灰色的散列标记区域显示了云层阻止 VIIRS 收集数据的区域。夜间灯光显示在 Landsat 9 卫星的底图上。

paras.en: “Standard Black Marble nighttime lights imagery, available through NASA Worldview, provides a broad picture of the storm's immediate impacts,” Shrestha said. “Black Marble HD takes this a step further by allowing us to visualize these changes at a much finer spatial scale.”
paras.zh: “通过 NASA Worldview 可以获得的标准 Black Marble 夜间灯光图像提供了风暴直接影响的总体情况，”Shrestha 说。 “Black Marble HD 更进一步，让我们能够在更精细的空间尺度上可视化这些变化。”

paras.en: At these finer scales, the images reveal lights decreasing sharply around parts of Pensacola, Florida, and along the U.S. Route 98 corridor toward Destin, suggesting widespread power disruptions. Shrestha also pointed out pockets where lights persisted, including Pensacola International Airport, Pensacola Christian College, and parts of downtown Pensacola. “These patterns could reflect backup power systems, differences in electrical infrastructure, or areas that maintained electricity during the storm, although the imagery alone cannot confirm the underlying reasons,” he said.
paras.zh: 在这些更精细的尺度上，图像显示佛罗里达州彭萨科拉部分地区以及沿着美国 98 号公路走廊通往德斯坦的灯光急剧减弱，表明出现了大范围的电力中断。什雷斯塔还指出了灯光持续存在的地方，包括彭萨科拉国际机场、彭萨科拉基督教学院和彭萨科拉市中心的部分地区。他说：“这些模式可能反映了备用电力系统、电力基础设施的差异或风暴期间维持电力供应的区域，尽管图像本身无法证实根本原因。”

paras.en: Black Marble HD images also reveal the pace and spatial patterns of recovery. The image pair above compares the same October 11 view (left) with one from October 12 (right), when lights had begun to return to some affected areas. By October 14, lighting patterns looked similar to pre-storm conditions.
paras.zh: Black Marble 高清图像还揭示了恢复的速度和空间模式。上面的图像对将 10 月 11 日的视图（左）与 10 月 12 日的视图（右）进行了比较，当时灯光已经开始恢复到一些受影响的区域。到 10 月 14 日，照明模式看起来与暴风雨前的情况相似。

paras.en: “Understanding where recovery is progressing and where disruptions persist can help emergency responders and decision makers identify areas that may require additional attention, prioritize resources, and assess the effectiveness of restoration efforts,” Shrestha said.
paras.zh: 什雷斯塔说：“了解恢复进展情况以及中断持续存在的情况可以帮助应急响应人员和决策者确定可能需要额外关注的领域，确定资源的优先顺序，并评估恢复工作的有效性。”

paras.en: Black Marble data complement ground-based outage reports rather than replace them, offering a more comprehensive view of disasters' impacts and recovery. “Ultimately, this is where the value of Black Marble lies: turning nighttime Earth observations into actionable insights that support informed decisions and help bridge the gap between Earth science and action,” Shrestha said.
paras.zh: Black Marble 数据是对地面停电报告的补充，而不是取代它们，从而提供了有关灾难影响和恢复的更全面的视图。什雷斯塔说：“归根结底，这就是 Black Marble 的价值所在：将夜间地球观测转化为可操作的见解，支持明智的决策，并帮助弥合地球科学与行动之间的差距。”

paras.en: The NASA Disasters Program, in coordination with FEMA and the USGS Coastal Storms Team, is supporting the Alabama Red Cross and the Alabama Emergency Management Agency’s response to Hurricane Isaias. The team will be posting maps and data products on its open-access mapping portal as new information becomes available.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局灾害计划与联邦应急管理局和美国地质调查局沿海风暴小组合作，支持阿拉巴马州红十字会和阿拉巴马州应急管理局应对飓风伊萨亚斯。随着新信息的出现，该团队将在其开放访问地图门户上发布地图和数据产品。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Lauren Dauphin, using Black Marble HD data courtesy of Ranjay Shrestha/NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center and Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Kathryn Hansen.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像由 Lauren Dauphin 拍摄，使用由 Ranjay Shrestha/NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心提供的 Black Marble HD 数据和来自美国地质调查局的 Landsat 数据。凯瑟琳·汉森的故事。

paras.en: - NASA Disasters Program (2026, October 8) Black Marble HD. Accessed October 15, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 灾难计划（2026 年，10 月 8 日）Black Marble HD。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 15 日。

paras.en: - National Hurricane Center (2026, October 11) Hurricane ISAIAS Advisory Archive. Accessed October 15, 2026.
paras.zh: - 国家飓风中心（2026 年，10 月 11 日）飓风 ISAIAS 咨询档案。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 15 日。

paras.en: - National Public Radio (2026, October 11) Hurricane Isaias: By the numbers. Accessed October 15, 2026.
paras.zh: - 国家公共广播电台（2026 年，10 月 11 日）飓风伊萨亚斯：根据数字。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 15 日。

articles.title: WHO scales up Ebola readiness in 22 countries across three continents

paras.en: WHO scales up Ebola readiness in 22 countries across three continents
paras.zh: 世卫组织加强三大洲22个国家的埃博拉准备工作

paras.en: The UN agency’s eastern Mediterranean region comprises 22 countries and territories. Intensified support is being given to Djibouti, Somalia and Sudan, which have been identified as priority countries.
paras.zh: 该联合国机构的东地中海地区由 22 个国家和地区组成。正在加大对吉布提、索马里和苏丹的支持力度，这些国家已被确定为优先国家。

paras.en: This follows deadly outbreaks of Ebola disease caused by the Bundibugyo virus in both the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda and confirmation of a case in Kenya linked to the DRC.
paras.zh: 此前，刚果民主共和国（刚果民主共和国）和乌干达爆发了由本迪布焦病毒引起的致命埃博拉疫情，肯尼亚也确认了一例与刚果民主共和国有关的病例。

paras.en: Hostilities and overstretched health systems
paras.zh: 敌对行动和不堪重负的卫生系统

paras.en: Although there have not been any Ebola cases in the region so far, conflict, displacement and overstretched health systems in several countries are making it difficult to prepare and respond should the situation change.
paras.zh: 尽管该地区迄今为止还没有出现任何埃博拉病例，但一些国家的冲突、流离失所和卫生系统不堪重负，使得在情况发生变化时难以做好准备和应对。

paras.en: In a speech earlier this week, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Gebreyesus described the region as “the epicentre of global humanitarian need”.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞在本周早些时候的一次讲话中将该地区描述为“全球人道主义需求的中心”。

paras.en: More than 117 million people in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, Sudan, Syria, Yemen and beyond, require humanitarian assistance to survive.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦被占领土、苏丹、叙利亚、也门等地区有超过 1.17 亿人需要人道主义援助才能生存。

paras.en: Assessing readiness, identifying challenges
paras.zh: 评估准备情况，识别挑战

paras.en: Between July and September, WHO deployed missions to Djibouti, Somalia and Sudan to assess national readiness and identify challenges in Ebola surveillance, laboratory capacity, infection prevention and control, case management and emergency coordination.
paras.zh: 7月至9月，世卫组织向吉布提、索马里和苏丹派遣了特派团，以评估各国的准备情况，并确定埃博拉监测、实验室能力、感染预防和控制、病例管理和应急协调方面的挑战。

paras.en: The UN agency is helping authorities to address gaps through training, technical support, medical supplies and simulation exercises.
paras.zh: 该联合国机构正在通过培训、技术支持、医疗用品和模拟演习帮助当局弥补差距。

paras.en: It has developed regional readiness checklists, contingency planning tools and technical guidance, in addition to strengthening coordination with countries in both Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean.
paras.zh: 除了加强与非洲和东地中海国家的协调外，它还制定了区域准备清单、应急规划工具和技术指南。

paras.en: WHO has also provided laboratory supplies, traveller guidance and community engagement resources.
paras.zh: 世卫组织还提供了实验室用品、旅行者指导和社区参与资源。

paras.en: Despite progress, gaps remain in early detection, laboratory confirmation and availability of protective equipment and resources for emergency response.
paras.zh: 尽管取得了进展，但在早期检测、实验室确认以及应急响应防护设备和资源的可用性方面仍然存在差距。

paras.en: “Conflict, insecurity and restricted access present additional challenges, particularly in countries already facing major humanitarian emergencies,” WHO said.
paras.zh: 世卫组织表示：“冲突、不安全和出入受限带来了额外的挑战，特别是在已经面临重大人道主义紧急情况的国家。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, work continues to ensure that national authorities and partners can rapidly detect, investigate and manage suspected Ebola cases.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我们仍在继续努力确保国家当局和合作伙伴能够迅速发现、调查和管理埃博拉疑似病例。

articles.title: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter

paras.en: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter
paras.zh: 面粉袋变成防洪堤：加沙将面临又一个没有安全住所的冬天

paras.en: Like many people in the war-ravaged Gaza Strip, Ahmed Al-Omari is preparing for another winter of bitter cold and rain that threatens to cause flooding as families struggle to survive in tattered tents and damaged buildings.
paras.zh: 和饱受战争蹂躏的加沙地带的许多人一样，艾哈迈德·奥马里正在为另一个严寒多雨的冬天做准备，这个冬天可能会引发洪水，因为家庭在破烂的帐篷和受损的建筑物中艰难生存。

paras.en: He is racing against time, working with other young men to fill sacks that once held World Food Programme (WFP) flour with sand to protect their makeshift shelters from the rain.
paras.zh: 他正在与时间赛跑，与其他年轻人一起用沙子填充曾经装有世界粮食计划署（WFP）面粉的麻袋，以保护他们的临时避难所免受雨淋。

paras.en: “These are flour sacks that we used to retrieve from the jaws of death, so that we could eat,” he told UN News, referring to the dangers of aid distribution in the Gaza Strip, where civilians have been killed while trying to obtain assistance.
paras.zh: “这些是我们用来从死亡之口取回的面粉袋，以便我们可以吃，”他告诉联合国新闻，指的是在加沙地带分发援助物资的危险，那里的平民在试图获得援助时被杀害。

paras.en: “Now, they have become sacks that we fill with sand to act as barriers against rainwater,” he explained. “We flood every year and we have put these sacks in place in the hope that, somehow, rainwater will not get inside.”
paras.zh: “现在，它们已经变成了麻袋，我们用沙子填充，作为阻挡雨水的屏障，”他解释道。 “我们每年都会发生洪水，我们把这些麻袋放在适当的位置，希望雨水不会以某种方式进入里面。”

paras.en: Around two million people in Gaza still need shelter assistance, according to the International Organization for Migration (IOM). Rain has already begun and an intensifying El Niño threatens more in the coming months.
paras.zh: 据国际移民组织 (IOM) 称，加沙约有 200 万人仍需要住房援助。降雨已经开始，未来几个月厄尔尼诺现象的加剧将带来更多威胁。

paras.en: Right now, agencies were working to get as much shelter material into the Strip as possible before winter, Karl Baker, IOM’s regional crisis coordinator for Gaza, said from Amman, Jordan.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织加沙地区危机协调员卡尔·贝克在约旦安曼表示，目前各机构正在努力在冬季之前将尽可能多的避难所材料运入加沙地带。

paras.en: “We know that the rains have already begun and that the volume of goods that we have to get into Gaza is not going to meet the demands of the population,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们知道降雨已经开始，我们必须运往加沙的货物量无法满足人们的需求。”

paras.en: Funding shortages that began to decline in January have hampered preparations, Mr. Baker said.
paras.zh: 贝克先生说，一月份开始减少的资金短缺阻碍了准备工作。

paras.en: “The funding has come a little later in the year. It is now arriving, but it’s not at the scale needed to support what we estimate is 1.8 to 1.9 million people needing some sort of shelter assistance,” he said.
paras.zh: “今年资金来得稍晚一些。现在已经到了，但还没有达到支持我们估计的 1.8 至 190 万人需要某种住房援助所需的规模，”他说。

paras.en: The continuing regional conflict is also disrupting supply chains. IOM relies on suppliers in countries including China, India and Pakistan, with goods routed through Jordan, Egypt and Israel before reaching Gaza.
paras.zh: 持续的地区冲突也扰乱了供应链。国际移民组织依赖中国、印度和巴基斯坦等国家的供应商，货物在抵达加沙之前途经约旦、埃及和以色列。

paras.en: “The other point, of course, is that the regional conflict seems to be only growing. That disrupts trade routes,” Mr. Baker said.
paras.zh: “当然，另一点是，地区冲突似乎只会愈演愈烈。这扰乱了贸易路线，”贝克先生说。

paras.en: As long as the global shipping is disrupted, it will delay the volume or the timing for goods to reach Gaza, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，只要全球运输中断，就会延迟货物到达加沙的数量或时间。

paras.en: Quality is another concern. In other emergencies, Mr. Baker said, IOM could provide more durable transitional shelter, such as plywood and relief housing units.
paras.zh: 质量是另一个问题。贝克先生说，在其他紧急情况下，国际移民组织可以提供更耐用的过渡住所，例如胶合板和救济住房单元。

paras.en: In Gaza, tents typically last only about six months. With people constantly displaced, they are often destroyed or left behind when families flee at short notice.
paras.zh: 在加沙，帐篷通常只能使用六个月左右。由于人们不断流离失所，当家人在短时间内逃离时，他们常常被摧毁或被抛在后面。

paras.en: “Constantly moving a tent or a temporary structure has caused, I would say, a lack of quality for what is currently inside of Gaza,” he said. “The quality needs to be enhanced with either more durable items or more goods, which currently help with temporary solutions.”
paras.zh: 他说：“我想说，不断移动帐篷或临时建筑导致加沙目前的情况质量下降。” “需要通过更耐用的物品或更多的商品来提高质量，这目前有助于临时解决方案。”

paras.en: More than 4,000 buildings, many of them home to thousands of residents, are reportedly at risk of collapse.
paras.zh: 据报道，超过 4,000 栋建筑物（其中许多是数千名居民的住所）面临倒塌的危险。

paras.en: Briefing the UN Security Council, Ramiz Alakbarov, acting Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process, said the UN was working with local communities to evacuate people from unsafe buildings. With no alternatives, many had little choice but to seek shelter in tents.
paras.zh: 中东和平进程代理特别协调员拉米兹·阿拉克巴罗夫在向联合国安理会通报情况时表示，联合国正在与当地社区合作，从不安全的建筑物中疏散人员。由于别无选择，许多人别无选择，只能躲进帐篷里。

paras.en: Recalling a recent visit to Gaza, he described the impossible decisions facing families: leave the homes they had returned to or stay in buildings at risk of collapse.
paras.zh: 他回忆起最近对加沙的访问，描述了家庭面临的不可能的决定：离开他们返回的家园，还是留在面临倒塌风险的建筑物中。

paras.en: Living space is also shrinking. Only around 30 per cent of Gaza is now accessible to most people, IOM’s Mr. Baker said.
paras.zh: 居住空间也在缩小。国际移民组织的贝克先生表示，现在只有约 30% 的加沙地带可供大多数人进入。

paras.en: Conditions in displacement sites continue to deteriorate, humanitarian assessments show, with many exposed to flooding and few alternative places to go.
paras.zh: 人道主义评估显示，流离失所地点的情况继续恶化，许多人遭受洪水袭击，几乎没有其他地方可去。

paras.en: In Khan Younis, in southern Gaza, families are salvaging materials from the rubble. Displaced from Rafah, Mohammed Barhoum and his sons are using metal rods recovered from the wreckage to try to strengthen their shelter.
paras.zh: 在加沙南部的汗尤尼斯，许多家庭正在废墟中抢救物资。穆罕默德·巴胡姆和他的儿子们从拉法流离失所，他们正在使用从残骸中找到的金属棒来加固他们的住所。

paras.en: It is risky work amid unstable debris and explosive remnants of war.
paras.zh: 在不稳定的废墟和战争遗留爆炸物中，这是一项危险的工作。

paras.en: “Every year during the winter, this area floods because of heavy rainfall,” Mr. Barhoum said. “This year, we decided to reinforce our tents using metal rods. It is a new experiment, and we will see how it goes. We hope the situation will be better than it was last time.”
paras.zh: “每年冬天，这个地区都会因为强降雨而发生洪水，”巴霍姆先生说。 “今年，我们决定用金属棒加固帐篷。这是一个新的实验，我们会看看效果如何。我们希望情况会比上次好。”

paras.en: Most of the durable shelter materials IOM would normally use in emergencies fall under Israel’s dual-use restrictions, which date back to 2008.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织通常在紧急情况下使用的大多数耐用住房材料都受到以色列自 2008 年以来的双重用途限制。

paras.en: They include roofing sheets, cement for floors and stronger walls to withstand the wind – items that could make shelters more resistant to winter, but are often deemed a security concern.
paras.zh: 其中包括屋顶板、地板水泥和更坚固的抗风墙壁——这些物品可以使避难所更能抵御冬季，但通常被认为是安全问题。

paras.en: Mr. Baker said IOM was in repeated contact with the Israeli authorities to negotiate their entry.
paras.zh: 贝克先生表示，国际移民组织正在多次与以色列当局联系，以协商他们的入境事宜。

paras.en: “It is an everyday occurrence, five times per day, as we try to negotiate or we try to make sure that we have actually either understood what their concern is and trying to adjust whatever that might be,” he said.
paras.zh: “这种情况每天都会发生，每天五次，因为我们试图进行谈判，或者我们试图确保我们实际上已经了解他们的担忧是什么，并试图调整可能的任何内容，”他说。

paras.en: “From our perspective, we must continue to advocate for more durable items to get in.”
paras.zh: “从我们的角度来看，我们必须继续倡导更耐用的物品进入市场。”

articles.title: COP17: The world has a plan to save nature. Is it working?

paras.en: COP17: The world has a plan to save nature. Is it working?
paras.zh: COP17：世界有一个拯救自然的计划。有效吗？

paras.en: The UN Secretary-General has called for an end to the “war on nature”. On Monday, governments gathering in Yerevan, Armenia, will have to confront a more practical question: are they doing enough to win the peace and put the world’s biodiversity goals back on track?
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长呼吁结束“对自然的战争”。周一，各国政府齐聚亚美尼亚埃里温，将不得不面对一个更实际的问题：他们是否采取了足够的措施来赢得和平并使世界生物多样性目标重回正轨？

paras.en: COP17, the UN Biodiversity Conference, comes at a critical halfway point in the global effort to halt and reverse biodiversity loss by 2030. Running from 19 to 30 October, the meeting will take stock of progress, identify where countries are falling behind and, crucially, consider how to accelerate action over the next four years.
paras.zh: 联合国生物多样性大会 COP17 正值全球努力到 2030 年阻止和扭转生物多样性丧失的关键中点。会议将于 10 月 19 日至 30 日举行，会议将评估进展情况，确定各国在哪些方面落后，最重要的是，考虑如何在未来四年内加快行动。

paras.en: First things first: What is the global biodiversity framework?
paras.zh: 首先，什么是全球生物多样性框架？

paras.en: The big picture: Think of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework as the world’s blueprint for halting and reversing the destruction of nature.
paras.zh: 大局观：将昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架视为世界制止和扭转自然破坏的蓝图。

paras.en: Agreed in 2022, it contains 23 targets for 2030 and four longer-term goals for 2050. It tackles the main drivers of biodiversity loss, including changes in how land and seas are used, unsustainable exploitation of species, climate change, pollution and invasive species.
paras.zh: 它于 2022 年达成一致，包含 2030 年的 23 个目标和 2050 年的四个长期目标。它解决了生物多样性丧失的主要驱动因素，包括土地和海洋利用方式的变化、物种的不可持续利用、气候变化、污染和入侵物种。

paras.en: Its best known ambition is “30 by 30”: conserving 30 per cent of land and sea by 2030, the deadline for achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
paras.zh: 其最著名的雄心是“30 by 30”：到 2030 年（实现联合国可持续发展目标 (SDG) 的最后期限）保护 30% 的陆地和海洋。

paras.en: But, the framework goes much further, including financing for biodiversity, reforming harmful incentives, encouraging more sustainable production and consumption and addressing businesses’ impacts and dependencies on nature.
paras.zh: 但是，该框架更进一步，包括为生物多样性融资、改革有害激励措施、鼓励更可持续的生产和消费以及解决企业对自然的影响和依赖。

paras.en: Reality check: We’re not moving fast enough.
paras.zh: 现实检验：我们的行动还不够快。

paras.en: There has been movement. Nearly 90 per cent of the 196 parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity have established national biodiversity targets, close to 60 per cent have developed national biodiversity strategies and action plans and more than 70 per cent have submitted national reports.
paras.zh: 有动静了。 《生物多样性公约》196个缔约方中近90%的缔约方制定了国家生物多样性目标，近60%的缔约方制定了国家生物多样性战略和行动计划，70%以上的缔约方提交了国家报告。

paras.en: But, fewer than half of the national targets assessed by parties are on track. Ambition also remains short of the 30-by-30 goal, while major gaps persist in finance, capacity, cooperation and the data needed to track progress.
paras.zh: 但是，各方评估的国家目标只有不到一半步入正轨。距离 30×30 的目标仍然不够雄心，而在资金、能力、合作和跟踪进展所需的数据方面仍然存在重大差距。

paras.en: As Secretary-General António Guterres told leaders in Yerevan on Friday: “Halfway to 2030, Yerevan is our moment of accountability.”
paras.zh: 正如秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周五在埃里温告诉领导人的那样：“2030 年已过半，埃里温是我们承担责任的时刻。”

paras.en: Why it matters: COP17 is essentially about moving from promises to delivery.
paras.zh: 为什么重要：COP17 本质上是关于从承诺转向交付。

paras.en: Among the big issues governments will grapple with:
paras.zh: 政府将解决的重大问题包括：

paras.en: - Taking stock: Countries will undertake the first global review of collective progress under the framework, examining what has been achieved since 2022 and where faster action is needed.
paras.zh: - 盘点：各国将对该框架下的集体进展进行首次全球审查，审查自 2022 年以来取得的成就以及需要更快采取行动的领域。

paras.en: - Closing the implementation gap: The question is how to translate national targets and plans into measurable results on the ground.
paras.zh: - 缩小实施差距：问题是如何将国家目标和计划转化为可衡量的实地成果。

paras.en: - Finding the money: The framework calls for at least $200 billion annually from all sources by 2030, including at least $30 billion in international biodiversity finance, according to Armenia’s UN Ambassador Paruyr Hovhannisyan.
paras.zh: - 寻找资金：亚美尼亚驻联合国大使 Paruyr Hovhannisyan 表示，该框架要求到 2030 年，每年从各种来源筹集至少 2000 亿美元，其中包括至少 300 亿美元的国际生物多样性融资。

paras.en: - Making the Cali Fund work: Governments will have an opportunity to advance practical arrangements for the fund, designed to support fair and equitable benefit-sharing from commercial use of digital sequence information on genetic resources.
paras.zh: - 使卡利基金发挥作用：各国政府将有机会推进该基金的实际安排，旨在支持公平公正地分享遗传资源数字序列信息商业用途带来的惠益。

paras.en: - Tracking progress: Better monitoring, data, capacity and cooperation are needed so countries can measure whether commitments are actually delivering results.
paras.zh: - 跟踪进展：需要更好的监测、数据、能力和合作，以便各国能够衡量承诺是否真正带来成果。

paras.en: - Changing the economics: Some of the areas furthest behind require action outside environment ministries, including on finance, business, sustainable consumption and harmful incentives.
paras.zh: - 改变经济：一些最落后的领域需要环境部委以外的机构采取行动，包括金融、商业、可持续消费和有害激励措施。

paras.en: For host Armenia, success means COP17 becoming both a “review COP” and an “implementation COP”.
paras.zh: 对于东道主亚美尼亚来说，成功意味着COP17既成为“审查缔约方会议”又成为“执行缔约方会议”。

paras.en: “We cannot treat 2030 as a distant deadline,” Ambassador Hovhannisyan told UN News. “Decisions taken in Yerevan must help close the gap between commitments and results on the ground.”
paras.zh: “我们不能把 2030 年视为一个遥远的最后期限，”霍夫汉尼斯扬大使告诉《联合国新闻》。 “在埃里温做出的决定必须有助于缩小承诺与实际成果之间的差距。”

paras.en: Hambardzum Matevosyan, Armenia’s Environment Minister and incoming COP17 president, puts the progression simply: COP15 produced the framework and COP16 advanced mechanisms to implement it. COP17, he said, must establish “where we stand, what is working, where progress is falling short and what must change”.
paras.zh: 亚美尼亚环境部长、即将上任的 COP17 主席 Hambardzum Matevosyan 简单地概括了这一进程：COP15 制定了框架，COP16 则提出了实施该框架的先进机制。他说，COP17 必须确定“我们的立场、哪些措施有效、哪些进展不足以及哪些措施必须改变”。

paras.en: Biodiversity can sound abstract. Its loss is anything but.
paras.zh: 生物多样性听起来很抽象。它的损失绝非如此。

paras.en: As António Guterres reminded leaders on Friday, the food we eat, the water we drink and the air we breathe depend on it. The question in Yerevan is whether countries can turn an ambitious global agreement into action quickly enough.
paras.zh: 正如安东尼奥·古特雷斯周五提醒各国领导人的那样，我们吃的食物、喝的水和呼吸的空气都取决于它。埃里温的问题是各国能否足够快地将一项雄心勃勃的全球协议付诸行动。

paras.en: On Thursday, launching a major UN report evaluating global progress under the landmark Kunming framework, Astrid Schomaker, executive secretary of the Convention on Biological Diversity, distilled the challenge: “We know where we stand. We know where the gaps are. Now, we must work together to close them.”
paras.zh: 周四，《生物多样性公约》执行秘书阿斯特丽德·肖梅克 (Astrid Schomaker) 发布了一份重要的联合国报告，评估了具有里程碑意义的昆明框架下的全球进展，他总结了这一挑战：“我们知道自己所处的位置。我们知道差距在哪里。现在，我们必须共同努力缩小差距。”

articles.title: South Africa stutter on rain-hit day one against Australia

paras.en: South Africa stutter on rain-wrecked day against Australia in second Test as Scott Boland takes two wickets in two balls
paras.zh: 南非队在第二次测试中对阵澳大利亚队的比赛中遭遇大雨，斯科特·博兰在两个球中攻入两个三柱门

paras.en: Scott Boland dismisses Aiden Markram and David Bedingham from successive deliveries as South Africa close on 20-2 from 12.2 overs possible around the rain in Gqeberha; Australia - who left out premier spinner Nathan Lyon - lead three-Test series 1-0 after 214-run win in Durban
paras.zh: 斯科特·博兰 (Scott Boland) 驳回了艾登·马克拉姆 (Aiden Markram) 和大卫·贝丁厄姆 (David Bedingham) 的连续传球，南非在格贝哈 (Gqeberha) 雨天以 12.2 分的比分以 20-2 逼近；澳大利亚 - 排除了顶级旋转选手内森·里昂 - 在德班取得 214 分胜利后，在三场测试系列赛中以 1-0 领先

paras.en: South Africa stuttered to 20-2 in the 12.2 overs possible on a rain-hit day one of the second Test against Australia as Scott Boland struck twice in as many balls.
paras.zh: 在第二场测试赛的第一天，南非队在 12.2 球的比赛中以 20 胜 2 负的战绩与澳大利亚队进行第二次测试，斯科特·博兰 (Scott Boland) 击中了两倍的球数。

paras.en: Boland, selected in Gqeberha as Australia omitted off-spinner Nathan Lyon and went in with a four-pronged pace attack, bowled Aiden Markam (11) off an inside edge in the ninth over before then nicking off David Bedingham (0) with his next delivery.
paras.zh: 博兰德在格克贝哈被选中，因为澳大利亚队省略了旋转球手内森·里昂，并以四管齐下的速度进攻，在第九个回合中从内缘击倒了艾登·马卡姆（11），然后用他的下一次投球击倒了大卫·贝丁厄姆（0）。

paras.en: South Africa, 1-0 down in the three-match series after a 214-run defeat in the opening game at Durban, were 12-2 at that stage having been put into bat but reached the premature stumps without any further casualties as debutant Marques Ackerman (5no off 32 balls) and captain Temba Bavuma (4no off 13) battled.
paras.zh: 南非队在德班首场比赛中以 214 分失利后，在三场系列赛中以 1-0 落后，在该阶段以 12-2 的比分进入击球区，但在首次亮相的马克斯·阿克曼 (32 球中 5 球) 和队长 Temba Bavuma (13 球中 4 球) 的战斗中，过早地到达了树桩，没有任何进一步的伤亡。

paras.en: - Scorecard: South Africa vs Australia, second Test, Gqeberha
paras.zh: - 记分卡：南非 vs 澳大利亚，第二次测试，Gqeberha

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: - Listen to latest episode of the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast
paras.zh: - 收听天空体育板球播客的最新一集

paras.en: Rain meant play started around two hours later than scheduled and it returned to bring about an early lunch after just 5.3 overs before another downpour led to the day being abandoned at 4.15pm local time at St George's Park.
paras.zh: 由于下雨，比赛比原定时间晚了大约两个小时开始，仅进行了 5.3 轮比赛后，比赛就开始了，人们提前吃午饭，但当地时间下午 4.15 分，另一场倾盆大雨导致比赛在圣乔治公园取消。

paras.en: Boland for Lyon was Australia's only change from the first match, with the Baggy Greens leaving their premier spinner out of a red-ball Test in which he was fit to play for the first time since 2013.
paras.zh: 里昂队的博兰是澳大利亚自第一场比赛以来唯一的换人，松松绿队将他们的首席旋转球手排除在红球测试之外，这是他自 2013 年以来首次恢复上场。

paras.en: South Africa made three alterations with left-arm spinner Keshav Maharaj, wicketkeeper Kyle Verreynne and batter Tristan Stubbs axed for batters Ackerman and Matthew Breetzke and fit-again paceman Kagiso Rabada.
paras.zh: 南非队做出了三项调整，左臂旋转手凯沙夫·马哈拉杰、三柱门将凯尔·维雷恩和击球手特里斯坦·斯塔布斯被砍掉，击球手阿克曼和马修·布里茨克以及恢复健康的配速员卡吉索·拉巴达。

paras.en: Ryan Rickelton took the wicketkeeping gloves in Verreynne's absence and dropped down from his opening position to No 6, with Ackerman coming in to partner Markam at the top of the order.
paras.zh: 瑞安·里克尔顿（Ryan Rickelton）在维雷恩（Verreynne）缺席的情况下接过了守门手套，并从他的首发位置下降到第六位，阿克曼（Ackerman）与马卡姆（Markam）搭档排名第一。

paras.zh: 曼城保持完美战绩，切尔西、曼联和伦敦城狮队均获胜——女足超级联赛综述

paras.en: Manchester City continued their flawless Women's Super League record by beating Brighton; Chelsea hammered London rivals Tottenham; Manchester United cruised past rock-bottom Charlton; London City Lionesses beat Everton; West Ham won at Crystal Palace; Aston Villa beat Liverpool

paras.en: Brighton, though, rallied before the break with goals from Olivia Garcia and Caitlin Hayes.
paras.zh: 不过，布莱顿在中场休息前凭借奥利维亚·加西亚和凯特琳·海耶斯的进球重整旗鼓。

paras.zh: 伦敦城狮队以 2-1 击败埃弗顿，挤进前三名。

paras.en: First-half goals from Delphine Cascarino and England winger Freya Godfrey had seemingly put the Lionesses in control.
paras.zh: 上半场德尔菲娜·卡斯卡里诺和英格兰边锋弗雷娅·戈弗雷的进球似乎让母狮队控制了局面。

paras.zh: 然而，埃弗顿队在比赛还剩 20 分钟时替补出场的霍莉·麦克纳马拉头球破门，比赛气氛紧张。

paras.zh: 曼联在联赛三连胜后以3-1击败垫底球队查尔顿，目前排名上升至第五。

paras.en: Three goals in the opening 13 minutes saw Ella Toone and Andrea Medina put United two up before Leah Davidson pulled one back.
paras.zh: 开场 13 分钟内，埃拉·图恩和安德里亚·梅迪纳连进三球，帮助曼联取得两球领先，随后利亚·戴维森扳回一球。

paras.en: Julia Zigioitti Olme completed the scoring just after the half-hour mark.
paras.zh: 朱莉娅·齐吉奥蒂·奥尔姆 (Julia Zigioitti Olme) 在半小时后完成了得分。

paras.en: Aston Villa stunned faltering Liverpool, coming from behind to secure a 2-1 win for their first league success of the season.
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉队以2-1逆转击败了摇摇欲坠的利物浦队，取得了本赛季的联赛首胜。

paras.en: Natalia Ramos scored a spectacular early opener but Villa improved after half-time, with Chasity Grant firing in an equaliser before a Grace Fisk own goal.
paras.zh: 纳塔利娅·拉莫斯早早打进一球，但维拉在半场结束后有所进步，查西蒂·格兰特在格蕾丝·菲斯克自摆乌龙之前扳平比分。

paras.en: Kelly Gago scored the only goal in the first half as West Ham defeated Crystal Palace 1-0.
paras.zh: 凯利·加戈打入上半场唯一进球，帮助西汉姆联1-0战胜水晶宫。

articles.title: Ruthless Celtic hit seven past title rivals Hearts in emphatic win

paras.en: Celtic 7-1 Hearts: Hoops move four clear at top of Scottish Premiership with ruthless display against Jambos
paras.zh: 凯尔特人队 7-1 红心队：凭借对詹博斯的无情表现，篮网队在苏格兰联赛中领先四分

paras.en: Celtic put seven past Hearts to move four points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership; Kieran Tierney, Benjamin Nygren, Callum Osmand and Camilo Duran all scored against the Jambos, who remain third in the table
paras.zh: 凯尔特人队七场战胜红心队，在苏超积分榜上领先 4 分；基兰·蒂尔尼、本杰明·尼格伦、卡勒姆·奥斯曼德和卡米洛·杜兰在对阵詹博队的比赛中均取得进球，詹博队仍排名第三

paras.en: Celtic cruised to victory against title rivals Hearts to move four points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership.
paras.zh: 凯尔特人队战胜了争冠对手哈茨队，在苏超积分榜上领先四分。

paras.en: Hearts returned to Parkhead for the first time since their trophy heartbreak in May, hoping to exact some revenge, only for Celtic to pile on the misery.
paras.zh: 自从五月份奖杯失利后，哈茨队首次回到帕克黑德，希望能报仇，但凯尔特人队却陷入了痛苦之中。

paras.en: The Hoops raced into a two-goal lead inside the opening 10 minutes, with both goals coming from Mika Baur corners. Kieran Tierney headed home the opener before Benjamin Nygren's deflected volley doubled Celtic's advantage.
paras.zh: 开场 10 分钟内，篮球队就取得两球领先，两个进球均来自米卡·鲍尔 (Mika Baur) 的角球。基兰·蒂尔尼首开纪录，本杰明·尼格伦的凌空抽射将凯尔特人队的优势扩大了一倍。

paras.en: Callum Osmand, who secured Celtic's title five months ago, marked his first start for the club with a quickfire double. He capitalised on a terrible pass from Sabri Guendouz to slot home before heading in the rebound after Camilo Duran was denied.
paras.zh: 五个月前夺得凯尔特人冠军的卡勒姆·奥斯曼德以快速的双垒安打标志着他在俱乐部的首次首发。他利用萨布里·冈杜兹的糟糕传球破门，然后在卡米洛·杜兰被挡出后头球攻门。

paras.en: After missing a glorious chance, Duran made amends by curling home Celtic's sixth shortly after the restart, before Nygren added a seventh late on to cap a miserable afternoon for Hearts.
paras.zh: 在错失绝佳机会后，杜兰在比赛重新开始后不久为凯尔特人队打进第六球，弥补了这一遗憾，随后尼格伦又打进第七球，为哈茨队度过了一个悲惨的下午。

paras.en: 7: GOAL! Celtic take an early lead! Liam Scales gets on the end of Mika Baur's corner and he heads it to Kieran Tierney to nod into the net.

paras.en: 10: GOAL! Celtic's second corner, Celtic's second goal. Baur sends it in with Dane Murray flicking it on to Benjamin Nygren and his deflected volley hits the back of the net.
paras.zh: 10：目标！凯尔特人的第二个角球，凯尔特人的第二个进球。鲍尔将球传入，戴恩·穆雷将球传给本杰明·尼格伦，他的凌空抽射击中了球网。

paras.en: 18: OFF THE POST! Haissem Hassan easily beats Stephen Kingsley and gets a shot away, but it smacks the upright.
paras.zh: 18：下岗！海塞姆·哈桑轻松击败斯蒂芬·金斯利并射门，但这却打中了正直的球员。

paras.zh: 36：目标！卡勒姆·奥斯曼德 (Callum Osmand) 借助萨布里·古恩杜兹 (Sabri Guendouz) 的糟糕传球，庆祝自己的首次首发。

paras.en: 38: GOAL! Camilo Duran's first effort is saved by Reus. He pounces on the rebound and sends the ball to Osmand to head his second of the game.
paras.zh: 38：目标！卡米洛·杜兰的第一脚射门被罗伊斯扑出。他抓住篮板球，将球传给奥斯曼德，这是他本场比赛的第二个头球。

paras.en: 41: GOAL! The visitors pull one back before the break as Laurent Mendy curls a powerful drive into the net from around 16 yards.
paras.zh: 41：目标！中场休息前，洛朗·门迪 (Laurent Mendy) 在 16 码处一脚强力射门入网，客队扳回一球。

paras.zh: 45+1：进球！鲍尔突破防守，轻弹过罗伊斯，金斯利将球从后卫麦卡特身上击过自己的防线。

paras.en: 49: GOAL CELTIC! Tierney slips the ball through for Duran and he curls it into the net.
paras.zh: 49：进球凯尔特人！蒂尔尼将球传给杜兰，杜兰将球卷入球网。

paras.en: 83: GOAL CELTIC! Kasper Hogh spins away from the Hearts defence and plays it out to Nygren and he slots the ball into the corner.
paras.zh: 83：进球凯尔特人！卡斯帕·霍格（Kasper Hogh）摆脱红心队的防守，将球传给尼格伦（Nygren），尼格伦将球射入角球。

articles.title: Trump says Ukraine resuming strikes on Russian oil sites is a ‘disgrace’
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s midterm elections.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将乌克兰恢复对俄罗斯炼油厂的罢工称为“耻辱”，这是他在天然气价格上涨问题上向美国盟友施压的最新举措，天然气价格上涨可能会让共和党在下个月的中期选举中付出代价。

paras.en: Kyiv said Thursday that it would no longer abide by Trump’s “energy ceasefire,” citing Russia’s refusal to halt its own attacks on Ukraine’s power grid. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy angrily accused the U.S. of costing civilian lives by striking deals with Moscow and withdrawing support that is crucial to Kyiv’s defense against the invasion launched by President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 基辅周四表示，将不再遵守特朗普的“能源停火”，理由是俄罗斯拒绝停止对乌克兰电网的攻击。总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基愤怒地指责美国与莫斯科达成协议并撤回对基辅防御弗拉基米尔·普京总统发起的入侵至关重要的支持，从而造成平民丧生。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials had raised alarm after gaps in intelligence sharing left Kyiv vulnerable to Russian attacks and restrictions on the Starlink satellite service disrupted military operations. Zelenskyy said Friday that the technology was still not fully restored.
paras.zh: 情报共享的漏洞导致基辅容易受到俄罗斯的攻击，而且对星链卫星服务的限制扰乱了军事行动，乌克兰官员对此发出了警报。泽连斯基周五表示，该技术尚未完全恢复。

paras.en: With Ukraine defying his demands to halt strikes, Trump responded late Thursday.
paras.zh: 由于乌克兰无视他停止袭击的要求，特朗普周四晚间做出了回应。

paras.en: “If you tell me that Zelenskyy is again shooting at refineries, all he’s doing is making the world oil price higher,” Trump told Newsmax’s Rob Finnerty. “I think that’s a disgrace. There’s plenty of other targets; they don’t have to hit,” Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普对 Newsmax 的 Rob Finnerty 表示：“如果你告诉我，泽连斯基再次向炼油厂开枪，那么他所做的就是推高世界油价。” “我认为这是一种耻辱。还有很多其他目标；他们不必击中，”特朗普说。

paras.en: “Zelenskyy is not a good guy for us to deal with” on the war, he said, adding that “I think they actually both would like to see it end, but I think I find Zelenskyy to be more difficult to deal with than Putin.”
paras.zh: 他说，在战争问题上，“泽伦斯基对我们来说不是一个好对付的人”，并补充说，“我认为他们实际上都希望看到战争结束，但我认为我发现泽伦斯基比普京更难对付。”

paras.en: As his clash escalated with Trump, Zelenskyy was in Brussels on Friday to shore up support from European allies, whom he called “real leaders” as they gathered for a crucial summit.
paras.zh: 随着他与特朗普的冲突升级，泽伦斯基周五在布鲁塞尔寻求欧洲盟友的支持，他称这些盟友是“真正的领导人”，因为他们聚集在一起参加了一次重要的峰会。

paras.en: Ukraine hit a Russian oil refinery Thursday after Zelenskyy said he was “done” with the truce, which Trump had announced to the apparent surprise of both sides in the war. Neither Moscow nor Kyiv reported any new strikes on Russian refineries Friday.
paras.zh: 周四，乌克兰袭击了俄罗斯一家炼油厂，此前泽连斯基表示他已经“完成”了休战，而特朗普宣布的休战令显然让战争双方都感到惊讶。周五，莫斯科和基辅都没有报告俄罗斯炼油厂发生新的罢工。

paras.en: Trump has sought to blame Ukraine’s strikes for destabilizing the price of diesel globally, despite the impact of his own war with Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普试图将全球柴油价格不稳定归咎于乌克兰的袭击，尽管他自己与伊朗的战争也产生了影响。

paras.en: But this campaign of attacks deep inside enemy territory has given Ukraine crucial leverage, sparking a major fuel crisis inside Russia.
paras.zh: 但这场深入敌方领土的袭击行动给乌克兰带来了至关重要的影响力，引发了俄罗斯境内的重大燃料危机。

paras.en: Kyiv hoped this would give it a stronger hand at the negotiating table, but as Washington pushes for an end to the conflict it has taken a series of steps that have caused surprise and alarm among Ukraine and its backers in Europe.
paras.zh: 基辅希望这将使其在谈判桌上拥有更强的实力，但随着华盛顿推动结束冲突，它采取了一系列步骤，引起了乌克兰及其欧洲支持者的惊讶和警惕。

paras.en: Last week, Trump announced a deal to buy diesel from Russia, an apparent attempt to relieve pressure at the pump for American consumers ahead of the midterm elections but which reversed years of U.S. policy. Trump then called for Kyiv to stop all strikes on Russian oil infrastructure and said Zelenskyy had to be replaced as Ukraine’s leader.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普宣布了一项从俄罗斯购买柴油的协议，这显然是为了在中期选举前缓解美国消费者的压力，但这却扭转了美国多年来的政策。特朗普随后呼吁基辅停止对俄罗斯石油基础设施的所有袭击，并表示必须更换泽伦斯基作为乌克兰领导人。

paras.en: It comes amid mounting questions about whether the U.S. is still sharing critical military intelligence with Ukraine after a pair of major strikes earlier this week that Kyiv said came without a usual advance warning from its partners.
paras.zh: 在此之际，人们越来越多地质疑美国是否仍在与乌克兰分享关键军事情报，基辅称本周早些时候发动了两次重大袭击，而乌克兰的合作伙伴通常没有提前发出警告。

paras.en: Ukraine also reported a slowing down of the Starlink satellite terminals, which are critical for its army’s communications, drone missions and aerial defenses.
paras.zh: 乌克兰还报告称，星链卫星终端的运行速度有所放缓，这对于乌克兰军队的通信、无人机任务和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Kyiv said that Starshield, the military version of the technology that is used by Ukraine’s troops, had been limited without any warning.
paras.zh: 基辅表示，乌克兰军队使用的军用技术“星盾”在没有任何警告的情况下受到限制。

paras.en: SpaceX chief Elon Musk, the billionaire Trump ally, said that such decisions were up to the U.S. military and ultimately Trump.
paras.zh: 亿万富翁特朗普的盟友、SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克表示，此类决定取决于美国军方，最终取决于特朗普。

paras.en: After repeated requests for comment about Musk’s statement, a senior U.S. official told NBC News that “no such request was ever made by the president.” Trump has also denied restricting military intelligence for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在多次要求对马斯克的声明发表评论后，一名美国高级官员告诉 NBC 新闻，“总统从未提出过这样的要求。”特朗普还否认限制乌克兰的军事情报。

paras.en: Kyiv said Thursday the Starshield service was being restored, but the episode only added to the mounting suspicion in Ukraine that the U.S. was willing to cut it off from battlefield support in order to exert pressure for a peace deal. Asked about the service on Friday, Zelenskyy said that issues were ongoing. “Has the speed been fully restored to what it was? No. Is the speed returning? Yes,” he told reporters in Brussels.
paras.zh: 基辅周四表示，星盾服务正在恢复，但这一事件只会加剧乌克兰境内越来越多的怀疑，即美国愿意切断其战场支持，以施加压力以达成和平协议。周五被问及该服务时，泽伦斯基表示问题仍在继续。 “速度是否已完全恢复到原来的水平？没有。速度是否正在恢复？是的，”他在布鲁塞尔对记者说。

paras.en: European and Ukrainian officials told NBC News they believed that the moves, coming only days after Trump eased sanctions on Russia’s diesel exports and railed against Zelenskyy, were most likely aimed at pressuring Kyiv into making concessions at the negotiating table amid the stalemate in peace talks.
paras.zh: 欧洲和乌克兰官员告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他们认为，在特朗普放松对俄罗斯柴油出口的制裁并谴责泽连斯基几天后采取的举措很可能是为了迫使基辅在和平谈判陷入僵局的情况下在谈判桌上做出让步。

paras.en: The Kremlin agreed with Trump on Friday, with spokesman Dmitry Peskov saying it was clear that “Zelenskyy doesn’t want to take responsibility and move toward a peaceful resolution.”
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周五同意特朗普的观点，发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，很明显“泽伦斯基不想承担责任并走向和平解决”。

paras.en: Russia has always stated it’s open to a peace settlement but only on its own hard-line terms, which would see Ukraine ceding significant territory.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯一直表示，它对和平解决方案持开放态度，但仅限于其自己的强硬条款，这将导致乌克兰放弃大量领土。

articles.title: U.S. taking Putin’s side would be a ‘historic mistake,’ says Zelenskyy
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that the U.S. formally siding with Russia’s Vladimir Putin would be a “historic mistake,” but said he still sees President Donald Trump as an ally despite a series of moves that have unsettled his country and its friends on Capitol Hill.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基警告说，美国正式站在俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一边将是一个“历史性错误”，但他表示，尽管一系列举动让乌克兰及其在国会山的朋友感到不安，但他仍然将唐纳德·特朗普总统视为盟友。

paras.en: “We want to trust him,” Zelenskyy told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” on Sunday, referring to Trump. “I hope that he will change his decisions, because I think that it’s all mistakes, and it will not help us, and it will not help United States.”
paras.zh: “我们想要信任他，”泽连斯基周日在 NBC 新闻节目“会见媒体”节目中谈到特朗普时说道。 “我希望他改变决定，因为我认为这都是错误，这对我们没有帮助，对美国也没有帮助。”

paras.en: Trump on Friday waived sweeping new sanctions against Russia passed by Congress, saying in an executive order that the move “is in the national interests of the United States.” Passed with bipartisan support and signed by Trump last month, the sanctions were intended to target Russia’s revenue streams by punishing global buyers of Russian oil and gas.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五放弃了国会通过的针对俄罗斯的全面新制裁，并在一项行政命令中表示，此举“符合美国的国家利益”。这些制裁措施在两党支持下通过并由特朗普上个月签署，旨在通过惩罚俄罗斯石油和天然气的全球买家来瞄准俄罗斯的收入来源。

paras.en: The waiver came days after a deal with Putin to release hundreds of thousands of tons of Russian diesel fuel onto the global market as fuel prices soar.
paras.zh: 几天前，随着燃油价格飙升，与普京达成协议，向全球市场释放数十万吨俄罗斯柴油。

paras.en: At the same time, Zelenskyy said, U.S. intelligence sharing was briefly “blocked,” blinding Ukraine to incoming ballistic missiles, while limits have been placed on Starlink technology critical to intercept jet-powered drones.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，与此同时，美国的情报共享被短暂“封锁”，使乌克兰对来袭的弹道导弹视而不见，而对拦截喷气式无人机至关重要的星链技术也受到了限制。

paras.en: Zelenskyy told moderator Kristen Welker that Ukrainian officials believe the decision to limit Starlink, imposed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, came in response to a “message from American government.”
paras.zh: 泽连斯基告诉主持人克里斯汀·韦尔克，乌克兰官员认为，埃隆·马斯克的 SpaceX 实施的限制星链的决定是对“美国政府的信息”的回应。

paras.en: The U.S. has been Ukraine’s most significant backer across four and a half years of war, but personal relations between Trump and Zelenskyy have appeared severely strained in recent weeks, with each offering public criticisms of the other.
paras.zh: 在四年半的战争中，美国一直是乌克兰最重要的支持者，但特朗普和泽连斯基之间的个人关系最近几周似乎严重紧张，双方都公开批评对方。

paras.en: Asked about Trump’s remark this week that the Ukrainian leader was “more difficult to deal with than Putin,” Zelenskyy said he was “very honest” with Trump.
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普本周表示乌克兰领导人“比普京更难对付”时，泽连斯基表示他对特朗普“非常诚实”。

paras.en: “Maybe it’s not very polite,” he said, but it is “better to have partners who are very open and clear than to have those who are killers, even with a smile on their face.”
paras.zh: “也许这不太礼貌，”他说，但“拥有非常开放和清晰的合作伙伴比拥有那些脸上挂着微笑的杀手要好。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy, who accused the U.S. of betraying Kyiv last week, said that his feelings have not changed. He warned that Trump’s diesel deal with Russia “will strengthen Putin in his will to occupy us.”
paras.zh: 上周指责美国背叛基辅的泽连斯基表示，他的感受没有改变。他警告说，特朗普与俄罗斯的柴油协议“将增强普京占领我们的意志”。

paras.en: Announcing the deal week, Trump expressed hopes that it would go some way to address soaring fuel costs.
paras.zh: 特朗普在本周宣布该协议时表示，希望该协议能在某种程度上解决不断飙升的燃料成本问题。

paras.en: But Zelenskyy said the deal wouldn’t have “a real influence” on the price of oil in the U.S. because the rising prices were due to the blockage of the Strait of Hormuz, not Ukraine.
paras.zh: 但泽伦斯基表示，该协议不会对美国石油价格产生“真正影响”，因为价格上涨是由于霍尔木兹海峡的封锁，而不是乌克兰。

paras.en: “I don’t know all the reasons why President Trump makes such deals,” he said.
paras.zh: “我不知道特朗普总统做出此类交易的所有原因，”他说。

paras.en: Of the prospect of the U.S. more formally siding with Russia, he said: “If these two countries will be together ... we will not prevail, and we will not be able to stand.”
paras.zh: 在谈到美国更正式地站在俄罗斯一边的前景时，他说：“如果这两个国家在一起……我们就不会获胜，我们也将无法站立。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said it was a “pity” Trump had waived the sanctions in a bill named for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., who he said was “a great supporter of peace and of Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，“遗憾的是”特朗普在一项以已故南卡罗来纳州参议员林赛·格雷厄姆 (Lindsey Graham) 命名的法案中放弃了制裁，他称格雷厄姆是“和平与乌克兰的伟大支持者”。

paras.en: “He invested his life and time because he really believed in Ukraine,” he said.
paras.zh: “他投入了生命和时间，因为他真的相信乌克兰，”他说。

paras.en: In a separate interview on “Meet the Press,” Sen. James Lankford, R-Okla., defended Trump’s decision to lift the Russia sanctions.
paras.zh: 在接受媒体采访时，俄克拉荷马州共和党参议员詹姆斯·兰克福德为特朗普取消对俄罗斯制裁的决定进行了辩护。

paras.en: “He’s trying to walk this fine balance between trying to be able to put pressure on Russia, but also to be able to help the American people, so he is choosing the American people first is what he’s doing,” Lankford said, pointing to high gas prices.
paras.zh: 兰克福德表示，“他试图在向俄罗斯施加压力和帮助美国人民之间取得良好的平衡，因此他首先选择美国人民，这就是他所做的。”他指的是高油价。

paras.en: Asked whether Trump’s moves indicate the president is siding with Putin, Lankford said that Trump was “siding with the free people of Ukraine,” adding later that Trump was working to get the two countries “to the table to be able to negotiate.”
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普的举动是否表明总统站在普京一边时，兰克福德表示，特朗普“站在乌克兰自由人民一边”，后来又补充说，特朗普正在努力让两国“坐到谈判桌前”。

paras.en: The war has seen little recent movement on the frontline, with Russia continuing to occupy around a fifth of Ukraine. Trump had vowed to end the conflict within days of his second term, but peace talks have effectively stalled, with Ukraine saying that Russia has rejected a short-term ceasefire and that Putin’s terms for peace are tantamount to a full surrender.
paras.zh: 战争前线最近几乎没有动静，俄罗斯继续占领着乌克兰约五分之一的领土。特朗普发誓要在他的第二个任期内结束冲突，但和平谈判实际上已经陷入僵局，乌克兰表示俄罗斯拒绝短期停火，而普京的和平条件相当于全面投降。

paras.en: Meanwhile, another difficult winter looms for Ukrainian civilians, with a critical munitions shortage limiting Zelenskyy’s ability to defend infrastructure against Russian strikes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰平民又将迎来一个艰难的冬天，严重的弹药短缺限制了泽连斯基保卫基础设施免受俄罗斯袭击的能力。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said he was due to speak to U.S. negotiators by phone later Sunday and was still hopeful of a meeting in the days ahead. “I’m very open for this, even with all the difficult circumstances,” he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，他定于周日晚些时候与美国谈判代表通电话，并仍对未来几天的会面抱有希望。 “即使在困难的情况下，我对此也持开放态度，”他说。

paras.en: He cited some progress after a multiday interruption to U.S. intelligence about incoming Russian ballistic missiles, which he said has now been “deblocked.”
paras.zh: 他列举了美国有关俄罗斯弹道导弹来袭的情报经过多日中断后取得的一些进展，他说这些情报现在已经“解除封锁”。

paras.en: “We are very thankful for this,” he said. “Now it works.”
paras.zh: “我们对此非常感激，”他说。 “现在可以了。”

paras.en: European and Ukrainian officials previously told NBC News they believed that a move to limit sharing intelligence, coming only days after Trump eased sanctions on Russia, were most likely aimed at pressuring Kyiv into making concessions at the negotiating table amid a stalemate in peace talks.
paras.zh: 欧洲和乌克兰官员此前告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他们认为，在特朗普放松对俄罗斯制裁几天后采取的限制情报共享的举措很可能是为了迫使基辅在和平谈判陷入僵局的情况下在谈判桌上做出让步。

paras.en: While Zelenskyy indicated that the intelligence problem has been resolved, he said that Ukraine was still facing an ongoing speed restriction on its use of Starshield, the military version of the Starlink service.
paras.zh: 虽然泽伦斯基表示情报问题已经解决，但他表示乌克兰在使用星盾（星链服务的军用版本）方面仍面临持续的速度限制。

paras.en: Asked if he thought Trump or Musk had directly made the decision to limit Starlink, Zelenskyy said that he didn’t know but thought “both” were involved. He said that if Trump decided tomorrow to lift the restriction, “it will immediately work as it was before.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否认为特朗普或马斯克直接做出了限制星链的决定时，泽连斯基表示他不知道，但认为“两者”都参与其中。他说，如果特朗普明天决定取消限制，“它将立即像以前一样发挥作用。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: Aussies survives dramatic collapse to beat New Zealand in first women's T20

paras.en: Sat, 22 Aug, 11:00 pm, Final score, AUS 210, BAN 64 & 95
paras.zh: 8 月 22 日星期六，晚上 11:00，最终成绩，AUS 210，BAN 64 和 95

paras.en: Australia survives dramatic collapse to beat New Zealand by two wickets in first women's T20
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在首场女子 T20 比赛中以两个三柱门击败新西兰队，从戏剧性的崩溃中幸存下来

paras.en: Australia has beaten New Zealand by two wickets in the first ODI at North Sydney Oval.
paras.zh: 在北悉尼椭圆形球场举行的首场 ODI 比赛中，澳大利亚以两个三柱门的优势击败了新西兰。

paras.en: The hosts survived a dramatic late collapse to get home with seven balls to spare.
paras.zh: 主队在最后时刻的戏剧性崩溃中幸存下来，带着七个球回到家。

paras.en: The series continues at the same venue on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 该系列赛将于周二在同一地点继续进行。

articles.title: Jordon Steele-John says he has been falsely accused of inappropriate conduct
articles.author: Cason Ho

paras.en: Greens senator Jordan Steele-John has addressed allegations of inappropriate conduct towards women.
paras.zh: 绿党参议员乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰回应了针对女性的不当行为的指控。

paras.en: In a public statement on social media, he denied any wrongdoing and blamed the public fallout from the allegations against him on party "factionalism".
paras.zh: 在社交媒体上的公开声明中，他否认有任何不当行为，并将针对他的指控造成的公众影响归咎于政党“派系主义”。

paras.en: Senator Steele-John says he is not on leave and the matter is now subject to an internal Greens investigation.
paras.zh: 参议员斯蒂尔-约翰表示，他并没有休假，此事目前正在接受绿党内部调查。

paras.en: Greens senator Jordon Steele-John has denied allegations of inappropriate conduct raised in a letter to the Greens, which he says included false allegations of sexual assault, and blamed the public fallout from the allegations against him on party "factionalism".
paras.zh: 绿党参议员乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰否认了在给绿党的一封信中提出的不当行为指控，他说其中包括虚假的性侵犯指控，并将针对他的指控造成的公众影响归咎于政党的“派系主义”。

paras.en: The Greens have been in crisis management since the existence of a 47-page dossier surfaced about how the WA Greens would manage media coverage of allegations made about Senator Steele-John.
paras.zh: 自从一份长达 47 页的档案浮出水面以来，绿党一直在进行危机管理，该档案涉及西澳绿党将如何应对媒体对参议员斯蒂尔-约翰的指控的报道。

paras.en: It was previously reported Senator Steele-John had taken leave from the party room last week after a letter from seven party members was sent to the office of Greens leader David Shoebridge.
paras.zh: 此前有报道称，参议员斯蒂尔-约翰上周在七名党员的一封信被送到绿党领袖大卫·舒布里奇的办公室后离开了党室。

paras.en: According to media reports the letter alleged the writers were aware of "multiple allegations" about his behaviour in the presence of women, although none of the writers was said to have direct knowledge of "the matters involved", according to Senator Shoebridge.
paras.zh: 据媒体报道，这封信称，作者们知道有关他在女性面前的行为的“多项指控”，但参议员舒布里奇表示，尽管据说没有一位作者直接了解“所涉及的事项”。

paras.en: In a public statement on social media, Senator Steele-John said, among the false allegations made against him, was an allegation of sexual assault, which police had investigated and made no adverse findings against him, with a finding of no charges.
paras.zh: 参议员斯蒂尔-约翰在社交媒体上发表的公开声明中表示，在针对他的虚假指控中，有一项是性侵犯指控，警方已经对此进行了调查，没有对他做出不利的调查结果，没有发现任何指控。

paras.en: He said that, with respect to that complaint, he had faced abuse and threats before the original complaint to police was made.
paras.zh: 他说，就该投诉而言，在向警方提出最初的投诉之前，他曾面临虐待和威胁。

paras.en: Senator Steele-John addressed several other allegations which he said were put to him by a journalist, which are now the subject of an internal Greens investigation.
paras.zh: 参议员斯蒂尔-约翰谈到了其他几项指控，他说这些指控是一名记者向他提出的，这些指控现在是绿党内部调查的主题。

paras.en: He said a nickname others used to refer to him, "Feels on wheels", had grown from its original meaning to something "more sinister".
paras.zh: 他说，其他人用来称呼他的绰号“感觉在轮子上”，已经从原来的含义变成了“更险恶的”。

paras.en: "Other parties started using [the name] to refer to me after I became emotional early in my career while giving speeches about the Royal Commission into Violence, Abuse, Neglect and Exploitation of Disabled People," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在我职业生涯早期发表有关暴力、虐待、忽视和剥削皇家委员会的演讲时，我变得情绪化，其他政党开始使用[这个名字]来称呼我。”

paras.en: "This phrase, which mocked my disability and my emotions, had taken on a new, more sinister meaning: that I had treated women inappropriately."
paras.zh: “这句话嘲笑了我的残疾和我的情绪，现在有了新的、更险恶的含义：我对待女性的方式不当。”

paras.en: The senator said his experience as a victim of abuse had collided with "political games", and denied he had taken leave after the allegations surfaced.
paras.zh: 这位参议员表示，他作为虐待受害者的经历与“政治游戏”相冲突，并否认指控浮出水面后他已休假。

paras.en: "I had hoped to be able to share all of this when I was ready, but because of a political clique in Greens WA and a leader facing his first serious test of leadership, I feel that the silence of self-protection will be [and has been] perceived as the silence of guilt," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我本来希望在准备好时能够分享这一切，但由于西澳绿党的一个政治派系和一位领导人面临着第一次严峻的领导力考验，我觉得自我保护的沉默将被视为内疚的沉默。”

paras.en: The senator claimed an "unofficial faction" of the Greens WA branch had released a letter detailing the allegations against him.
paras.zh: 这位参议员声称，绿党西澳分部的一个“非官方派别”发布了一封信，详细说明了针对他的指控。

paras.en: "This is not accountability. It is factionalism, and it has no place in the Greens," he said.
paras.zh: “这不是问责制。这是派系主义，绿党不允许这样做，”他说。

paras.en: In a statement, a Greens WA party spokesperson said they were "putting together an independent process to assess the allegations".
paras.zh: 西澳绿党发言人在一份声明中表示，他们正在“制定一个独立的程序来评估这些指控”。

paras.en: "To ensure the integrity of that process, we will not be commenting further at this time," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“为了确保该流程的完整性，我们目前不会进一步发表评论。”

paras.en: Senator Steele-John said he had asked Senator Shoebridge "not to announce that I had requested leave" as it would appear to validate the allegations against him.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰参议员表示，他已要求舒布里奇参议员“不要宣布我已请求休假”，因为这似乎证实了对他的指控。

paras.en: "I had expected him to recognise that absent any specific allegations, there was no procedural need for me to take leave of any kind," Senator Steele-John said.
paras.zh: “我原以为他会认识到，如果没有任何具体指控，我就没有任何程序上的必要请假，”参议员斯蒂尔-约翰说。

paras.en: "It was a bad call from David. We've all made those in politics.
paras.zh: “大卫的决定很糟糕。我们在政界都曾做出过这样的决定。

paras.en: "So, to be clear, I am not on leave and did not agree to the inclusion of that line within David's statement."
paras.zh: “所以，需要明确的是，我没有休假，也不同意将这句话纳入大卫的声明中。”

paras.en: Senator Shoebridge's office has been contacted for comment.
paras.zh: 已联系参议员舒布里奇的办公室征求意见。

articles.title: French police arrest 1,800 after violent clashes and looting mar protests

paras.en: Approximately 1,800 people were arrested in France over the weekend as protests turned violent.
paras.zh: 周末，随着抗议活动演变成暴力活动，法国约有 1,800 人被捕。

paras.en: Hundreds of shops were looted in Paris and other cities and losses are estimated to be in the hundreds of millions of euros.
paras.zh: 巴黎和其他城市数百家商店遭到抢劫，损失估计达数亿欧元。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said investigations are underway and President Macron is expected to address the nation.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，调查正在进行中，预计马克龙总统将向全国发表讲话。

paras.en: France is reeling from widespread damage caused by violent protests that saw 1,800 people arrested, a historic town hall torched and widespread looting.
paras.zh: 法国正遭受暴力抗议造成的广泛破坏，1,800 人被捕，历史悠久的市政厅被纵火，还有大范围的抢劫。

paras.en: "It's like we had a war," a 78-year-old resident in central Paris, Mehmet Ozeden, said amid burnt street barricades from the protests.
paras.zh: “这就像我们经历了一场战争，”巴黎市中心 78 岁的居民穆罕默德·奥泽登 (Mehmet Ozeden) 在抗议活动烧毁的街道路障中说道。

paras.en: The convulsion raised the stakes for President Emmanuel Macron, who is in his final months in power before elections to replace him in six months' time.
paras.zh: 这次骚乱增加了总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)的赌注，他现在正处于执政的最后几个月，六个月后将举行接替他的选举。

paras.en: It followed weeks of student protests that had also turned violent at times.
paras.zh: 在此之前，学生抗议活动已持续数周，有时甚至演变成暴力事件。

paras.en: President Macron was to address the nation Sunday evening at 1800 GMT, his office said, after meeting key ministers.
paras.zh: 马克龙总统办公室表示，在与重要部长会面后，马克龙总统将于格林威治标准时间周日晚上 1800 点向全国发表讲话。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said 1,800 people were arrested over the protests and looting, with investigations under way "to identify the perpetrators of these acts so they can be brought to justice".
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，有 1,800 人因抗议和抢劫而被捕，调查正在进行中，“以查明这些行为的肇事者，以便将他们绳之以法”。

paras.en: Torched cars, smashed shopfronts and burnt debris scarred numerous streets in Paris, where officials said 557 people were in custody after a "record" number of arrests.
paras.zh: 巴黎多条街道上被烧毁的汽车、被砸毁的店面和烧焦的碎片造成伤痕累累，官员称，逮捕人数创“创纪录”，目前有 557 人被拘留。

paras.en: The capital experienced "a level of violence that we have never, I believe, seen before", said Paris deputy mayor Lamia El Aaraje.
paras.zh: 巴黎副市长拉米亚·埃尔·阿拉杰 (Lamia El Aaraje) 表示，首都经历了“我相信我们以前从未见过的暴力程度”。

paras.en: Hundreds of shops were looted in Paris and other cities, including Marseille, Bordeaux, Nice and Strasbourg, during the protests over the cost of living.
paras.zh: 在针对生活成本的抗议活动中，巴黎和马赛、波尔多、尼斯和斯特拉斯堡等其他城市的数百家商店遭到抢劫。

paras.en: One person died during the main march in Paris, but officials said it was health-related and not linked to the protest violence.
paras.zh: 巴黎主要游行期间有一人死亡，但官员表示，这与健康有关，与抗议暴力无关。

paras.en: Around 1,500 businesses were damaged, causing losses estimated in the hundreds of millions of euros, according to the Retail and Trade Federation.
paras.zh: 据零售和贸易联合会称，大约 1,500 家企业遭到破坏，造成的损失估计达数亿欧元。
