paras.en: Lakhi Bai, 62, from Ramnagar in Maihar district, Madhya Pradesh, in central India, about 500 miles away, came to Delhi seeking treatment for diabetes and a condition that she says causes numbness and a loss of sensation in parts of her body.
paras.zh: 62 岁的拉基·拜 (Lakhi Bai) 来自印度中部中央邦迈哈尔区的拉姆纳加尔 (距此约 500 英里)，她来到德里寻求糖尿病治疗，她说这种疾病导致她身体某些部位麻木和失去知觉。

paras.en: She says she could sometimes sustain an injury without feeling pain. When we met her, she had been sleeping outside Safdarjung Hospital for about 20 days. During that time, she says, she had been going to different doctors and departments for consultations and tests but had not yet received a treatment plan.
paras.zh: 她说，有时她可能会受伤而不会感到疼痛。当我们见到她时，她已经在 Safdarjung 医院外面睡了大约 20 天。她说，那段时间她曾到不同的医生和科室咨询和检查，但尚未得到治疗方案。

paras.en: Bai is a farmer and describes herself as a homemaker. She said she has three sons but is no longer in contact with them. She came to Delhi alone.
paras.zh: 白是一名农民，自称是一名家庭主妇。她说她有三个儿子，但已不再与他们联系。她独自一人来到德里。

paras.en: "I cannot afford to bring someone with me," she says. "If I bring someone, I have to pay for their food and accommodation, too."
paras.zh: “我负担不起带人一起去，”她说。 “如果我带人来，我也必须支付他们的食物和住宿费用。”

paras.en: It's been a difficult period. "Sometimes I don't even get food," she says. "I sleep with an empty stomach."
paras.zh: 这是一段艰难的时期。 “有时我什至买不到食物，”她说。 “我是空着肚子睡觉的。”

paras.en: Sleeping outside is also stressful. The heat is hard to endure, she said, as is rainwater.
paras.zh: 睡在外面也有压力。她说，炎热的天气让人难以忍受，雨水也是如此。

paras.en: "When it rains, water comes here," she said. "There is nowhere to go."
paras.zh: “下雨的时候，水就会流到这里，”她说。 “无处可去。”

paras.en: AIIMS did not respond to requests for comment about her account or the experiences described by other families interviewed for this story.
paras.zh: AIIMS 没有回应对她的账户或接受本文采访的其他家庭所描述的经历发表评论的请求。

paras.en: Bai did not know how much longer she would have to remain in Delhi. "I have no place to stay," she says. "I just pray that I can get the treatment I need and something can be done."
paras.zh: 白不知道自己还要在德里待多久。 “我没有地方住，”她说。 “我只是祈祷我能得到我需要的治疗，并且能做点什么。”

paras.en: A month outside awaiting a child's heart treatment
paras.zh: 孩子在外面等待心脏治疗一个月

paras.en: In August, Balraam Singh, 35, a brick-kiln worker from Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, had been sleeping outside Safdarjung Hospital for about a month with his wife and their 7-year-old son, Munna Singh.
paras.zh: 8 月，来自北方邦密拉特的 35 岁砖窑工人巴尔拉姆·辛格 (Balraam Singh) 与妻子和 7 岁的儿子穆纳·辛格 (Munna Singh) 在萨夫达容医院外睡了大约一个月。

paras.en: Munna has a heart condition that his father describes as a "hole in the heart."
paras.zh: 穆纳患有心脏病，他的父亲将其描述为“心中有一个洞”。

paras.en: They had come from about 50 miles away seeking further medical evaluation and treatment at Safdarjung Hospital.
paras.zh: 他们从大约 50 英里外来到萨夫达容医院寻求进一步的医疗评估和治疗。

paras.en: "We came with a lot of hope that we would find a doctor and my son would be treated," he says. "But now it feels like we may have to go back without knowing what will happen next.
paras.zh: “我们满怀希望地来到这里，希望能找到一位医生，让我的儿子得到治疗，”他说。 “但现在感觉我们可能不得不回去，而不知道接下来会发生什么。

paras.en: For Singh, who can earn $5 to $7 a day at the kiln where he works, staying in Delhi means not only a loss of income but the need to spend money on food and other daily needs.
paras.zh: 辛格在他工作的窑炉里每天可以赚到 5 至 7 美元，对于他来说，留在德里不仅意味着收入损失，还需要花钱购买食物和其他日常必需品。

paras.en: Six months of saving for another hospital visit
paras.zh: 为再次就诊节省六个月的费用

paras.en: Gulshan Bano, 38, had come to Delhi from Bihar with her 60-year-old mother, Asma Khatoon, and her 6-year-old daughter, Fiza. They had been sleeping outside Safdarjung Hospital for about a week when we met them in August.
paras.zh: 38 岁的古尔珊·巴诺 (Gulshan Bano) 与 60 岁的母亲阿斯玛·哈图恩 (Asma Khatoon) 以及 6 岁的女儿菲扎 (Fiza) 从比哈尔邦来到德里。当我们八月份见到他们时，他们已经在 Safdarjung 医院外睡了大约一周。

paras.en: Bano says her mother has had a heart condition for several years and was receiving treatment in Bihar. Her mother had undergone checkups and tests there, but the family felt she needed further evaluation and care.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，她的母亲患有心脏病好几年了，正在比哈尔邦接受治疗。她的母亲在那里接受了检查和检查，但家人认为她需要进一步的评估和护理。

paras.en: Relatives also advised them to seek treatment in Delhi, and the family decided to travel for further consultations and tests.
paras.zh: 亲戚们也建议他们去德里寻求治疗，一家人决定前往进一步咨询和检查。

paras.en: Bano said doctors have told them that her mother has a heart problem and have prescribed medication rather than recommending surgery.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，医生告诉他们，她的母亲有心脏病，并开了药物，而不是建议手术。

paras.en: The family returns to Delhi for checkups about every six months. To pay for the trips, Bano works in domestic jobs in Bihar.
paras.zh: 一家人大约每六个月返回德里进行一次检查。为了支付旅费，巴诺在比哈尔邦从事家政工作。

paras.en: "I work for months and save whatever I can, and then I come here," she says. "Whatever little money remains has to be used here."
paras.zh: “我工作了几个月，尽我所能存钱，然后才来到这里，”她说。 “剩下的一点钱都得用在这里。”

paras.en: Bano said her husband does not contribute to her mother's medical expenses and she has little choice but to keep making the journey to Delhi.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，她的丈夫不承担她母亲的医疗费用，她别无选择，只能继续前往德里。

paras.en: A visit can last about a month, Bano said, as the family waits for scheduled consultations, tests and follow-up care. Because they cannot afford other accommodation, they sleep outside the hospital between appointments and tests rather than return home and make another journey to Delhi.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，一次探访可能会持续大约一个月，家人会等待预定的咨询、检查和后续护理。由于他们无力承担其他住宿费用，他们在预约和检查之间睡在医院外面，而不是回家并再次前往德里。

paras.en: "Where should I go?" she said. "I have to come here because my mother needs treatment."
paras.zh: “我该去哪里？”她说。 “我必须来这里，因为我母亲需要治疗。”

paras.en: For families like Bano's, charities and volunteers can provide some of the practical support they need while they wait outside the hospitals.
paras.zh: 对于像巴诺这样的家庭来说，慈善机构和志愿者可以在他们在医院外等待时提供他们所需的一些实际支持。

paras.en: Rajiv Ranjan, who works with the Delhi-based Donate A Meal Trust, said his organization regularly helps patients and their attendants staying outside AIIMS and Safdarjung Hospital by distributing food, clothes and rations.
paras.zh: 拉吉夫·兰詹 (Rajiv Ranjan) 在德里的捐赠膳食信托基金 (Donate A Meal Trust) 工作，他表示，他的组织定期通过分发食品、衣服和口粮来帮助留在 AIIMS 和 Safdarjung 医院外的患者及其护理人员。

paras.en: He said the organization has seen many families remain outside the hospitals while seeking treatment or caring for relatives inside.
paras.zh: 他说，该组织发现许多家庭仍在医院外寻求治疗或照顾医院内的亲属。

paras.en: "We come here for people who sleep outside while they or their family members are receiving treatment inside the hospital," he says. "They have nowhere else to stay, so we try to help with whatever we can." The group distributes about 100 meals a day, Ranjan says.
paras.zh: “我们来这里是为了那些在外面睡觉而他们或他们的家人在医院接受治疗的人，”他说。 “他们无处可住，所以我们尽力提供帮助。” Ranjan 说，该组织每天分发大约 100 份餐食。

paras.en: Food, however, is only one of the needs.
paras.zh: 然而，食物只是需求之一。

paras.en: "People need shade from the sun, and during the rainy season they need somewhere to stay dry," Ranjan said. "Some of them take shelter under the Delhi Metro, the city's rapid-transit rail system, when it rains."
paras.zh: 兰詹说：“人们需要遮阳，在雨季，他们需要有地方保持干燥。” “下雨时，他们中的一些人会在德里地铁（该市的快速交通铁路系统）下避难。”

paras.en: For Shalini Yadav, the 20-year-old college student from Madhya Pradesh who traveled to Delhi for treatment, the food distributions and other help have become part of life outside the hospital. She said people arrive to help in whatever way they can, but the assistance does not reach everyone.
paras.zh: 对于前往德里接受治疗的中央邦 20 岁大学生沙利尼·亚达夫 (Shalini Yadav) 来说，分发食物和其他帮助已成为医院外生活的一部分。她说，人们尽其所能地提供帮助，但援助并没有惠及所有人。

paras.en: "Sometimes we get food. When we don't, we buy it nearby. But there are many people here who don't get anything to eat."
paras.zh: “有时我们能买到食物。当我们没有时，我们就在附近买。但这里有很多人没有东西吃。”

paras.en: For families, treatment means returning to Delhi again and again
paras.zh: 对于家庭来说，治疗意味着一次又一次返回德里

paras.en: Suhana Bano, 47, from Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, has been bringing her 18-year-old son, Mohammad Sameer, to Delhi for treatment for about two years.
paras.zh: 47 岁的苏哈娜·巴诺 (Suhana Bano) 来自北方邦巴雷利 (Bareilly)，她带着 18 岁的儿子穆罕默德·萨米尔 (Mohammad Sameer) 来德里接受治疗已有两年了。

paras.en: Sameer has irritable bowel syndrome. He was in seventh grade when this digestive ailment forced him to leave school. The family first sought treatment at several hospitals in Bareilly, about 155 miles from Delhi, before traveling to Safdarjung Hospital.
paras.zh: 萨米尔患有肠易激综合症。当他七年级时，这种消化疾病迫使他辍学。这家人首先在距离德里约 155 英里的巴雷利的几家医院寻求治疗，然后前往萨夫达容医院。

paras.en: Suhana Bano said the family turned to Delhi after seeking treatment locally, hoping to find the specialized care Sameer needed.
paras.zh: 苏哈娜·巴诺说，一家人在当地寻求治疗后转向德里，希望能找到萨米尔所需的专门护理。

paras.en: The family travels to Delhi whenever Sameer is due for a consultation or tests. Typically, they stay one to two months, Bano says. While in Delhi, the family sleeps outside Safdarjung because they cannot afford a room.
paras.zh: 每当萨米尔需要接受咨询或检查时，全家都会前往德里。巴诺说，通常情况下，他们会停留一到两个月。在德里期间，一家人睡在萨夫达琼外面，因为他们买不起房间。

paras.en: Aamar Singh, 60, a farmer from Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, had been sleeping outside AIIMS for about a week when we met him in April.
paras.zh: 60 岁的阿马尔·辛格 (Aamar Singh) 是北方邦哈斯拉斯 (Hathras) 的一名农民，我们四月份见到他时，他已经在 AIIMS 外面睡了大约一周了。

paras.en: His 35-year-old daughter, Neelam, was admitted to the AIIMS intensive care unit with a respiratory problem, he said. His 40-year-old sister, Rashima, stayed outside with him. At night, they sleep alongside stray dogs that also gather on the pavement.
paras.zh: 他说，他 35 岁的女儿尼拉姆 (Neelam) 因呼吸系统问题被送进 AIIMS 重症监护室。他 40 岁的妹妹拉希玛 (Rashima) 和他一起呆在外面。晚上，他们和聚集在人行道上的流浪狗一起睡觉。

paras.en: Singh does not know how long his daughter will remain in the ICU after being admitted for treatment and therefore does not know how long he will have to remain outside.
paras.zh: 辛格不知道他的女儿入院接受治疗后将在重症监护室待多久，因此也不知道他必须在外面待多久。

paras.en: Food is not always available, he said, and some days they go hungry.
paras.zh: 他说，食物并不总是可用，有时他们会挨饿。

paras.en: "Sometimes you eat, sometimes you don't," he said. "My daughter is inside, so I have to stay here. What else can I do? This is our situation."
paras.zh: “有时你吃，有时你不吃，”他说。 “我女儿在里面，所以我必须留在这里。我还能做什么？这就是我们的处境。”

paras.en: So Aamar Singh waits on the pavement for news about his daughter until he can take her home.
paras.zh: 因此，阿马尔·辛格在人行道上等待有关他女儿的消息，直到他能带她回家。

paras.en: Sajad Hameed is an India-based journalist and multimedia storyteller focusing on South Asia. He writes about politics, human rights, health, business, the economy and the impact of climate change, with particular focus on the region's evolving social and political landscape.
paras.zh: 萨贾德·哈米德 (Sajad Hameed) 是一位驻印度记者和多媒体故事讲述者，专注于南亚。他撰写的文章涉及政治、人权、健康、商业、经济和气候变化的影响，特别关注该地区不断变化的社会和政治格局。

paras.en: Rehan Qayoom Mir is an independent journalist whose work has appeared in outlets including Al Jazeera English, The Guardian, Nikkei Asia, The Progressive, Jacobin and more. He reports from across India and South Asia, with a focus on ground reporting and human-interest stories.
paras.zh: Rehan Qayoom Mir 是一名独立记者，其作品曾出现在半岛电视台英语频道、卫报、日经亚洲、进步报、雅各宾报等媒体上。他在印度和南亚各地进行报道，重点关注地面报道和人文故事。

articles.title: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
paras.zh: 军事基地发生致命事件后，阿尔伯塔省发生重大火灾

paras.en: EDMONTON, Alberta — Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at a military base in Alberta that caused a major fire, while reports said that large numbers of injured people were being transported to hospitals.
paras.zh: 艾伯塔省埃德蒙顿——加拿大国防部长周六表示，艾伯塔省一处军事基地发生火灾，造成人员伤亡，有报道称，大量伤者正在被送往医院。

paras.en: Fire crews scrambled late into the night as fierce winds whipped flames beyond Canadian Forces Base Wainwright and into the surrounding rural area.
paras.zh: 消防人员在深夜奋力救援，狂风将火焰从加拿大温赖特军事基地吹到周围的农村地区。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear how many people were killed or injured, but a doctor at a hospital in the city of Edmonton, 180 km (120 miles) northwest, told Canada's national broadcaster that patients were being brought to hospitals across the city as health-care facilities around the base became "completely overwhelmed" by the number of people needing care.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚有多少人死亡或受伤，但西北 180 公里（120 英里）的埃德蒙顿市一家医院的一名医生告诉加拿大国家广播公司，由于基地周围的医疗机构因需要护理的人数而“完全不堪重负”，患者被送往全市各地的医院。

paras.en: "This number of patients would overwhelm the city of Edmonton," Dr. Warren Thirsk, an emergency department physician at the Royal Alexandra Hospital, told CBC News. "It is more patients than any of us want to count right now. It's a disaster. It's a one in every 15 to 25-year disaster."
paras.zh: 皇家亚历山德拉医院急诊科医生沃伦·瑟斯克博士告诉加拿大广播公司新闻网：“这么多的病人将使埃德蒙顿市不堪重负。” “现在的病人数量比我们任何人想要统计的都要多。这是一场灾难。每 15 到 25 年的灾难就有一次。”

paras.en: The town of Wainwright, near the base, has about 7,000 residents.
paras.zh: 基地附近的温赖特镇约有 7,000 名居民。

paras.en: Defense Minister David McGuinty said the Royal Canadian Mounted Police were involved in investigating the incident and described the situation as "very, very active and delicate." He said authorities were still working to determine what happened and expected to provide further information.
paras.zh: 国防部长戴维·麦坚蒂表示，加拿大皇家骑警已参与调查该事件，并称局势“非常、非常活跃且微妙”。他表示，当局仍在努力确定发生了什么，并希望提供进一步的信息。

paras.en: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police said officers were called shortly after 4 p.m. Saturday following reports of a fire in a training area at the base.
paras.zh: 加拿大皇家骑警表示，下午 4 点过后不久，警方接到报警。周六，有报道称基地训练区发生火灾。

paras.en: Firefighters faced a volatile situation. Large areas of the province were hit during the day by a windstorm with gusts up to 100 kilometres an hour. The wind toppled some trees and sent signs flying and garbage cans rolling down streets.
paras.zh: 消防队员面临着不稳定的局势。白天，该省大部分地区遭受阵风高达每小时 100 公里的风暴袭击。风吹倒了一些树木，招牌飞扬，垃圾桶滚落街道。

paras.en: By 11 p.m., the Municipal District of Wainwright said on social media the fire was being held and that property and critical infrastructure were protected. There was no evacuation order for residents.
paras.zh: 晚上 11 点，温赖特市政府在社交媒体上表示，火势已被控制，财产和关键基础设施受到保护。没有居民疏散命令。

paras.en: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe said his province was sending assistance to Alberta but did not specify what resources were being deployed.
paras.zh: 萨斯喀彻温省省长斯科特·莫表示，该省正在向艾伯塔省提供援助，但没有具体说明正在部署哪些资源。

paras.en: "Our thoughts are with all the brave women and men affected," Prime Minister Mark Carney said earlier in a social media post.
paras.zh: “我们的心与所有受影响的勇敢的女性和男性同在，”总理马克·卡尼早些时候在社交媒体帖子中表示。

paras.en: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith described the fire as "significant and tragic" and said it was affecting many military personnel.
paras.zh: 阿尔伯塔省省长丹妮尔·史密斯（Danielle Smith）形容这场火灾“重大而悲惨”，并表示许多军事人员受到影响。

paras.en: CFB Wainwright is one of Canada's busiest military training bases, where soldiers prepare for combat operations. It is home to the Canadian Manoeuvre Training Centre, which conducts realistic battlefield exercises, and the 3rd Canadian Division Training Centre, which provides military training.
paras.zh: CFB 温赖特是加拿大最繁忙的军事训练基地之一，士兵们在这里为作战行动做准备。这里是进行真实战场演习的加拿大机动训练中心和提供军事训练的加拿大第三师训练中心的所在地。

paras.en: Canadian Conservative opposition leader Pierre Poilievre said he had spoken with Carney and the defense minister to offer support to those affected by the fire.
paras.zh: 加拿大保守党反对党领袖皮埃尔·波利耶夫表示，他已与卡尼和国防部长交谈，向受火灾影响的人们提供支持。

paras.en: "Pray for Wainwright, everyone," Poilievre said in a social media post. He urged people in the area to follow emergency instructions and keep roads clear for first responders.
paras.zh: “大家为温赖特祈祷，”波利耶夫在社交媒体帖子中说。他敦促该地区的人们遵守紧急指示，并为急救人员保持道路畅通。

paras.en: The fire also disrupted advance voting ahead of Monday's referendum on whether Alberta should begin a process that could lead to independence from Canada. Elections Alberta said two polling locations, in Lloydminster and Vermilion, closed early Saturday and the ballots were transported securely.
paras.zh: 火灾还扰乱了周一就艾伯塔省是否应该开始从加拿大独立的进程进行公投之前的提前投票。艾伯塔省选举局表示，劳埃德明斯特和弗米利恩的两个投票站周六早些时候关闭，选票已安全运输。

articles.title: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
paras.zh: 教皇利奥表示癌症手术后将逐步恢复职务

paras.en: VATICAN CITY — Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized for an operation to remove a malignant tumor, and said he plans to gradually return to his usual duties.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈城——周日，教皇利奥十四世在他因恶性肿瘤手术住院期间，感谢圣彼得广场数千名信徒的祈祷，并表示他计划逐步恢复正常职责。

paras.en: The crowd erupted in cheers when the pontiff showed himself in the window overlooking the square, where a week ago on the same occasion of the traditional Angelus blessing he revealed that a nodule had been located on his lung, and that it would be surgically removed.
paras.zh: 当教皇出现在俯瞰广场的窗户时，人群爆发出欢呼声。一周前，在传统的三钟经祝福仪式上，他透露自己的肺部发现了一个结节，将通过手术切除。

paras.en: ''Now that this delicate phase is behind me, I will gradually resume my activities, always with God's help and your prayers," Leo said, his voice sounding strong four days after the lower lobe of his right lung was removed.
paras.zh: “现在这个微妙的阶段已经过去，我将在上帝的帮助和你们的祈祷下逐渐恢复我的活动，”利奥说，在右肺下叶被切除四天后，他的声音听起来很有力。

paras.en: The pontiff said the experience of the last week "has made me feel especially close to those facing illness and infirmity." He told the faithful that he had ''truly felt your support,'' and expressed ''particular gratitude to the doctors, nurses and all the staff at Gemelli hospital'' where he was treated.
paras.zh: 教宗表示，上周的经历“让我对那些面临疾病和虚弱的人感到特别亲近”。他告诉信徒，他“真正感受到了你们的支持”，并表达了“特别感谢他接受治疗的格梅利医院的医生、护士和所有工作人员”。

paras.en: The pope paused for a moment and waved to the crowd before retreating into his apartment in the Apostolic Palace.
paras.zh: 教皇停顿了一会儿，向人群挥手致意，然后退回到他在使徒宫的公寓里。

paras.en: A delegation from Africa in Rome for a congress danced and ululated after the pope's blessing.
paras.zh: 来自非洲的代表团在罗马参加一次大会，在教皇的祝福后跳舞并欢呼。

paras.en: ''He was always in our prayers when he was sick, and we are happy to see him today,″ said Alain Kalembu of the Democratic Republic of Congo. ″This is an expression of our joy.″
paras.zh: “当他生病时，我们总是为他祈祷，我们很高兴今天见到他，”刚果民主共和国的阿兰·卡伦布说。 “这是我们喜悦的表达。”

paras.en: The 71-year-old pontiff had the lower lobe of his right lung removed on Tuesday in the first major health event of his 17-month pontificate. The surgery confirmed he had adenocarcinoma, the most common type of lung cancer.
paras.zh: 周二，这位71岁的教皇切除了右肺下叶，这是他就任教皇17个月以来的第一次重大健康事件。手术证实他患有腺癌，这是最常见的肺癌类型。

paras.en: He told a reporter in English that he was doing ''much better'' as he drove away from Rome's Gemelli hospital to return to the Vatican, after a shorter hospital stay than had initially been anticipated.
paras.zh: 他用英语告诉记者，当他开车离开罗马杰梅利医院返回梵蒂冈时，他的情况“好多了”，住院时间比最初预期的要短。

paras.en: "I don't believe it, because he was just operated on the other day," Cosimo Mastrocinque, a retired factory worker visiting the Vatican from the southern region of Puglia, said. "It is a miracle that he recovered already."
paras.zh: “我不相信，因为他前几天刚刚接受手术，”从普利亚南部地区访问梵蒂冈的退休工厂工人科西莫·马斯特罗辛克说。 “他已经康复了，这真是一个奇迹。”

paras.en: American tourists were especially eager to pray alongside the first pope born in the United States. Marla Marsala of Michigan was supposed to attend a Mass with the pope last week that was canceled due to his hospitalization.
paras.zh: 美国游客特别渴望与美国第一位出生的教皇一起祈祷。密歇根州的玛拉·马萨拉原定于上周与教皇一起参加弥撒，但由于教皇住院而被取消。

paras.en: ''I am just happy that we are praying with him today instead of for him, like we were before,'' Marsala said. "It was a tough week for all of the people who love him, which are many. He seems like a very strong soul. So I think he will pull through and fight it, and succeed and keep doing the wonderful work he is doing.''
paras.zh: “我很高兴我们今天与他一起祈祷，而不是像以前那样为他祈祷，”马萨拉说。 “对于所有爱他的人来说，这是艰难的一周。他看起来是一个非常坚强的灵魂。所以我认为他会渡过难关并与之抗争，取得成功并继续做他正在做的出色工作。”

paras.en: Claire Holland from Jacksonville, Florida, said she felt "very blessed" to be present for the pope's return to his flock.
paras.zh: 来自佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔的克莱尔·霍兰德表示，能够出席教皇回到他的信徒身边，她感到“非常幸运”。

paras.en: "I'm so happy that he has recovered so quickly. I think there have been millions and millions of prayers. And he is a strong, determined man, and I am so happy that he is feeling well enough to do this," Holland said.
paras.zh: “我很高兴他康复得这么快。我想已经有数以百万计的人为他祈祷。他是一个坚强、坚定的人，我很高兴他感觉很好，可以做到这一点，”霍兰德说。

paras.en: Leo's next major engagement is an ambitious Nov. 6-17 trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, including a dozen flights and two helicopter rides to high altitudes. His surgeon, Dr. Stefano Margaritora, told Vatican News on Saturday that "there are no clinical reasons why it should not take place."
paras.zh: Leo 的下一个主要活动是 11 月 6 日至 17 日雄心勃勃的乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁之旅，其中包括十几次飞行和两架直升机飞往高海拔地区。他的外科医生斯特凡诺·马加里托拉（Stefano Margaritora）医生周六告诉梵蒂冈新闻，“没有任何临床原因不应该进行这种手术。”

paras.en: "The Holy Father has put his heart and soul into his recovery," Margaritora told Vatican News, adding that he expected the pope to recover fully from surgery "in another 10 days or so."
paras.zh: 马加里托拉告诉梵蒂冈新闻：“教宗全心全意地致力于康复。”他补充说，他预计教皇“再过十天左右”就能从手术中完全康复。

paras.en: Histological testing of the tumor and related lymph nodes was underway. The results, along with details of the tumor's molecular and genetic makeup, will help doctors determine whether the pope needs additional treatment. Options include chemotherapy, a combination of chemotherapy and immunotherapy, or targeted oral therapy based on the tumor's genetic characteristics.
paras.zh: 肿瘤和相关淋巴结的组织学检测正在进行中。结果以及肿瘤分子和基因组成的详细信息将帮助医生确定教皇是否需要额外治疗。选择包括化疗、化疗和免疫治疗相结合，或根据肿瘤的遗传特征进行靶向口服治疗。

paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。
